package ru.savushkina.feature.review

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ItemConstraints
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

data class ReviewFormState(
    val item: Item? = null,
    val rating: Int = 0,
    val comment: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isSaving: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class ReviewViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val itemId: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("itemId"))
    private var currentUserId: String? = null

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(
        ReviewFormState(
            isLoading = true,
            rating = savedStateHandle.get<Int>(KEY_RATING) ?: 0,
            comment = savedStateHandle.get<String>(KEY_COMMENT).orEmpty()
        )
    )
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    init {
        if (itemId.isBlank()) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                isLoading = false,
                error = "Некорректный ID айтема"
            )
        } else {
            load()
        }
    }

    private fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            currentUserId = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
            runCatchingCancellable {
                val item = itemRepository.getItemById(itemId)
                val existing = currentUserId?.let { reviewRepository.getReview(it, itemId) }
                item to existing
            }.onSuccess { (item, existing) ->
                // Если в SavedStateHandle уже есть черновик (rating/comment),
                // не перезатираем его данными из существующего отзыва.
                val hasDraftRating = savedStateHandle.contains(KEY_RATING)
                val hasDraftComment = savedStateHandle.contains(KEY_COMMENT)
                _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                    item = item,
                    rating = if (hasDraftRating) _state.value.rating
                    else existing?.rating ?: 0,
                    comment = if (hasDraftComment) _state.value.comment
                    else existing?.comment ?: "",
                    isLoading = false
                )
                // Если черновика не было, а отзыв существовал — сохраняем как стартовый.
                if (!hasDraftRating && existing != null) {
                    savedStateHandle[KEY_RATING] = existing.rating
                }
                if (!hasDraftComment && existing != null) {
                    savedStateHandle[KEY_COMMENT] = existing.comment
                }
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить айтем"
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun onRatingChange(newRating: Int) {
        savedStateHandle[KEY_RATING] = newRating
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(rating = newRating, error = null)
    }

    fun onCommentChange(value: String) {
        savedStateHandle[KEY_COMMENT] = value
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(comment = value, error = null)
    }

    fun save(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        val uid = currentUserId
        if (uid == null) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(error = "Не авторизован")
            return
        }
        val rating = _state.value.rating
        if (rating < 1 || rating > ItemConstraints.RATING_MAX) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(error = "Поставьте оценку от 1 до 5")
            return
        }
        val comment = _state.value.comment.trim()
        if (comment.length > ItemConstraints.REVIEW_COMMENT_MAX) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                error = "Комментарий слишком длинный (максимум ${ItemConstraints.REVIEW_COMMENT_MAX})"
            )
            return
        }
        if (_state.value.isSaving) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(isSaving = true, error = null)
            val user = userRepository.currentUser.value
            val item = _state.value.item

            reviewRepository.saveReview(
                Review(
                    userId = uid,
                    itemId = itemId,
                    rating = rating,
                    comment = comment,
                    authorName = user?.displayName ?: "",
                    authorAvatarBase64 = user?.avatarBase64 ?: "",
                    itemName = item?.name ?: "",
                    itemSymbol = item?.symbol,
                    itemIconKey = item?.iconKey
                )
            )
                .onSuccess {
                    // Черновик больше не нужен — очищаем.
                    savedStateHandle.remove<Int>(KEY_RATING)
                    savedStateHandle.remove<String>(KEY_COMMENT)
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        rating = 0,
                        comment = ""
                    )
                    onSuccess()
                }
                .onFailure { e ->
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Не удалось сохранить отзыв"
                    )
                }
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val KEY_RATING = "review_rating"
        const val KEY_COMMENT = "review_comment"
    }
}

package com.example.feature.search

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.FlowPreview
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface SearchUiState {
    data object Idle : SearchUiState
    data object Loading : SearchUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<Item>) : SearchUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : SearchUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class, FlowPreview::class)
@HiltViewModel
class SearchViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _query = MutableStateFlow("")
    val query = _query.asStateFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<SearchUiState> = _query
        .debounce(300)
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .flatMapLatest { raw ->
            val q = raw.trim()
            flow {
                if (q.isBlank()) {
                    emit(SearchUiState.Idle)
                } else {
                    emit(SearchUiState.Loading)
                    runCatchingCancellable { itemRepository.searchByName(q) }
                        .onSuccess { emit(SearchUiState.Success(it)) }
                        .onFailure {
                            emit(
                                SearchUiState.Error(
                                    it.message ?: "Не удалось выполнить поиск"
                                )
                            )
                        }
                }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            SearchUiState.Idle
        )

    fun onQueryChange(value: String) {
        _query.value = value
    }
}

package com.example.feature.search

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes

import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface TypeItemsUiState {
    data object Loading : TypeItemsUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<Item>) : TypeItemsUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : TypeItemsUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class TypeItemsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val type: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("type"))
    val typeName: String get() = type

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<TypeItemsUiState>(TypeItemsUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        if (type.isBlank()) {
            _uiState.value = TypeItemsUiState.Error("Некорректный тип")
        } else {
            load()
        }
    }

    private fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            runCatchingCancellable { itemRepository.getItemsByType(type) }
                .onSuccess { _uiState.value = TypeItemsUiState.Success(it) }
                .onFailure {
                    _uiState.value = TypeItemsUiState.Error(
                        it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить айтемы"
                    )
                }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun UserSearchScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onUserClick: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: UserSearchViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val query by viewModel.query.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// поиск людей",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = viewModel::onQueryChange,
                label = "username",
                placeholder = "@handle"
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is UserSearchUiState.Idle -> {
                    LabelText(text = "// введите username")
                }
                is UserSearchUiState.Loading -> {
                    SkeletonList(count = 4) { SkeletonItemRow() }
                }
                is UserSearchUiState.Error -> {
                    AlertBox(text = (state as UserSearchUiState.Error).message)
                }
                is UserSearchUiState.Success -> {
                    val users = (state as UserSearchUiState.Success).users
                    if (users.isEmpty()) {
                        LabelText(text = "// никого не нашли")
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                        ) {
                            items(users, key = { it.uid }) { user ->
                                UserRow(user = user, onClick = { onUserClick(user.uid) })
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun UserRow(user: User, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable(onClick = onClick)
                .padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            WireAvatar(
                avatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64,
                fallbackText = user.initials,
                size = 40.dp
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.padding(start = Spacing.md))
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = user.displayName,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                )
                if (user.handle.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                    LabelText(
                        text = user.handle,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.search

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.FlowPreview
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface UserSearchUiState {
    data object Idle : UserSearchUiState
    data object Loading : UserSearchUiState
    data class Success(val users: List<User>) : UserSearchUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : UserSearchUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class, FlowPreview::class)
@HiltViewModel
class UserSearchViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _query = MutableStateFlow("")
    val query = _query.asStateFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<UserSearchUiState> = _query
        .debounce(300)
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .flatMapLatest { raw ->
            val q = raw.trim().removePrefix("@")
            flow {
                if (q.isBlank()) {
                    emit(UserSearchUiState.Idle)
                } else {
                    emit(UserSearchUiState.Loading)
                    runCatchingCancellable {
                        val byPrefix = userRepository.searchUsersByUsernamePrefix(q, limit = 30)
                        if (byPrefix.isNotEmpty()) return@runCatchingCancellable byPrefix
                        // Точное совпадение, если префикс не дал результата.
                        val exact = userRepository.getUserByUsername(q)
                        if (exact != null) listOf(exact) else emptyList()
                    }
                        .onSuccess { emit(UserSearchUiState.Success(it)) }
                        .onFailure {
                            emit(UserSearchUiState.Error(it.message ?: "Не удалось найти"))
                        }
                }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            UserSearchUiState.Idle
        )

    fun onQueryChange(value: String) {
        _query.value = value
    }
}

    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val draft by viewModel.draft.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isSaving by viewModel.isSaving.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val error by viewModel.error.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val textCaseStyle by viewModel.textCaseStyle.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isCheckingUsername by viewModel.isCheckingUsername.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val usernameAvailable by viewModel.usernameAvailable.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    var confirmSignOut by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    val imagePicker = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(
        contract = ActivityResultContracts.GetContent()
    ) { uri ->
        uri?.let { viewModel.onAvatarSelected(it) }
    }

    SettingsContent(
        state = state,
        draft = draft,
        isSaving = isSaving,
        error = error,
        isCheckingUsername = isCheckingUsername,
        usernameAvailable = usernameAvailable,
        onBack = onBack,
        onPickAvatar = { imagePicker.launch("image/*") },
        onNameChange = viewModel::onNameChange,
        onUsernameChange = viewModel::onUsernameChange,
        onDescriptionChange = viewModel::onDescriptionChange,
        onRoleChange = viewModel::onRoleChange,
        onSave = { viewModel.save(onSuccess = onSaved) },
        onSignOut = { confirmSignOut = true },
        textCaseStyle = textCaseStyle,
        onTextCaseStyleChange = viewModel::setTextCaseStyle
    )

    if (confirmSignOut) {
        SignOutDialog(
            onConfirm = {
                confirmSignOut = false
                viewModel.signOut()
            },
            onDismiss = { confirmSignOut = false }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SignOutDialog(
    onConfirm: () -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    Dialog(onDismissRequest = onDismiss) {
        WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                    .padding(Spacing.md)
            ) {
                LabelText(text = "// выйти из аккаунта?")
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                Row(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                ) {
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        WireButton(
                            text = "отмена",
                            onClick = onDismiss,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                    }
                    Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                        WireButton(
                            text = "выйти",
                            onClick = onConfirm,
                            accent = true,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun SettingsContent(
    state: SettingsUiState,
    draft: User? = null,
    isSaving: Boolean = false,
    error: String? = null,
    isCheckingUsername: Boolean = false,
    usernameAvailable: Boolean? = null,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onPickAvatar: () -> Unit = {},
    onNameChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onUsernameChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onDescriptionChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onRoleChange: (Role) -> Unit = {},
    onSave: () -> Unit = {},
    onSignOut: () -> Unit = {},
    textCaseStyle: TextCaseStyle = TextCaseStyle.NORMAL,
    onTextCaseStyleChange: (TextCaseStyle) -> Unit = {},
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val canSave = !isSaving && state is SettingsUiState.Success

            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// настройки",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                },
                right = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = if (isSaving) "..." else "сохранить",
                        color = if (canSave) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                        else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(enabled = canSave, onClick = onSave)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))

            when (state) {
                is SettingsUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is SettingsUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is SettingsUiState.Success -> {
                    val user = draft ?: state.user
                    SettingsForm(
                        user = user,
                        isSaving = isSaving,
                        error = error,
                        isCheckingUsername = isCheckingUsername,
                        usernameAvailable = usernameAvailable,
                        onPickAvatar = onPickAvatar,
                        onNameChange = onNameChange,
                        onUsernameChange = onUsernameChange,
                        onDescriptionChange = onDescriptionChange,
                        onRoleChange = onRoleChange,
                        onSave = onSave,
                        onSignOut = onSignOut,
                        onTextCaseStyleChange = onTextCaseStyleChange,
                        textCaseStyle = textCaseStyle
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SettingsForm(
    user: User,
    isSaving: Boolean,
    error: String?,
    isCheckingUsername: Boolean,
    usernameAvailable: Boolean?,
    onPickAvatar: () -> Unit,
    onNameChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onUsernameChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onDescriptionChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onRoleChange: (Role) -> Unit,
    onSave: () -> Unit,
    onSignOut: () -> Unit = {},
    textCaseStyle: TextCaseStyle = TextCaseStyle.NORMAL,
    onTextCaseStyleChange: (TextCaseStyle) -> Unit = {},
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxSize()
            .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.TopCenter
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(vertical = Spacing.lg),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
        ) {
            WireAvatar(
                avatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64,
                fallbackText = user.initials,
                size = 120.dp
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
            LabelText(
                text = "[ сменить аватар ]",
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                modifier = Modifier.clickable(enabled = !isSaving, onClick = onPickAvatar)
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

            WireTextField(
                value = user.name,
                onValueChange = onNameChange,
                label = "name",
                placeholder = "ваше_имя",
                enabled = !isSaving
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireTextField(
                value = user.username,
                onValueChange = onUsernameChange,
                label = "username",
                placeholder = "handle",
                enabled = !isSaving
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
            LabelText(
                text = when {
                    isCheckingUsername -> "// проверяем..."
                    usernameAvailable == true -> "// @${user.username} свободен"
                    usernameAvailable == false -> "// @${user.username} занят"
                    user.username.isBlank() -> "// 3–20 символов, a-z, 0-9, _"
                    else -> "// @${user.username}"
                },
                color = when {
                    usernameAvailable == true -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    usernameAvailable == false -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                    else -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                }
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireTextField(
                value = user.description,
                onValueChange = onDescriptionChange,
                label = "about",
                placeholder = "пара_слов_о_себе",
                singleLine = false,
                enabled = !isSaving
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

            LabelText(
                text = "// ваша роль",
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))

            RolePicker(
                selectedRole = user.role,
                onRoleSelect = onRoleChange,
                enabled = !isSaving
            )

            error?.let {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                AlertBox(text = it)
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))
            WireButton(
                text = if (isSaving) "сохранение..." else "сохранить",
                onClick = onSave,
                accent = true,
                enabled = !isSaving
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

            LabelText(
                text = "// стиль текста",
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))

            TextCaseStylePicker(
                selected = textCaseStyle,
                onSelect = onTextCaseStyleChange,
                enabled = !isSaving
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))
            WireButton(text = "выйти из аккаунта", onClick = onSignOut)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TextCaseStylePicker(
    selected: TextCaseStyle,
    onSelect: (TextCaseStyle) -> Unit,
    enabled: Boolean = true
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        TextCaseStyle.entries.forEach { style ->
            val isSelected = selected == style
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .clickable(enabled = enabled) { onSelect(style) }
                    .padding(vertical = Spacing.xs),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                LabelText(
                    text = if (isSelected) "[x]" else "[ ]",
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )
                Text(
                    text = style.displayName,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = if (isSelected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE [181/192]: feature/settings/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/feature/settings/SettingsViewModel.kt
==============================================================================
package ru.savushkina.feature.settings

import android.net.Uri
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AvatarEncodeResult
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AvatarEncoder
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SettingsRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Role
import ru.savushkina.core.model.TextCaseStyle
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserConstraints
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface SettingsUiState {
    data object Loading : SettingsUiState
    data class Success(val user: User) : SettingsUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : SettingsUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class SettingsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val sessionRepository: SessionRepository,
    private val settingsRepository: SettingsRepository,
    private val avatarEncoder: AvatarEncoder
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<SettingsUiState>(SettingsUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _draft = MutableStateFlow<User?>(null)
    val draft = _draft.asStateFlow()

    private val _isSaving = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isSaving = _isSaving.asStateFlow()

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    private val _isCheckingUsername = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isCheckingUsername = _isCheckingUsername.asStateFlow()

    private val _usernameAvailable = MutableStateFlow<Boolean?>(null)
    val usernameAvailable = _usernameAvailable.asStateFlow()

    private var usernameCheckJob: Job? = null

    val textCaseStyle: StateFlow<TextCaseStyle> = settingsRepository.textCaseStyle
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), TextCaseStyle.NORMAL)

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            userRepository.currentUser.collect { user ->
                if (user != null) {
                    _uiState.value = SettingsUiState.Success(user)
                    if (_draft.value == null) _draft.value = user
                } else if (_uiState.value !is SettingsUiState.Loading) {
                    _uiState.value = SettingsUiState.Error("Не авторизован")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun setTextCaseStyle(style: TextCaseStyle) {
        viewModelScope.launch { settingsRepository.setTextCaseStyle(style) }
    }

    fun onNameChange(value: String) {
        _draft.update { it?.copy(name = value) }
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        val clean = value.lowercase().removePrefix("@").filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() || it == '_' }
        _draft.update { it?.copy(username = clean) }
        _error.value = null
        _usernameAvailable.value = null
        scheduleUsernameCheck(clean)
    }

    private fun scheduleUsernameCheck(username: String) {
        usernameCheckJob?.cancel()
        val original = (_uiState.value as? SettingsUiState.Success)?.user?.username.orEmpty()
        if (username == original) {
            _usernameAvailable.value = true
            return
        }
        if (username.isBlank()) return
        if (!UserConstraints.USERNAME_REGEX.matches(username)) return

        usernameCheckJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            delay(500)
            _isCheckingUsername.value = true
            userRepository.isUsernameAvailable(username)
                .onSuccess { available ->
                    _isCheckingUsername.value = false
                    _usernameAvailable.value = available
                    if (!available) _error.value = "Этот username уже занят"
                }
                .onFailure {
                    _isCheckingUsername.value = false
                    _usernameAvailable.value = null
                }
        }
    }

    fun onDescriptionChange(value: String) {
        _draft.update { it?.copy(description = value) }
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun onRoleChange(role: Role) {
        _draft.update { user ->
            if (user == null) null
            else user.copy(role = if (user.role == role) null else role)
        }
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun onAvatarSelected(uri: Uri) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _error.value = null
            when (val result = avatarEncoder.encode(uri)) {
                is AvatarEncodeResult.Failure -> _error.value = result.reason
                is AvatarEncodeResult.TooLarge -> _error.value =
                    "Изображение слишком большое (${result.base64Length / 1024} KB > " +
                            "${UserConstraints.AVATAR_MAX_BASE64_LENGTH / 1024} KB)"
                is AvatarEncodeResult.Success -> {
                    _draft.update { it?.copy(avatarBase64 = result.base64) }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun signOut() = sessionRepository.signOut()

    fun save(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        val currentDraft = _draft.value ?: return
        validate(currentDraft)?.let { _error.value = it; return }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isSaving.value = true
            _error.value = null
            val authUser = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()
            if (authUser == null) {
                _isSaving.value = false
                _error.value = "Сессия истекла, войдите заново"
                return@launch
            }
            userRepository.saveProfile(
                uid = authUser.uid,
                name = currentDraft.name.trim(),
                username = currentDraft.username.trim().ifBlank { null },
                description = currentDraft.description.trim(),
                avatarBase64 = currentDraft.avatarBase64,
                role = currentDraft.role
            )
                .onSuccess {
                    _isSaving.value = false
                    _draft.value = null
                    _usernameAvailable.value = null
                    onSuccess()
                }
                .onFailure {
                    _isSaving.value = false
                    _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось сохранить"
                }
        }
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        super.onCleared()
        _draft.value = null
        usernameCheckJob?.cancel()
    }

    private fun validate(user: User): String? {
        val name = user.name.trim()
        if (name.isBlank()) return "Имя не может быть пустым"
        if (name.length > UserConstraints.NAME_MAX) {
            return "Имя слишком длинное (максимум ${UserConstraints.NAME_MAX} символов)"
        }
        if (user.username.isNotBlank() &&
            !UserConstraints.USERNAME_REGEX.matches(user.username)
        ) {
            return "Username: 3–20 символов, a-z, 0-9, _"
        }
        if (_usernameAvailable.value == false) return "Этот username уже занят"
        if (user.description.length > UserConstraints.DESCRIPTION_MAX) {
            return "Описание слишком длинное (максимум ${UserConstraints.DESCRIPTION_MAX})"
        }
        return null
    }
}

#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH="\\\"\\\""


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

package ru.savushkina.codeboxd

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.WindowInsets
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.material3.Scaffold
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.navigation.NavHostController
import androidx.navigation.NavType
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.currentBackStackEntryAsState
import androidx.navigation.navArgument
import com.example.feature.collection.ArrayPickerScreen
import com.example.feature.collection.CollectionDetailScreen
import com.example.feature.collection.CollectionPickerScreen
import com.example.feature.collection.CollectionTypePickerScreen
import com.example.feature.collection.CollectionsListScreen
import com.example.feature.collection.CreateCollectionScreen
import com.example.feature.favourite_picker.FavouritePickerScreen
import com.example.feature.search.LowestRatedScreen
import com.example.feature.search.SearchScreen
import com.example.feature.search.TopRatedScreen
import com.example.feature.search.TypeItemsScreen
import com.example.feature.search.TypesScreen
import com.example.feature.search.UserSearchScreen
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.AlertBox
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.BlinkingCursor
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.WireButton

import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.pattern.TerminalScreen
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Spacing
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.FollowListMode
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import ru.savushkina.feature.activity.ActivityScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.auth.AuthScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.details.DetailsScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.feed.FeedScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.onboarding.OnboardingScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.profile.FollowListScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.profile.ProfileScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.profile.ProfileViewModel
import ru.savushkina.feature.review.ReviewDetailScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.review.ReviewReactionsScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.review.ReviewScreen
import ru.savushkina.feature.settings.SettingsScreen

@Composable
fun CodeboxNavHost(
    navController: NavHostController,
    sessionViewModel: SessionViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val navTarget by sessionViewModel.navTarget.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val currentUserId by sessionViewModel.currentUserId.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val canRetry by sessionViewModel.canRetry.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val retrying by sessionViewModel.retrying.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    val currentRoute = navController.currentBackStackEntryAsState().value?.destination?.route
        ?: Routes.SPLASH

    LaunchedEffect(navTarget) {
        val target = navTarget ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        val current = navController.currentDestination?.route

        when (target) {
            Routes.AUTH -> if (current != Routes.AUTH) {
                navController.navigate(Routes.AUTH) {
                    popUpTo(navController.graph.id) { inclusive = true }
                    launchSingleTop = true
                }
            }
            Routes.ONBOARDING -> if (current != Routes.ONBOARDING) {
                navController.navigate(Routes.ONBOARDING) {
                    popUpTo(navController.graph.id) { inclusive = true }
                    launchSingleTop = true
                }
            }
            Routes.FEED -> {
                val sessionRoutes = setOf(
                    Routes.SPLASH, Routes.AUTH, Routes.ONBOARDING, Routes.FEED
                )
                if (current in sessionRoutes && current != Routes.FEED) {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.FEED) {
                        popUpTo(navController.graph.id) { inclusive = true }
                        launchSingleTop = true
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    val bottomBarRoutes = setOf(
        Routes.FEED, Routes.SEARCH, Routes.ACTIVITY, Routes.PROFILE
    )
    val showBottomBar = currentRoute in bottomBarRoutes
    val selectedTab = when (currentRoute) {
        Routes.FEED -> BottomTab.FEED
        Routes.SEARCH -> BottomTab.SEARCH
        Routes.ACTIVITY -> BottomTab.ACTIVITY
        Routes.PROFILE -> BottomTab.PROFILE
        else -> null
    }

    Scaffold(
        contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0),
        bottomBar = {
            if (showBottomBar) {
                TerminalBottomBar(
                    selectedTab = selectedTab,
                    onFeedClick = { navController.navigateSingleTop(Routes.FEED) },
                    onSearchClick = { navController.navigateSingleTop(Routes.SEARCH) },
                    onActivityClick = { navController.navigateSingleTop(Routes.ACTIVITY) },
                    onProfileClick = { navController.navigateSingleTop(Routes.PROFILE) }
                )
            }
        }
    ) { padding ->
        NavHost(
            navController = navController,
            startDestination = Routes.SPLASH,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(padding)
        ) {
            composable(Routes.SPLASH) {
                TerminalScreen {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        if (canRetry) {
                            Column(
                                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.md)
                            ) {
                                AlertBox(text = "Не удалось загрузить профиль")
                                WireButton(
                                    text = if (retrying) "загрузка..." else "повторить",
                                    onClick = sessionViewModel::retry,
                                    accent = true,
                                    enabled = !retrying
                                )
                            }
                        } else {
                            BlinkingCursor()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            composable(Routes.AUTH) { AuthScreen() }
            composable(Routes.ONBOARDING) { OnboardingScreen() }

            composable(Routes.FEED) {
                FeedScreen(
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.ACTIVITY) {
                ActivityScreen(
                    onUserClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    },
                    onReviewClick = { reviewId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.reviewDetail(reviewId))
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.DETAILS,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("itemId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) { entry ->
                val itemId = entry.arguments?.getString("itemId").orEmpty()
                DetailsScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onWriteReview = { navController.navigate(Routes.reviewForm(itemId)) },
                    onReviewClick = { reviewId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.reviewDetail(reviewId))
                    },
                    onAuthorClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    },
                    currentUserId = currentUserId
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.REVIEW_FORM,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("itemId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                ReviewScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onSaved = { navController.popBackStack() }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.REVIEW_DETAIL,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("reviewId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) { entry ->
                val reviewId = entry.arguments?.getString("reviewId").orEmpty()
                ReviewDetailScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onAuthorClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    },
                    onReactionsClick = {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.reviewReactions(reviewId))
                    },
                    currentUserId = currentUserId
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.REVIEW_REACTIONS,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("reviewId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                ReviewReactionsScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onUserClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.SEARCH) {
                SearchScreen(
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) },
                    onSearchByTypeClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TYPES) },
                    onTopRatedClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TOP_RATED) },
                    onLowestRatedClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.LOWEST_RATED) },
                    onUserSearchClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.USER_SEARCH) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.USER_SEARCH) {
                UserSearchScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onUserClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.TYPES) {
                TypesScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onTypeClick = { type -> navController.navigate(Routes.typeItems(type)) }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.TYPE_ITEMS,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("type") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                TypeItemsScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.TOP_RATED) {
                TopRatedScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.LOWEST_RATED) {
                LowestRatedScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.PROFILE) { backStackEntry ->
                val profileViewModel: ProfileViewModel = hiltViewModel()
                val selectedItemFlow = remember(backStackEntry) {
                    backStackEntry.savedStateHandle
                        .getStateFlow<String?>("selected_item", null)
                }
                LaunchedEffect(selectedItemFlow, profileViewModel) {
                    selectedItemFlow.collect { itemId ->
                        if (itemId != null) {
                            profileViewModel.addFavourite(itemId)
                            backStackEntry.savedStateHandle["selected_item"] = null
                        }
                    }
                }

                ProfileScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onSettingsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.SETTINGS) },
                    onReviewClick = { reviewId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.reviewDetail(reviewId))
                    },
                    onAddFavouriteClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.FAVOURITE_PICKER) },
                    onCollectionsClick = { userId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collections(userId))
                    },
                    onFollowersClick = {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.followList(FollowListMode.FOLLOWERS))
                    },
                    onFollowingClick = {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.followList(FollowListMode.FOLLOWING))
                    },
                    viewModel = profileViewModel
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.USER_PROFILE,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("userId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                ProfileScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onSettingsClick = {},
                    onReviewClick = { reviewId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.reviewDetail(reviewId))
                    },
                    onAddFavouriteClick = {},
                    onCollectionsClick = { userId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collections(userId))
                    },
                    onFollowersClick = {},
                    onFollowingClick = {},
                    viewModel = hiltViewModel()
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.FOLLOW_LIST,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("mode") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                FollowListScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onUserClick = { userId ->
                        navController.openUserProfile(userId, currentUserId)
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.FAVOURITE_PICKER) {
                FavouritePickerScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemSelected = { itemId ->
                        navController.previousBackStackEntry
                            ?.savedStateHandle
                            ?.set("selected_item", itemId)
                        navController.popBackStack()
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.SETTINGS) {
                SettingsScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onSaved = {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.PROFILE) {
                            popUpTo(Routes.PROFILE) { inclusive = true }
                            launchSingleTop = true
                        }
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.COLLECTIONS,
                arguments = listOf(
                    navArgument("userId") {
                        type = NavType.StringType
                        nullable = true
                        defaultValue = null
                    }
                )
            ) {
                CollectionsListScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onCollectionClick = { id ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collectionDetail(id))
                    },
                    onCreateClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.COLLECTION_CREATE) }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.COLLECTION_CREATE) { entry ->
                CreateCollectionScreen(
                    backStackEntry = entry,
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onListCreated = { id ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collectionDetail(id)) {
                            popUpTo(Routes.COLLECTIONS) { inclusive = false }
                        }
                    },
                    onGoToTypePicker = {
                        navController.navigate(Routes.COLLECTION_TYPE_PICKER)
                    },
                    onGoToArrayPicker = { name, type ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collectionArrayPicker(name, type))
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(Routes.COLLECTION_TYPE_PICKER) {
                CollectionTypePickerScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onTypeSelected = { type ->
                        navController.previousBackStackEntry
                            ?.savedStateHandle
                            ?.set("selected_type", type)
                        navController.popBackStack()
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.COLLECTION_ARRAY_PICKER,
                arguments = listOf(
                    navArgument("name") { type = NavType.StringType; defaultValue = "" },
                    navArgument("type") { type = NavType.StringType; defaultValue = "" }
                )
            ) {
                ArrayPickerScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onCreated = { id ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collectionDetail(id)) {
                            popUpTo(Routes.COLLECTIONS) { inclusive = false }
                        }
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.COLLECTION_DETAIL,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("collectionId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                CollectionDetailScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemClick = { itemId -> navController.navigate(Routes.details(itemId)) },
                    onAddItemClick = { collectionId ->
                        navController.navigate(Routes.collectionPicker(collectionId))
                    },
                    onDeleted = {
                        navController.popBackStack(Routes.COLLECTIONS, inclusive = false)
                    }
                )
            }

            composable(
                route = Routes.COLLECTION_PICKER,
                arguments = listOf(navArgument("collectionId") { type = NavType.StringType })
            ) {
                CollectionPickerScreen(
                    onBack = { navController.popBackStack() },
                    onItemAdded = { navController.popBackStack() }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun NavHostController.navigateSingleTop(route: String) {
    if (currentDestination?.route == route) return
    navigate(route) {
        popUpTo(graph.id) { saveState = true }
        launchSingleTop = true
        restoreState = true
    }
}

private fun NavHostController.openUserProfile(userId: String, currentUserId: String?) {
    if (userId == currentUserId) {
        navigateSingleTop(Routes.PROFILE)
    } else {
        navigate(Routes.userProfile(userId))
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.codeboxd

import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.activity.ComponentActivity
import androidx.activity.SystemBarStyle
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.activity.enableEdgeToEdge
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import dagger.hilt.android.AndroidEntryPoint
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.CodeboxTheme
import ru.savushkina.feature.settings.SettingsViewModel

@AndroidEntryPoint
class MainActivity : ComponentActivity() {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        enableEdgeToEdge(
            statusBarStyle = SystemBarStyle.dark(Color.TRANSPARENT),
            navigationBarStyle = SystemBarStyle.dark(Color.TRANSPARENT)
        )
        setContent {
            val settingsViewModel: SettingsViewModel = hiltViewModel()
            val textCaseStyle by settingsViewModel.textCaseStyle.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

            CodeboxTheme(textCaseStyle = textCaseStyle) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                ) {
                    CodeboxNavHost(navController = rememberNavController())
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.codeboxd

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.SessionState
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class SessionViewModel @Inject constructor(
    sessionRepository: SessionRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    val sessionState: StateFlow<SessionState> = sessionRepository.sessionState

    private val _retrying = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val retrying: StateFlow<Boolean> = _retrying.asStateFlow()

    val currentUserId: StateFlow<String?> = sessionRepository.sessionState
        .map { state ->
            when (state) {
                is SessionState.Authenticated -> state.user.uid
                is SessionState.Onboarding -> state.userId
                is SessionState.ProfileLoadError -> state.userId
                else -> null
            }
        }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .stateIn(
            scope = viewModelScope,
            started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            initialValue = null
        )

    val navTarget: StateFlow<String?> = sessionRepository.sessionState
        .map { state ->
            when (state) {
                SessionState.Unknown -> null
                SessionState.LoadingProfile -> null
                is SessionState.ProfileLoadError -> null
                SessionState.Unauthenticated -> Routes.AUTH
                is SessionState.Onboarding -> Routes.ONBOARDING
                is SessionState.Authenticated -> Routes.FEED
            }
        }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .stateIn(
            scope = viewModelScope,
            started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            initialValue = null
        )

    /**
     * true — на сплэше нужно показать «повторить».
     * Скрываем кнопку на время попытки (_retrying = true).
     */
    val canRetry: StateFlow<Boolean> = combine(
        sessionRepository.sessionState,
        _retrying
    ) { state, retrying ->
        state is SessionState.ProfileLoadError && !retrying
    }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .stateIn(
            scope = viewModelScope,
            started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            initialValue = false
        )

    fun retry() {
        val state = sessionState.value
        val uid = when (state) {
            is SessionState.ProfileLoadError -> state.userId
            is SessionState.Authenticated -> state.user.uid
            is SessionState.Onboarding -> state.userId
            else -> return
        }
        if (_retrying.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _retrying.value = true
            try {
                userRepository.refresh(uid)
            } finally {
                _retrying.value = false
            }
        }
    }
}

FILE [17/192]: collect_project.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Собирает все текстовые файлы проекта в один .txt с оглавлением и разделителями.

Использование:
    python3 collect_project.py                     # текущая папка → project.txt
    python3 collect_project.py -r /path/to/project  # указать корень
    python3 collect_project.py -o output.txt        # указать выходной файл
    python3 collect_project.py --ext .kt .xml .json # только эти расширения
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# ── Что пропускаем (папки) ──
DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS = {
    ".git", ".gradle", ".idea", "build", "out", "node_modules",
    "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv", "env", ".dart_tool", ".next",
    ".cache", "dist", ".kotlin", "generated", ".fleet",
}

# ── Что пропускаем (файлы) ──
DEFAULT_SKIP_FILES = {
    ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", "local.properties",
    "google-services.json", ".gitignore",
}

# ── Расширения, которые считаем текстом, если не указано иное ──
DEFAULT_TEXT_EXT = {
    ".kt", ".kts", ".java", ".xml", ".json", ".gradle", ".properties",
    ".pro", ".toml", ".md", ".txt", ".yml", ".yaml", ".cfg", ".ini",
    ".html", ".css", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".jsx", ".py", ".sh",
    ".gitignore", ".editorconfig", ".firebaserc", ".npmrc",
}

# ── Размер файла (пропускаем слишком большие — обычно бинарники) ──
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB

# ── Бинарные расширения — пропускаем всегда ──
BINARY_EXT = {
    ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif", ".webp", ".ico", ".bmp", ".svg",
    ".ttf", ".otf", ".woff", ".woff2", ".eot",
    ".mp3", ".mp4", ".wav", ".ogg", ".webm",
    ".zip", ".tar", ".gz", ".rar", ".7z",
    ".apk", ".aab", ".jar", ".aar", ".dex",
    ".so", ".dylib", ".dll", ".class",
    ".pdf", ".doc", ".docx", ".xls", ".xlsx", ".ppt", ".pptx",
    ".db", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3",
}

# ── Специальные имена файлов без расширения ──
SPECIAL_TEXT_NAMES = {
    "Dockerfile", "Makefile", "README", "LICENSE", ".gitignore",
    ".editorconfig", ".firebaserc", ".npmrc", "gradlew", "gradlew.bat",
    "firebase.json", "firestore.indexes.json", "firestore.rules",
}


def is_binary(path: Path) -> bool:
    """Проверка, что файл — бинарник (по первым 8 КБ)."""
    try:
        with open(path, "rb") as f:
            chunk = f.read(8192)
        return b"\x00" in chunk
    except OSError:
        return True


def should_include(path: Path, root: Path, text_exts: set) -> bool:
    """Решает, включать ли файл."""
    name = path.name

    if name in DEFAULT_SKIP_FILES:
        return False
    if path.suffix.lower() in BINARY_EXT:
        return False
    if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
        return False

    # Файл по расширению?
    if path.suffix.lower() in text_exts:
        return True
    # Файл без расширения, но известный?
    if not path.suffix and name in SPECIAL_TEXT_NAMES:
        return True
    # Файл без расширения — эвристика: пробуем прочитать как UTF-8
    if not path.suffix:
        return not is_binary(path)

    return False


def collect_files(root: Path, text_exts: set) -> list[Path]:
    """Рекурсивно собирает все подходящие файлы, сортирует по пути."""
    files = []
    for current, dirs, filenames in os.walk(root):
        # Пропускаем мусорные папки
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS]
        for name in filenames:
            p = Path(current) / name
            if p.is_file() and should_include(p, root, text_exts):
                files.append(p)
    files.sort(key=lambda p: str(p).lower())
    return files


def write_output(files: list[Path], root: Path, out: Path) -> None:
    """Пишет все файлы в один .txt с оглавлением."""
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        # ── Шапка ──
        f.write("#" * 78 + "\n")
        f.write(f"# PROJECT: {root.name}\n")
        f.write(f"# ROOT:    {root}\n")
        f.write(f"# FILES:   {len(files)}\n")
        f.write("#" * 78 + "\n\n")

        # ── Оглавление ──
        f.write("=" * 78 + "\n")
        f.write("ОГЛАВЛЕНИЕ\n")
        f.write("=" * 78 + "\n")
        for i, p in enumerate(files, 1):
            rel = p.relative_to(root)
            f.write(f"{i:4d}. {rel}\n")
        f.write("\n")

        # ── Содержимое ──
        for i, p in enumerate(files, 1):
            rel = p.relative_to(root)
            f.write("=" * 78 + "\n")
            f.write(f"FILE [{i}/{len(files)}]: {rel}\n")
            f.write("=" * 78 + "\n")
            try:
                content = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                try:
                    content = p.read_text(encoding="cp1251")
                except Exception:
                    f.write("[[не удалось прочитать как текст]]\n\n")
                    continue
            except Exception as e:
                f.write(f"[[ошибка чтения: {e}]]\n\n")
                continue
            f.write(content)
            if not content.endswith("\n"):
                f.write("\n")
            f.write("\n")

    print(f"✔ Записано {len(files)} файлов в {out}")
    print(f"  Размер: {out.stat().st_size / 1024:.1f} KB")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Собирает все текстовые файлы проекта в один .txt"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "-r", "--root", default=".", help="Корень проекта (по умолчанию: .)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "-o", "--output", default=None,
        help="Выходной файл (по умолчанию: <root>/project.txt)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--ext", nargs="+", default=None,
        help="Только эти расширения (например: --ext .kt .xml)"
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--include-skip-dirs", action="store_true",
        help="Не пропускать build/, .git/ и т.п. (осторожно)"
    )
    args = parser.parse_args()

    root = Path(args.root).resolve()
    if not root.is_dir():
        print(f"✖ Не найдена папка: {root}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    out = Path(args.output) if args.output else root / "project.txt"
    out = out.resolve()

    text_exts = set(DEFAULT_TEXT_EXT)
    if args.ext:
        text_exts = {e if e.startswith(".") else "." + e for e in args.ext}

    if args.include_skip_dirs:
        DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS.clear()

    files = collect_files(root, text_exts)
    if not files:
        print("✖ Не нашлось подходящих файлов", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    write_output(files, root, out)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

package ru.savushkina.core.common

import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry

package ru.savushkina.core.common

import kotlin.coroutines.cancellation.CancellationException

/**
 * Безопасный runCatching, который не глотает CancellationException.
 * Используйте его во всех suspend-функциях, где нужен Result.
 */
inline fun <T> runCatchingCancellable(block: () -> T): Result<T> =
    try {
        Result.success(block())
    } catch (e: CancellationException) {
        throw e
    } catch (e: Exception) {
        Result.failure(e)
    }

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuthException
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ErrorMapper
import ru.savushkina.core.model.AppError
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class AuthErrorMapper @Inject constructor() : ErrorMapper {

    override fun map(e: Throwable): AppError = mapInternal(e)

    companion object {
        fun mapInternal(e: Throwable): AppError {
            if (e is FirebaseAuthException) {
                val code = e.errorCode ?: ""
                val message = when (code) {
                    "ERROR_INVALID_CREDENTIALS",
                    "INVALID_LOGIN_CREDENTIALS" -> "Неверный email или пароль"

                    "ERROR_EMAIL_ALREADY_IN_USE",
                    "EMAIL_EXISTS" -> "Этот email уже зарегистрирован"

                    "ERROR_WEAK_PASSWORD",
                    "WEAK_PASSWORD" -> "Пароль слишком короткий (минимум 6 символов)"

                    "ERROR_USER_NOT_FOUND",
                    "USER_NOT_FOUND" -> "Пользователь с таким email не найден"

                    "ERROR_INVALID_EMAIL",
                    "INVALID_EMAIL" -> "Некорректный email"

                    "ERROR_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS",
                    "TOO_MANY_REQUESTS" -> "Слишком много попыток. Попробуйте позже"

                    "ERROR_NETWORK_REQUEST_FAILED",
                    "NETWORK_ERROR" -> "Нет подключения к интернету"

                    "ERROR_OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED",
                    "OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED" -> "Вход по email временно отключён"

                    else -> fallbackByMessage(e.message.orEmpty())
                }
                return AppError.Auth(message = message, cause = e)
            }

            val msg = e.message.orEmpty()
            return when {
                msg.contains("network", ignoreCase = true) ->
                    AppError.Network(cause = e)
                else -> AppError.Unknown(cause = e)
            }
        }

        private fun fallbackByMessage(msg: String): String = when {
            msg.contains("credential is incorrect", ignoreCase = true) ->
                "Неверный email или пароль"
            msg.contains("network", ignoreCase = true) ->
                "Нет подключения к интернету"
            else -> "Что-то пошло не так. Попробуйте ещё раз"
        }
    }
}
