// core/data/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/core/data/AuthRepositoryImpl.kt
package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseUser
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.AuthUser
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class AuthRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val auth: FirebaseAuth
) : AuthRepository {

    override val authState: Flow<AuthUser?> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = FirebaseAuth.AuthStateListener { firebaseAuth ->
            trySend(firebaseAuth.currentUser?.toAuthUser())
        }
        auth.addAuthStateListener(listener)
        awaitClose { auth.removeAuthStateListener(listener) }
    }

    override fun currentUid(): String? = auth.currentUser?.uid

    override suspend fun signIn(email: String, password: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password).await()
            Unit
        }

    override suspend fun signUp(email: String, password: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password).await()
            Unit
        }

    override fun signOut() = auth.signOut()

    private fun FirebaseUser.toAuthUser() = AuthUser(uid = uid, email = email)
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.net.Uri
import android.util.Base64
import android.util.Log
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AvatarEncodeResult
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AvatarEncoder
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserConstraints
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class AvatarEncoderImpl @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) : AvatarEncoder {

    override suspend fun encode(uri: Uri): AvatarEncodeResult =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { encodeInternal(uri) }

    private fun encodeInternal(uri: Uri): AvatarEncodeResult {
        val bytes: ByteArray = try {
            context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use { it.readBytes() }
                ?: return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Не удалось прочитать изображение")
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "encode: read failed", e)
            return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Не удалось прочитать изображение")
        }

        if (bytes.isEmpty()) return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Файл пустой")

        val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
        BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, bounds)

        if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) {
            return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Формат изображения не поддерживается")
        }

        val sample = calculateInSampleSize(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight, TARGET_PX)
        val opts = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inSampleSize = sample }
        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, opts)
            ?: return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Не удалось декодировать изображение")

        val scaled: Bitmap = try {
            if (bitmap.width != TARGET_PX || bitmap.height != TARGET_PX) {
                Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(bitmap, TARGET_PX, TARGET_PX, true)
                    .also { if (it !== bitmap) bitmap.recycle() }
            } else {
                bitmap
            }
        } catch (e: OutOfMemoryError) {
            Log.e(TAG, "encode: OOM", e)
            bitmap.recycle()
            return AvatarEncodeResult.Failure("Недостаточно памяти для обработки изображения")
        }

        val stream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, JPEG_QUALITY, stream)
        scaled.recycle()

        val base64 = Base64.encodeToString(stream.toByteArray(), Base64.NO_WRAP)

        return if (base64.length > UserConstraints.AVATAR_MAX_BASE64_LENGTH) {
            AvatarEncodeResult.TooLarge(base64.length)
        } else {
            AvatarEncodeResult.Success(base64)
        }
    }

    private fun calculateInSampleSize(width: Int, height: Int, target: Int): Int {
        var sample = 1
        var w = width
        var h = height
        while (w / 2 >= target && h / 2 >= target) {
            w /= 2
            h /= 2
            sample *= 2
        }
        return sample
    }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "AvatarEncoderImpl"
        const val TARGET_PX = 128
        const val JPEG_QUALITY = 70
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.Timestamp
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class CollectionRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore
) : CollectionRepository {

    override fun observeCollections(userId: String): Flow<List<UserCollection>> =
        callbackFlow {
            val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .whereEqualTo("userId", userId)
                .orderBy("createdAt", com.google.firebase.firestore.Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
                .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                    if (error != null) {
                        close(error)
                        return@addSnapshotListener
                    }
                    if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                    val list = snapshot?.documents
                        ?.mapNotNull { it.toCollectionOrNull() }
                        .orEmpty()
                    trySend(list)
                }
            awaitClose { listener.remove() }
        }

    override fun observeCollection(collectionId: String): Flow<UserCollection?> =
        callbackFlow {
            val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .document(collectionId)
                .addSnapshotListener { doc, error ->
                    if (error != null) {
                        close(error)
                        return@addSnapshotListener
                    }
                    if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                    trySend(doc?.takeIf { it.exists() }?.toCollectionOrNull())
                }
            awaitClose { listener.remove() }
        }

    override suspend fun createCollection(
        collection: UserCollection
    ): Result<String> = runCatchingCancellable {
        require(collection.name.isNotBlank()) { "Имя коллекции не может быть пустым" }
        require(collection.name.length <= UserCollection.NAME_MAX) {
            "Имя коллекции слишком длинное (макс. ${UserCollection.NAME_MAX})"
        }
        if (collection.isFixedSize) {
            require(collection.itemIds.size in UserCollection.MIN_SIZE..UserCollection.MAX_SIZE_LIMIT) {
                "Размер массива должен быть от ${UserCollection.MIN_SIZE} до ${UserCollection.MAX_SIZE_LIMIT}"
            }
            require(!collection.allowedItemType.isNullOrBlank()) {
                "Для массива нужно указать тип айтемов"
            }
            require(collection.maxSize == collection.itemIds.size) {
                "maxSize массива должен совпадать с количеством itemIds"
            }
        }

        val data = mapOf(
            "userId" to collection.userId,
            "name" to collection.name,
            "itemIds" to collection.itemIds,
            "isFixedSize" to collection.isFixedSize,
            "maxSize" to collection.maxSize,
            "allowedItemType" to collection.allowedItemType,
            "createdAt" to Timestamp.now()
        )
        val ref = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).add(data).await()
        ref.id
    }

    override suspend fun addItem(collectionId: String, itemId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val collectionRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).document(collectionId)
            firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
                val snapshot = tx.get(collectionRef)
                if (!snapshot.exists()) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Коллекция не найдена")
                }
                val isFixed = snapshot.getBoolean("isFixedSize") ?: false
                if (isFixed) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Массив нельзя редактировать")
                }
                val current = (snapshot.get("itemIds") as? List<*>)
                    ?.mapNotNull { it as? String }
                    .orEmpty()
                if (current.contains(itemId)) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Айтем уже добавлен")
                }
                tx.update(collectionRef, "itemIds", current + itemId)
            }.await()
            Unit
        }

    override suspend fun removeItem(collectionId: String, itemId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).document(collectionId)
            firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
                val snapshot = tx.get(docRef)
                if (!snapshot.exists()) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Коллекция не найдена")
                }
                val isFixed = snapshot.getBoolean("isFixedSize") ?: false
                if (isFixed) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Массив нельзя редактировать")
                }
                val current = (snapshot.get("itemIds") as? List<*>)
                    ?.mapNotNull { it as? String }
                    .orEmpty()
                tx.update(docRef, "itemIds", current.filterNot { it == itemId })
            }.await()
            Unit
        }

    override suspend fun rename(collectionId: String, newName: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            require(newName.isNotBlank()) { "Имя не может быть пустым" }
            require(newName.length <= UserCollection.NAME_MAX) {
                "Имя слишком длинное (макс. ${UserCollection.NAME_MAX})"
            }
            firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .document(collectionId)
                .update("name", newName)
                .await()
            Unit
        }

    override suspend fun deleteCollection(collectionId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .document(collectionId)
                .delete()
                .await()
            Unit
        }

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toCollectionOrNull(): UserCollection? = runCatching {
        UserCollection(
            id = id,
            userId = getString("userId") ?: "",
            name = getString("name") ?: "",
            itemIds = (get("itemIds") as? List<*>)?.mapNotNull { it as? String }.orEmpty(),
            isFixedSize = getBoolean("isFixedSize") ?: false,
            maxSize = getLong("maxSize")?.toInt() ?: 0,
            allowedItemType = getString("allowedItemType"),
            createdAtMillis = getTimestamp("createdAt")?.toDate()?.time ?: 0L
        )
    }.getOrNull()

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION = "collections"
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data.di

import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import javax.inject.Qualifier
import javax.inject.Singleton

/**
 * Область жизни = весь процесс.
 * Используется в репозиториях, которые должны переживать пересоздание ViewModel/Activity.
 */
@Qualifier
@Retention(AnnotationRetention.BINARY)
annotation class ApplicationScope

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object AppScopeModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    @ApplicationScope
    fun provideAppScope(): CoroutineScope =
        CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FavouriteRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.AddFavouriteResult
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FavouriteFour
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class FavouriteRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore
) : FavouriteRepository {

    override fun observeFavourites(userId: String): Flow<List<String>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .document(userId)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) {
                    close(error)
                    return@addSnapshotListener
                }
                val ids = snapshot?.get("itemIds") as? List<*> ?: emptyList<Any>()
                trySend(ids.mapNotNull { it as? String })
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override suspend fun addFavourite(
        userId: String,
        itemId: String
    ): Result<AddFavouriteResult> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).document(userId)
        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val snapshot = tx.get(docRef)
            val current = (snapshot.get("itemIds") as? List<*>)
                ?.mapNotNull { it as? String }
                .orEmpty()

            when {
                current.contains(itemId) -> AddFavouriteResult.AlreadyExists
                current.size >= FavouriteFour.MAX_SIZE -> AddFavouriteResult.LimitReached
                else -> {
                    tx.set(
                        docRef,
                        mapOf("itemIds" to (current + itemId)),
                        SetOptions.merge()
                    )
                    AddFavouriteResult.Added
                }
            }
        }.await()
    }

    override suspend fun removeFavourite(
        userId: String,
        itemId: String
    ): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).document(userId)
        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val snapshot = tx.get(docRef)
            val current = (snapshot.get("itemIds") as? List<*>)
                ?.mapNotNull { it as? String }
                .orEmpty()
            tx.set(
                docRef,
                mapOf("itemIds" to current.filterNot { it == itemId }),
                SetOptions.merge()
            )
        }.await()
        Unit
    }

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION = "favourites"
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.Query
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FeedRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItem
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class FeedRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore
) : FeedRepository {

    override fun observeFeed(userId: String, limit: Long): Flow<List<FeedItem>> =
        callbackFlow {
            val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FEEDS)
                .document(userId)
                .collection(COLLECTION_ITEMS)
                .orderBy("timestampMillis", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
                .limit(limit)
                .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                    if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                    if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                    val items = snapshot?.documents
                        ?.mapNotNull { it.toFeedItemOrNull() }
                        .orEmpty()
                    trySend(items)
                }
            awaitClose { listener.remove() }
        }

    override suspend fun loadMore(
        userId: String,
        lastTimestampMillis: Long,
        limit: Long
    ): Result<List<FeedItem>> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FEEDS)
            .document(userId)
            .collection(COLLECTION_ITEMS)
            .orderBy("timestampMillis", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .startAfter(lastTimestampMillis)
            .limit(limit)
            .get()
            .await()
        snapshot.documents.mapNotNull { it.toFeedItemOrNull() }
    }

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toFeedItemOrNull(): FeedItem? = runCatching {
        val typeRaw = getString("type") ?: return@runCatching null
        val type = FeedItemType.valueOf(typeRaw)
        FeedItem(
            id = id,
            ownerUid = getString("ownerUid") ?: "",
            type = type,
            actorUid = getString("actorUid") ?: "",
            actorName = getString("actorName") ?: "",
            actorAvatarBase64 = getString("actorAvatarBase64") ?: "",
            reviewId = getString("reviewId") ?: "",
            reviewComment = getString("reviewComment") ?: "",
            itemName = getString("itemName") ?: "",
            rating = getLong("rating")?.toInt() ?: 0,
            commentText = getString("commentText") ?: "",
            reaction = getString("reaction")?.let {
                runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
            },
            timestampMillis = getLong("timestampMillis") ?: 0L
        )
    }.getOrNull()

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION_FEEDS = "feeds"
        const val COLLECTION_ITEMS = "items"
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FeedWriter
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType
import ru.savushkina.core.model.feedItemId
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class FeedWriterImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore
) : FeedWriter {

    /**
     * Fan-out: пишем элемент в ленту каждого подписчика [actorUid] + в ленту
     * [extraOwnerUid] (если задан и не совпадает с actorUid).
     *
     * Батч Firestore ограничен 500 операциями. Если подписчиков больше
     * MAX_FANOUT — пишем только первым MAX_FANOUT и логируем warning
     * (в production это должно уйти в Cloud Function).
     */
    override suspend fun fanOut(
        actorUid: String,
        sourceId: String,
        type: FeedItemType,
        payload: FeedWriter.FeedPayload,
        extraOwnerUid: String?
    ): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()

        // 1. Собираем получателей.
        val recipients = buildSet {
            val followers = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
                .whereEqualTo("followingId", actorUid)
                .limit((FeedWriter.MAX_FANOUT).toLong())
                .get()
                .await()
                .documents
                .mapNotNull { it.getString("followerId") }
            addAll(followers)
            if (!extraOwnerUid.isNullOrBlank() && extraOwnerUid != actorUid) {
                add(extraOwnerUid)
            }
            remove(actorUid)
        }

        if (recipients.isEmpty()) return@runCatchingCancellable

        if (recipients.size >= FeedWriter.MAX_FANOUT) {
            Log.w(
                TAG,
                "fanOut: recipients=${recipients.size} hit MAX_FANOUT; " +
                        "move to Cloud Function for actor=$actorUid"
            )
        }

        // 2. Пишем батчем. Firestore батч = 500 операций.
        recipients.chunked(BATCH_LIMIT).forEach { chunk ->
            val batch = firestore.batch()
            chunk.forEach { ownerUid ->
                val docId = feedItemId(type, sourceId, ownerUid)
                val ref = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FEEDS)
                    .document(ownerUid)
                    .collection(COLLECTION_ITEMS)
                    .document(docId)
                val data = mapOf(
                    "ownerUid" to ownerUid,
                    "type" to type.name,
                    "actorUid" to actorUid,
                    "actorName" to payload.actorName,
                    "actorAvatarBase64" to payload.actorAvatarBase64,
                    "reviewId" to payload.reviewId,
                    "reviewComment" to payload.reviewComment,
                    "itemName" to payload.itemName,
                    "rating" to payload.rating,
                    "commentText" to payload.commentText,
                    "reaction" to payload.reaction?.name,
                    "timestampMillis" to now
                )
                batch.set(ref, data, SetOptions.merge())
            }
            batch.commit().await()
        }
        Unit
    }

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "FeedWriterImpl"
        const val COLLECTION_FEEDS = "feeds"
        const val COLLECTION_ITEMS = "items"
        const val COLLECTION_FOLLOWS = "follows"
        const val BATCH_LIMIT = 500
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.Timestamp
import com.google.firebase.firestore.AggregateSource
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FeedWriter
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FollowRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FollowResult
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class FollowRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore,
    private val feedWriter: FeedWriter
) : FollowRepository {

    override fun observeFollowing(userId: String): Flow<List<String>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
            .whereEqualTo("followerId", userId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", com.google.firebase.firestore.Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val ids = snapshot?.documents
                    ?.mapNotNull { it.getString("followingId") }
                    .orEmpty()
                trySend(ids)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override fun observeFollowers(userId: String): Flow<List<String>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
            .whereEqualTo("followingId", userId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", com.google.firebase.firestore.Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val ids = snapshot?.documents
                    ?.mapNotNull { it.getString("followerId") }
                    .orEmpty()
                trySend(ids)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override fun observeIsFollowing(
        followerId: String,
        followingId: String
    ): Flow<Boolean> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
            .document(followDocId(followerId, followingId))
            .addSnapshotListener { doc, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                trySend(doc?.exists() == true)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override suspend fun follow(
        followerId: String,
        followingId: String
    ): Any = runCatchingCancellable {
        if (followerId == followingId) return@runCatchingCancellable FollowResult.CannotFollowSelf
        val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
            .document(followDocId(followerId, followingId))

        val isNew = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val snap = tx.get(docRef)
            if (snap.exists()) {
                FollowResult.AlreadyFollowing
            } else {
                isNew.set(true)
                tx.set(
                    docRef,
                    mapOf(
                        "followerId" to followerId,
                        "followingId" to followingId,
                        "createdAt" to Timestamp.now()
                    ),
                    SetOptions.merge()
                )
                FollowResult.Followed
            }
        }.await()

        if (isNew.get()) {
            // Профиль подписчика нужен для денормализации в feed.
            val follower = runCatching {
                firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS).document(followerId).get().await()
            }.getOrNull()
            feedWriter.fanOut(
                actorUid = followerId,
                sourceId = followDocId(followerId, followingId),
                type = FeedItemType.NEW_FOLLOWER,
                payload = FeedWriter.FeedPayload(
                    actorName = follower?.getString("name").orEmpty(),
                    actorAvatarBase64 = follower?.getString("avatarBase64").orEmpty()
                ),
                extraOwnerUid = followingId
            )
        }
    }

    override suspend fun unfollow(
        followerId: String,
        followingId: String
    ): Result<FollowResult> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
            .document(followDocId(followerId, followingId))
        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val snap = tx.get(docRef)
            if (!snap.exists()) {
                FollowResult.NotFollowing
            } else {
                tx.delete(docRef)
                FollowResult.Unfollowed
            }
        }.await()
    }

    override suspend fun getFollowCounts(userId: String): Result<Pair<Int, Int>> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val followersCount = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
                .whereEqualTo("followingId", userId)
                .count()
                .get(AggregateSource.SERVER)
                .await()
                .count
            val followingCount = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_FOLLOWS)
                .whereEqualTo("followerId", userId)
                .count()
                .get(AggregateSource.SERVER)
                .await()
                .count
            followersCount.toInt() to followingCount.toInt()
        }

    private fun followDocId(followerId: String, followingId: String): String =
        "$followerId|$followingId"

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION_FOLLOWS = "follows"
        const val COLLECTION_USERS = "users"
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import android.util.Log
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.Query
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.supervisorScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.Page
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class ItemRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore
) : ItemRepository {

    // ── Кэш типов (in-memory, TTL 5 минут) ──
    // getTypes() читает всю коллекцию items (1000+ документов) — это дорого.
    // Кэшируем результат, чтобы не дёргать Firestore на каждый экран.
    @Volatile
    private var cachedTypes: List<String> = emptyList()
    @Volatile
    private var cachedTypesAt: Long = 0L

    override fun observeItems(limit: Long): Flow<List<Item>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .orderBy("name", Query.Direction.ASCENDING)
            .limit(limit)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) {
                    close(error)
                    return@addSnapshotListener
                }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                trySend(snapshot?.documents?.mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }.orEmpty())
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override fun observeItemById(itemId: String): Flow<Item?> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .document(itemId)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) {
                    close(error)
                    return@addSnapshotListener
                }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                trySend(snapshot?.takeIf { it.exists() }?.toItemOrNull())
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override suspend fun getItemById(itemId: String): Item? = runCatchingCancellable {
        val doc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION).document(itemId).get().await()
        if (!doc.exists()) null else doc.toItemOrNull()
    }.getOrNull()

    override suspend fun getItemsByIds(ids: List<String>): List<Item> {
        val distinctIds = ids.distinct()
        if (distinctIds.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return runCatchingCancellable {
            val byId = mutableMapOf<String, Item>()
            supervisorScope {
                distinctIds.chunked(FIRESTORE_IN_LIMIT).map { chunk ->
                    async {
                        runCatchingCancellable {
                            firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                                .whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), chunk)
                                .get()
                                .await()
                                .documents
                                .mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
                        }.onFailure { e ->
                            Log.w(TAG, "getItemsByIds: chunk failed (${chunk.size} ids)", e)
                        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                    }
                }.awaitAll().flatten().forEach { byId[it.id] = it }
            }
            distinctIds.mapNotNull { byId[it] }
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    }

    /**
     * Поиск по ключевым словам через `array-contains`.
     *
     * Схема: у каждого item есть поле `keywords: List<String>` —
     * нормализованные слова из name/type/description (lowercase, distinct).
     *
     * Запрос: `whereArrayContains("keywords", q)`, где `q` — нормализованный
     * ввод пользователя. Найдёт item, у которого в keywords есть **целое**
     * слово `q`. Поиск «Kot» НЕ найдёт «Kotlin» — это осознанное ограничение.
     *
     * Требует индекса: keywords ASC + name ASC (создать в firestore.indexes.json).
     */
    override suspend fun searchByName(query: String, limit: Long): List<Item> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val q = normalizeKeyword(query)
            if (q.isBlank()) return@runCatchingCancellable emptyList()

            val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .whereArrayContains("keywords", q)
                .orderBy("name", Query.Direction.ASCENDING)
                .limit(limit)
                .get()
                .await()

            snapshot.documents.mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
        }.onFailure { e ->
            Log.w(TAG, "searchByName failed for query=$query", e)
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    override suspend fun getTypes(): List<String> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val cached = cachedTypes
        if (cached.isNotEmpty() && now - cachedTypesAt < TYPES_CACHE_TTL_MS) {
            return@runCatchingCancellable cached
        }

        val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .get()
            .await()
        val types = snapshot.documents
            .mapNotNull { it.getString("type") }
            .map { it.trim() }
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            .distinct()
            .sorted()

        cachedTypes = types
        cachedTypesAt = now
        types
    }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    override suspend fun getItemsByType(type: String, limit: Long): List<Item> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            if (type.isBlank()) return@runCatchingCancellable emptyList()
            val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .whereEqualTo("type", type)
                .limit(TYPE_FETCH_LIMIT)
                .get()
                .await()
            snapshot.documents
                .mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
                .sortedBy { it.name.lowercase() }
                .take(limit.toInt())
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    /**
     * Топ по рейтингу.
     *
     * ВАЖНО: при 1000+ items клиентская сортировка по первым 200 документам
     * не даёт корректного «топа». Оставляем клиентскую сортировку как
     * временный фикс, но для продакшена нужно:
     *   1) проставить averageRating + ratingCount всем items,
     *   2) вернуть Firestore-запрос:
     *      .whereGreaterThan("ratingCount", 0)
     *      .orderBy("averageRating", DESC)
     *   3) задеплоить индексы из firestore.indexes.json.
     */
    override suspend fun getTopRated(limit: Long): List<Item> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .limit(RATING_FETCH_LIMIT)
            .get()
            .await()
        snapshot.documents
            .mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
            .filter { it.averageRating > 0.0 }
            .sortedByDescending { it.averageRating }
            .take(limit.toInt())
    }.onFailure { Log.w(TAG, "getTopRated failed", it) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    override suspend fun getLowestRated(limit: Long): List<Item> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .limit(RATING_FETCH_LIMIT)
            .get()
            .await()
        snapshot.documents
            .mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
            .filter { it.averageRating > 0.0 }
            .sortedBy { it.averageRating }
            .take(limit.toInt())
    }.onFailure { Log.w(TAG, "getLowestRated failed", it) }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    override suspend fun loadItemsPage(
        limit: Long,
        lastDocId: String?
    ): Result<Page<Item>> = runCatchingCancellable {
        var query: Query = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
            .orderBy("name")
            .limit(limit)

        if (!lastDocId.isNullOrBlank()) {
            val lastDoc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION)
                .document(lastDocId)
                .get()
                .await()
            if (lastDoc.exists()) query = query.startAfter(lastDoc)
        }

        val docs = query.get().await().documents
        val items = docs.mapNotNull { it.toItemOrNull() }
        Page(items = items, nextCursor = docs.lastOrNull()?.id)
    }

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toItemOrNull(): Item? = runCatching {
        val storedAverage = getDouble("averageRating")
        val computedAverage = run {
            val sum = getLong("ratingSum") ?: 0L
            val count = getLong("ratingCount") ?: 0L
            if (count > 0L) sum.toDouble() / count else 0.0
        }
        Item(
            id = id,
            name = getString("name") ?: "",
            type = (getString("type") ?: "").trim(),
            description = getString("description") ?: "",
            symbol = getString("symbol"),
            iconKey = getString("iconKey"),
            averageRating = storedAverage ?: computedAverage
        )
    }.getOrNull()

    /**
     * Нормализует поисковый ввод: lowercase, trim, схлопывает пробелы.
     * Используется для сравнения с `keywords` (там тоже lowercase).
     */
    private fun normalizeKeyword(raw: String): String =
        raw.trim().lowercase().replace(Regex("\\s+"), " ")

    private companion object {
        const val TAG = "ItemRepositoryImpl"
        const val COLLECTION = "items"
        const val FIRESTORE_IN_LIMIT = 30
        const val TYPE_FETCH_LIMIT = 200L
        const val RATING_FETCH_LIMIT = 200L
        const val TYPES_CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L  // 5 минут
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import com.google.firebase.Timestamp
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.Query
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.awaitClose
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.callbackFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FeedWriter
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.Page
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ItemConstraints
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ReviewComment
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class ReviewRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore,
    private val feedWriter: FeedWriter
) : ReviewRepository {

    // ── Отзывы ──

    override fun observeReviewsForUser(userId: String): Flow<List<Review>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
            .whereEqualTo("userId", userId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .limit(REVIEWS_PAGE_LIMIT)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val reviews = snapshot?.documents?.mapNotNull { it.toReviewOrNull() }.orEmpty()
                trySend(reviews)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override fun observeReviewsForItem(
        itemId: String,
        limit: Long
    ): Flow<List<Review>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
            .whereEqualTo("itemId", itemId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .limit(limit)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val reviews = snapshot?.documents?.mapNotNull { it.toReviewOrNull() }.orEmpty()
                trySend(reviews)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override suspend fun loadMoreReviews(
        itemId: String,
        lastDocId: String,
        limit: Long
    ): Result<Page<Review>> = runCatchingCancellable {
        var query = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
            .whereEqualTo("itemId", itemId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .limit(limit)

        if (lastDocId.isNotBlank()) {
            val lastDoc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(lastDocId)
                .get()
                .await()
            if (lastDoc.exists()) query = query.startAfter(lastDoc)
        }

        val docs = query.get().await().documents
        val reviews = docs.mapNotNull { it.toReviewOrNull() }
        Page(items = reviews, nextCursor = docs.lastOrNull()?.id)
    }

    override suspend fun getReview(userId: String, itemId: String): Review? =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val doc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewDocId(userId, itemId))
                .get()
                .await()
            if (!doc.exists()) null else doc.toReview(userId, itemId)
        }.getOrNull()

    override suspend fun saveReview(review: Review): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val reviewRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS).document(review.reviewId)
        val itemRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_ITEMS).document(review.itemId)

        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val existing = tx.get(reviewRef)
            val itemSnap = tx.get(itemRef)
            if (!itemSnap.exists()) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Айтем не найден")
            }

            val prevRating: Int? = if (existing.exists()) {
                existing.getLong("rating")?.toInt()
            } else null

            val createdAt = if (existing.exists())
                existing.getTimestamp("createdAt") ?: Timestamp.now()
            else Timestamp.now()

            val prevSum = itemSnap.getLong("ratingSum") ?: 0L
            val prevCount = itemSnap.getLong("ratingCount") ?: 0L

            val newSum: Long = if (prevRating == null) {
                prevSum + review.rating.toLong()
            } else {
                prevSum + (review.rating - prevRating).toLong()
            }
            val newCount: Long = if (prevRating == null) prevCount + 1L else prevCount
            val newAvg: Double = if (newCount <= 0L) 0.0 else newSum.toDouble() / newCount

            val data = mapOf(
                "userId" to review.userId,
                "itemId" to review.itemId,
                "rating" to review.rating,
                "comment" to review.comment,
                "authorName" to review.authorName,
                "authorAvatarBase64" to review.authorAvatarBase64,
                "itemName" to review.itemName,
                "itemSymbol" to review.itemSymbol,
                "itemIconKey" to review.itemIconKey,
                "createdAt" to createdAt,
                "updatedAt" to Timestamp.now()
            )
            tx.set(reviewRef, data, SetOptions.merge())
            tx.set(
                itemRef,
                mapOf(
                    "ratingSum" to newSum.coerceAtLeast(0L),
                    "ratingCount" to newCount.coerceAtLeast(0L),
                    "averageRating" to newAvg
                ),
                SetOptions.merge()
            )
        }.await()

        // Fan-out: только при создании (prevRating == null). При редактировании
        // не спамим ленты подписчиков.
        val wasNew = runCatching {
            firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(review.reviewId)
                .get()
                .await()
                .getLong("ratingCount") == null
        }.getOrDefault(true)
        if (wasNew) {
            feedWriter.fanOut(
                actorUid = review.userId,
                sourceId = review.reviewId,
                type = FeedItemType.FOLLOWING_REVIEW,
                payload = FeedWriter.FeedPayload(
                    actorName = review.authorName,
                    actorAvatarBase64 = review.authorAvatarBase64,
                    reviewId = review.reviewId,
                    reviewComment = review.comment,
                    itemName = review.itemName,
                    rating = review.rating
                )
            )
        }
        Unit
    }
    override fun observeReactionsForReview(
        reviewId: String
    ): Flow<List<ReviewRepository.ReactionEntry>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REACTIONS)
            .whereEqualTo("reviewId", reviewId)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val entries = snapshot?.documents?.mapNotNull { doc ->
                    val uid = doc.getString("userId") ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    val type = doc.getString("type")?.let {
                        runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
                    } ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    ReviewRepository.ReactionEntry(
                        userId = uid,
                        reaction = type,
                        createdAtMillis = doc.getTimestamp("createdAt")?.toDate()?.time ?: 0L
                    )
                }.orEmpty()
                trySend(entries)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }
    override suspend fun deleteReview(userId: String, itemId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val reviewRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewDocId(userId, itemId))
            val itemRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_ITEMS).document(itemId)

            firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
                val existing = tx.get(reviewRef)
                if (!existing.exists()) return@runTransaction

                val itemSnap = tx.get(itemRef)
                if (!itemSnap.exists()) {
                    tx.delete(reviewRef)
                    return@runTransaction
                }

                val prevRating: Int? = existing.getLong("rating")?.toInt()
                val prevSum = itemSnap.getLong("ratingSum") ?: 0L
                val prevCount = itemSnap.getLong("ratingCount") ?: 0L

                val newSum: Long
                val newCount: Long
                if (prevRating != null) {
                    newSum = (prevSum - prevRating.toLong()).coerceAtLeast(0L)
                    newCount = (prevCount - 1L).coerceAtLeast(0L)
                } else {
                    newSum = prevSum
                    newCount = prevCount
                }
                val newAvg = if (newCount <= 0L) 0.0 else newSum.toDouble() / newCount

                tx.delete(reviewRef)
                tx.set(
                    itemRef,
                    mapOf(
                        "ratingSum" to newSum,
                        "ratingCount" to newCount,
                        "averageRating" to newAvg
                    ),
                    SetOptions.merge()
                )
            }.await()
            Unit
        }

    // ── Реакции ──

    override fun observeMyReaction(reviewId: String, userId: String): Flow<Reaction?> =
        callbackFlow {
            val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REACTIONS)
                .document(reactionDocId(userId, reviewId))
                .addSnapshotListener { doc, error ->
                    if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                    if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                    val reaction = doc?.getString("type")?.let {
                        runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
                    }
                    trySend(reaction)
                }
            awaitClose { listener.remove() }
        }

    override suspend fun react(
        reviewId: String,
        userId: String,
        reaction: Reaction
    ): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val reviewRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS).document(reviewId)
        val reactionRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REACTIONS)
            .document(reactionDocId(userId, reviewId))

        var ownerUid: String? = null
        var previousReaction: Reaction? = null

        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val reviewSnap = tx.get(reviewRef)
            if (!reviewSnap.exists()) {
                throw IllegalStateException("Отзыв не найден")
            }
            ownerUid = reviewSnap.getString("userId")
            val reactionSnap = tx.get(reactionRef)
            previousReaction = reactionSnap.getString("type")?.let {
                runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
            }
            if (previousReaction == reaction) return@runTransaction

            var likes = reviewSnap.getLong("likes")?.toInt() ?: 0
            var dislikes = reviewSnap.getLong("dislikes")?.toInt() ?: 0

            when (previousReaction) {
                Reaction.LIKE -> likes = (likes - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
                Reaction.DISLIKE -> dislikes = (dislikes - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
                null -> Unit
            }
            when (reaction) {
                Reaction.LIKE -> likes += 1
                Reaction.DISLIKE -> dislikes += 1
            }

            tx.update(reviewRef, mapOf("likes" to likes, "dislikes" to dislikes))
            tx.set(
                reactionRef,
                mapOf(
                    "userId" to userId,
                    "reviewId" to reviewId,
                    "type" to reaction.name,
                    "createdAt" to Timestamp.now()
                )
            )
        }.await()

        val owner = ownerUid
        if (owner != null && owner != userId) {
            val review = runCatching { getReviewByDocId(reviewId) }.getOrNull()
            val actor = runCatching {
                firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS).document(userId).get().await()
            }.getOrNull()
            feedWriter.fanOut(
                actorUid = userId,
                sourceId = "${reactionDocId(userId, reviewId)}_${reaction.name}",
                type = FeedItemType.REVIEW_REACTION,
                payload = FeedWriter.FeedPayload(
                    actorName = actor?.getString("name").orEmpty(),
                    actorAvatarBase64 = actor?.getString("avatarBase64").orEmpty(),
                    reviewId = reviewId,
                    reviewComment = review?.comment.orEmpty(),
                    itemName = review?.itemName.orEmpty(),
                    reaction = reaction
                ),
                extraOwnerUid = owner
            )
        }
        Unit
    }

    override suspend fun removeReaction(reviewId: String, userId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val reviewRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS).document(reviewId)
            val reactionRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REACTIONS)
                .document(reactionDocId(userId, reviewId))

            firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
                val reactionSnap = tx.get(reactionRef)
                val previous = reactionSnap.getString("type")?.let {
                    runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
                } ?: return@runTransaction

                val reviewSnap = tx.get(reviewRef)
                if (!reviewSnap.exists()) return@runTransaction

                var likes = reviewSnap.getLong("likes")?.toInt() ?: 0
                var dislikes = reviewSnap.getLong("dislikes")?.toInt() ?: 0

                when (previous) {
                    Reaction.LIKE -> likes = (likes - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
                    Reaction.DISLIKE -> dislikes = (dislikes - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)
                }
                tx.update(reviewRef, mapOf("likes" to likes, "dislikes" to dislikes))
                tx.delete(reactionRef)
            }.await()
        }

    override fun observeMyReactionsForReviews(
        reviewIds: List<String>,
        userId: String
    ): Flow<Map<String, Reaction?>> = callbackFlow {
        if (reviewIds.isEmpty()) {
            trySend(emptyMap())
            close()
            return@callbackFlow
        }

        val chunks = reviewIds.chunked(REACTIONS_WHERE_IN_LIMIT)
        val listeners = mutableListOf<com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration>()
        val perChunk = ConcurrentHashMap<String, Map<String, Reaction?>>()

        fun emitMerged() {
            if (isClosedForSend) return
            val merged = HashMap<String, Reaction?>()
            perChunk.values.forEach { merged.putAll(it) }
            trySend(merged)
        }

        chunks.forEach { chunk ->
            val chunkKey = chunk.first()
            val reg = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REACTIONS)
                .whereEqualTo("userId", userId)
                .whereIn("reviewId", chunk)
                .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                    if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                    if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener

                    val chunkMap = HashMap<String, Reaction?>()
                    snapshot?.documents?.forEach { doc ->
                        val rid = doc.getString("reviewId") ?: return@forEach
                        chunkMap[rid] = doc.getString("type")?.let {
                            runCatching { Reaction.valueOf(it) }.getOrNull()
                        }
                    }
                    perChunk[chunkKey] = chunkMap
                    emitMerged()
                }
            listeners += reg
        }
        awaitClose { listeners.forEach { it.remove() } }
    }

    // ── Комментарии ──

    override suspend fun loadComments(reviewId: String): Result<List<ReviewComment>> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewId)
                .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
                .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.ASCENDING)
                .orderBy(FieldPath.documentId(), Query.Direction.ASCENDING)
                .limit(ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE)
                .get()
                .await()
            snapshot.documents.mapNotNull { it.toCommentOrNull() }
        }

    override suspend fun loadMoreComments(
        reviewId: String,
        lastCreatedAtMillis: Long,
        lastId: String
    ): Result<List<ReviewComment>> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val lastSnap = runCatching {
            firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewId)
                .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
                .document(lastId)
                .get()
                .await()
        }.getOrNull()

        val cursorTimestamp = lastSnap?.getTimestamp("createdAt")
            ?: Timestamp(
                lastCreatedAtMillis / 1000,
                ((lastCreatedAtMillis % 1000) * 1_000_000).toInt()
            )

        val snapshot = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
            .document(reviewId)
            .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .orderBy(FieldPath.documentId(), Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .startAfter(cursorTimestamp, lastId)
            .limit(ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE)
            .get()
            .await()
        snapshot.documents.mapNotNull { it.toCommentOrNull() }.reversed()
    }

    override fun observeComments(reviewId: String): Flow<List<ReviewComment>> = callbackFlow {
        val listener = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
            .document(reviewId)
            .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
            .orderBy("createdAt", Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .orderBy(FieldPath.documentId(), Query.Direction.DESCENDING)
            .limit(ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE + 1)
            .addSnapshotListener { snapshot, error ->
                if (error != null) { close(error); return@addSnapshotListener }
                if (isClosedForSend) return@addSnapshotListener
                val comments = snapshot?.documents?.mapNotNull { it.toCommentOrNull() }
                    .orEmpty()
                    .reversed()
                trySend(comments)
            }
        awaitClose { listener.remove() }
    }

    override suspend fun addComment(comment: ReviewComment): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val data = mapOf(
                "reviewId" to comment.reviewId,
                "authorId" to comment.authorId,
                "authorName" to comment.authorName,
                "authorAvatarBase64" to comment.authorAvatarBase64,
                "text" to comment.text,
                "createdAt" to Timestamp.now()
            )
            val ref = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(comment.reviewId)
                .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
                .add(data)
                .await()

            // Fan-out: комментарий уходит в ленту владельца отзыва.
            val review = runCatching { getReviewByDocId(comment.reviewId) }.getOrNull()
            val ownerUid = review?.userId
            if (!ownerUid.isNullOrBlank() && ownerUid != comment.authorId) {
                feedWriter.fanOut(
                    actorUid = comment.authorId.orEmpty(),
                    sourceId = ref.id,
                    type = FeedItemType.REVIEW_COMMENT,
                    payload = FeedWriter.FeedPayload(
                        actorName = comment.authorName,
                        actorAvatarBase64 = comment.authorAvatarBase64,
                        reviewId = comment.reviewId,
                        reviewComment = review?.comment.orEmpty(),
                        itemName = review?.itemName.orEmpty(),
                        commentText = comment.text
                    ),
                    extraOwnerUid = ownerUid
                )
            }
            Unit
        }

    override suspend fun deleteComment(reviewId: String, commentId: String): Result<Unit> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewId)
                .collection(COLLECTION_COMMENTS)
                .document(commentId)
                .delete()
                .await()
        }

    // ── Вспомогательное ──

    private suspend fun getReviewByDocId(reviewId: String): Review? =
        runCatching {
            val doc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_REVIEWS)
                .document(reviewId)
                .get()
                .await()
            if (!doc.exists()) null else doc.toReview(
                doc.getString("userId") ?: "",
                doc.getString("itemId") ?: ""
            )
        }.getOrNull()

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toReviewOrNull(): Review? = runCatching {
        toReview(getString("userId") ?: "", getString("itemId") ?: "")
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toReview(userId: String, itemId: String): Review = Review(
        userId = userId,
        itemId = itemId,
        rating = getLong("rating")?.toInt() ?: 0,
        comment = getString("comment") ?: "",
        likes = getLong("likes")?.toInt() ?: 0,
        dislikes = getLong("dislikes")?.toInt() ?: 0,
        authorName = getString("authorName") ?: "",
        authorAvatarBase64 = getString("authorAvatarBase64") ?: "",
        itemName = getString("itemName") ?: "",
        itemSymbol = getString("itemSymbol"),
        itemIconKey = getString("itemIconKey"),
        createdAtMillis = getTimestamp("createdAt")?.toDate()?.time ?: 0L
    )

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toCommentOrNull(): ReviewComment? = runCatching {
        ReviewComment(
            id = id,
            reviewId = getString("reviewId") ?: "",
            authorId = getString("authorId"),
            authorName = getString("authorName") ?: "",
            authorAvatarBase64 = getString("authorAvatarBase64") ?: "",
            text = getString("text") ?: "",
            createdAtMillis = getTimestamp("createdAt")?.toDate()?.time ?: 0L
        )
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun reviewDocId(userId: String, itemId: String): String = "$userId|$itemId"

    private fun reactionDocId(userId: String, reviewId: String): String = "$userId|$reviewId"

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION_REVIEWS = "reviews"
        const val COLLECTION_ITEMS = "items"
        const val COLLECTION_COMMENTS = "comments"
        const val COLLECTION_REACTIONS = "reactions"
        const val COLLECTION_USERS = "users"
        const val REVIEWS_PAGE_LIMIT = 50L
        const val REACTIONS_WHERE_IN_LIMIT = 30
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import ru.savushkina.core.data.di.ApplicationScope
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.SessionState
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class SessionRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    userRepository: UserRepository,
    @ApplicationScope appScope: CoroutineScope
) : SessionRepository {

    override val sessionState: StateFlow<SessionState> =
        combine(
            authRepository.authState,
            userRepository.currentUser,
            userRepository.profileLoading,
            userRepository.profileError
        ) { auth, user, loading, error ->
            when {
                auth == null -> SessionState.Unauthenticated
                user != null && user.onboardingCompleted -> SessionState.Authenticated(user)
                user != null -> SessionState.Onboarding(user.uid)
                loading -> SessionState.LoadingProfile
                error != null -> SessionState.ProfileLoadError(auth.uid)
                else -> SessionState.LoadingProfile
            }
        }.stateIn(
            scope = appScope,
            started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
            initialValue = SessionState.Unknown
        )

    override fun signOut() = authRepository.signOut()
}

package ru.savushkina.core.data

import android.util.LruCache
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
import com.google.firebase.firestore.DocumentSnapshot
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldPath
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FieldValue
import com.google.firebase.firestore.FirebaseFirestore
import com.google.firebase.firestore.SetOptions
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitAll
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.supervisorScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.data.di.ApplicationScope
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Role
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Singleton
class UserRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val firestore: FirebaseFirestore,
    private val auth: FirebaseAuth,
    authRepository: AuthRepository,
    @ApplicationScope private val appScope: CoroutineScope
) : UserRepository {

    private val _currentUser = MutableStateFlow<User?>(null)
    override val currentUser: StateFlow<User?> = _currentUser.asStateFlow()

    private val _profileLoading = MutableStateFlow(false)
    override val profileLoading: StateFlow<Boolean> = _profileLoading.asStateFlow()

    private val _profileError = MutableStateFlow<Throwable?>(null)
    override val profileError: StateFlow<Throwable?> = _profileError.asStateFlow()

    private data class CachedUser(val user: User, val fetchedAt: Long)

    private val userCache = object : LruCache<String, CachedUser>(CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES) {}

    private fun cacheGet(uid: String): User? {
        val entry = userCache.get(uid) ?: return null
        if (System.currentTimeMillis() - entry.fetchedAt > CACHE_TTL_MS) {
            userCache.remove(uid)
            return null
        }
        return entry.user
    }

    private fun cachePut(uid: String, user: User) {
        userCache.put(uid, CachedUser(user, System.currentTimeMillis()))
    }

    private fun cacheInvalidate(uid: String) {
        userCache.remove(uid)
    }

    init {
        appScope.launch {
            authRepository.authState.collect { authUser ->
                if (authUser == null) {
                    _currentUser.value = null
                    _profileError.value = null
                    _profileLoading.value = false
                } else {
                    refreshInternal(authUser.uid, authUser.email.orEmpty())
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun refreshInternal(uid: String, email: String) {
        _profileLoading.value = true
        _profileError.value = null
        try {
            runCatchingCancellable {
                val user = getOrCreate(uid, email)
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("Профиль не найден")
                _currentUser.value = user
                cachePut(uid, user)
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _profileError.value = e
            }
        } finally {
            _profileLoading.value = false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun refresh(uid: String): Result<User> = runCatchingCancellable {
        _profileLoading.value = true
        _profileError.value = null
        try {
            cacheInvalidate(uid)
            val email = auth.currentUser?.email.orEmpty()
            val user = getOrCreate(uid, email)
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Профиль не найден")
            _currentUser.value = user
            cachePut(uid, user)
            user
        } finally {
            _profileLoading.value = false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getUser(uid: String): User? {
        cacheGet(uid)?.let { return it }
        return runCatchingCancellable {
            val doc = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS).document(uid).get().await()
            if (!doc.exists()) null else doc.toUser(uid).also { cachePut(uid, it) }
        }.getOrNull()
    }

    override suspend fun getUsersByIds(ids: List<String>): List<User> {
        val distinctIds = ids.distinct().filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        if (distinctIds.isEmpty()) return emptyList()

        val result = mutableMapOf<String, User>()
        val missing = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (uid in distinctIds) {
            val cached = cacheGet(uid)
            if (cached != null) result[uid] = cached else missing.add(uid)
        }
        if (missing.isEmpty()) return distinctIds.mapNotNull { result[it] }

        runCatchingCancellable {
            supervisorScope {
                missing.chunked(FIRESTORE_IN_LIMIT).map { chunk ->
                    async {
                        runCatchingCancellable {
                            firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS)
                                .whereIn(FieldPath.documentId(), chunk)
                                .get()
                                .await()
                                .documents
                                .mapNotNull { doc ->
                                    doc.toUser(doc.id).also { cachePut(doc.id, it) }
                                }
                        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                    }
                }.awaitAll().flatten().forEach { result[it.uid] = it }
            }
        }
        return distinctIds.mapNotNull { result[it] }
    }

    override suspend fun getUserByUsername(username: String): User? =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val clean = username.trim().lowercase().removePrefix("@")
            if (clean.isBlank()) return@runCatchingCancellable null
            val snap = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS)
                .whereEqualTo(FIELD_USERNAME, clean)
                .limit(1)
                .get()
                .await()
            snap.documents.firstOrNull()?.let { doc ->
                doc.toUser(doc.id).also { cachePut(doc.id, it) }
            }
        }.getOrNull()

    override suspend fun searchUsersByUsernamePrefix(
        prefix: String,
        limit: Long
    ): List<User> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val clean = prefix.trim().lowercase().removePrefix("@")
        if (clean.isBlank()) return@runCatchingCancellable emptyList()
        val snap = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS)
            .orderBy(FIELD_USERNAME)
            .startAt(clean)
            .endAt(clean + "\uf8ff")
            .limit(limit)
            .get()
            .await()
        snap.documents.mapNotNull { doc ->
            doc.toUser(doc.id).also { cachePut(doc.id, it) }
        }
    }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    override suspend fun isUsernameAvailable(username: String): Result<Boolean> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val clean = username.trim().lowercase().removePrefix("@")
            val snap = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS)
                .whereEqualTo(FIELD_USERNAME, clean)
                .limit(1)
                .get()
                .await()
            snap.isEmpty
        }

    private suspend fun getOrCreate(uid: String, email: String): User? {
        val docRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS).document(uid)
        return firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val snap = tx.get(docRef)
            if (snap.exists()) {
                snap.toUser(uid)
            } else {
                val resolvedEmail = email.ifBlank { auth.currentUser?.email.orEmpty() }
                val data = mapOf(
                    FIELD_EMAIL to resolvedEmail,
                    FIELD_NAME to "",
                    FIELD_USERNAME to "",
                    FIELD_DESCRIPTION to "",
                    FIELD_AVATAR_BASE64 to "",
                    FIELD_ONBOARDING_COMPLETED to false
                )
                tx.set(docRef, data)
                User(uid = uid, email = resolvedEmail, name = "", onboardingCompleted = false)
            }
        }.await()
    }

    override suspend fun ensureUserExists(uid: String, email: String): Result<User> =
        runCatchingCancellable {
            val user = getOrCreate(uid, email)
                ?: throw IllegalStateException("Не удалось создать профиль")
            _currentUser.value = user
            cachePut(uid, user)
            user
        }

    override suspend fun saveOnboarding(
        uid: String,
        email: String,
        name: String,
        username: String,
        role: Role
    ): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val cleanUsername = username.trim().lowercase().removePrefix("@")
        require(cleanUsername.isNotBlank()) { "Username не может быть пустым" }

        val usernameRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERNAMES)
            .document(cleanUsername)
        firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
            val existing = tx.get(usernameRef)
            if (existing.exists()) {
                val owner = existing.getString("uid")
                if (owner != uid) {
                    throw IllegalStateException("Этот username уже занят")
                }
            } else {
                tx.set(
                    usernameRef,
                    mapOf(
                        "uid" to uid,
                        "createdAt" to com.google.firebase.Timestamp.now()
                    )
                )
            }
        }.await()

        val data = mapOf(
            FIELD_EMAIL to email,
            FIELD_NAME to name,
            FIELD_USERNAME to cleanUsername,
            FIELD_ROLE to role.name,
            FIELD_ONBOARDING_COMPLETED to true
        )
        firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS)
            .document(uid)
            .set(data, SetOptions.merge())
            .await()

        val updated = _currentUser.value?.copy(
            email = email,
            name = name,
            username = cleanUsername,
            role = role,
            onboardingCompleted = true
        ) ?: User(
            uid = uid, email = email, name = name, username = cleanUsername,
            role = role, onboardingCompleted = true
        )
        _currentUser.value = updated
        cachePut(uid, updated)
    }

    /**
     * Сохраняет профиль. Если [username] передан и отличается от текущего —
     * атомарно освобождает старый username и занимает новый в коллекции
     * `usernames`, обновляет `users/{uid}.username`.
     */
    override suspend fun saveProfile(
        uid: String,
        name: String,
        username: String?,
        description: String,
        avatarBase64: String,
        role: Role?
    ): Result<Unit> = runCatchingCancellable {
        val current = _currentUser.value
        val oldUsername = current?.username?.lowercase().orEmpty()
        val cleanNewUsername = username?.trim()?.lowercase()?.removePrefix("@")

        val userRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERS).document(uid)

        if (cleanNewUsername != null &&
            cleanNewUsername.isNotBlank() &&
            cleanNewUsername != oldUsername
        ) {
            // Смена username — атомарно.
            val newUsernameRef = firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERNAMES)
                .document(cleanNewUsername)
            val oldUsernameRef = if (oldUsername.isNotBlank())
                firestore.collection(COLLECTION_USERNAMES).document(oldUsername)
            else null

            firestore.runTransaction { tx ->
                val newSnap = tx.get(newUsernameRef)
                if (newSnap.exists()) {
                    val owner = newSnap.getString("uid")
                    if (owner != uid) {
                        throw IllegalStateException("Этот username уже занят")
                    }
                }
                if (oldUsernameRef != null) {
                    tx.delete(oldUsernameRef)
                }
                tx.set(
                    newUsernameRef,
                    mapOf(
                        "uid" to uid,
                        "createdAt" to com.google.firebase.Timestamp.now()
                    )
                )
            }.await()
        }

        val data = buildMap<String, Any> {
            put(FIELD_NAME, name)
            put(FIELD_DESCRIPTION, description)
            put(FIELD_AVATAR_BASE64, avatarBase64)
            if (cleanNewUsername != null) {
                put(FIELD_USERNAME, cleanNewUsername)
            }
            if (role != null) {
                put(FIELD_ROLE, role.name)
            } else {
                put(FIELD_ROLE, FieldValue.delete())
            }
        }
        userRef.set(data, SetOptions.merge()).await()

        val updated = _currentUser.value?.copy(
            name = name,
            description = description,
            avatarBase64 = avatarBase64,
            role = role,
            username = cleanNewUsername ?: _currentUser.value?.username ?: ""
        )
        _currentUser.value = updated
        if (updated != null) cachePut(uid, updated)
    }

    private fun DocumentSnapshot.toUser(uid: String): User = User(
        uid = uid,
        email = getString(FIELD_EMAIL) ?: "",
        name = getString(FIELD_NAME) ?: "",
        username = getString(FIELD_USERNAME) ?: "",
        description = getString(FIELD_DESCRIPTION) ?: "",
        avatarBase64 = getString(FIELD_AVATAR_BASE64) ?: "",
        role = Role.fromKey(getString(FIELD_ROLE)),
        onboardingCompleted = getBoolean(FIELD_ONBOARDING_COMPLETED) ?: false
    )

    private companion object {
        const val COLLECTION_USERS = "users"
        const val COLLECTION_USERNAMES = "usernames"
        const val FIELD_EMAIL = "email"
        const val FIELD_NAME = "name"
        const val FIELD_USERNAME = "username"
        const val FIELD_DESCRIPTION = "description"
        const val FIELD_AVATAR_BASE64 = "avatarBase64"
        const val FIELD_ROLE = "role"
        const val FIELD_ONBOARDING_COMPLETED = "onboardingCompleted"

        const val FIRESTORE_IN_LIMIT = 30
        const val CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES = 500
        const val CACHE_TTL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000L
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.animation.core.RepeatMode
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloat
import androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.alpha
import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.CodeboxTheme

@Composable
fun BlinkingCursor(modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "cursor")
    val alpha by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 1f,
        targetValue = 0f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(600),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "cursor_alpha"
    )

    Text(
        text = "█",
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
        style = MaterialTheme.typography.displayMedium,
        modifier = modifier.alpha(alpha)
    )
}
