@Composable
fun FavouriteFourSection(
    favourites: List<Item>,
    isOwnProfile: Boolean,
    onSlotClick: (Int) -> Unit,
    onRemoveFavourite: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    Column(modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        LabelText(text = "// любимая четвёрка")
        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))

        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
        ) {
            for (index in 0 until 4) {
                val item = favourites.getOrNull(index)

                FavouriteSlot(
                    item = item,
                    isOwnProfile = isOwnProfile,
                    onClick = { if (item == null) onSlotClick(index) },
                    onRemove = { item?.let { onRemoveFavourite(it.id) } },
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FavouriteSlot(
    item: Item?,
    isOwnProfile: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    onRemove: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    WireFrame(
        modifier = modifier
            .height(90.dp)
            .clickable(
                enabled = isOwnProfile && item == null,
                onClick = onClick
            ),
        accent = item != null
    ) {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            if (item == null) {
                if (isOwnProfile) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Outlined.Add,
                        contentDescription = "Добавить",
                        tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.Center)
                            .size(28.dp)
                    )
                } else {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "—",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center)
                    )
                }
            } else {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxSize()
                        .padding(Spacing.xs),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.Center
                ) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier.size(28.dp),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        val symbol = item.symbol
                        val iconKey = item.iconKey
                        when {
                            !symbol.isNullOrBlank() -> Text(
                                text = symbol,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                fontSize = 14.sp
                            )
                            !iconKey.isNullOrBlank() -> IconKey(
                                iconKey = iconKey,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(20.dp)
                            )
                            else -> Text(
                                text = item.fallbackText,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                fontSize = 14.sp
                            )
                        }
                    }

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))

                    Text(
                        text = item.name,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
                        textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                        maxLines = 2,
                        overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                        fontSize = 10.sp
                    )
                }

                if (isOwnProfile) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .align(Alignment.TopEnd)
                            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                            .clickable(onClick = onRemove),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center

                            contentDescription = "Убрать из избранного",
                            tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            modifier = Modifier.size(14.dp)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.Canvas
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

@Composable
fun HorizontalLine(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    accent: Boolean = false
) {
    val color = if (accent) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline

    val strokeDp = if (accent) 3.dp else 1.5.dp

    Canvas(modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(2.dp)) {
        drawLine(
            color = color,
            start = Offset(0f, size.height / 2),
            end = Offset(size.width, size.height / 2),
            strokeWidth = strokeDp.toPx()
        )
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.*
import androidx.compose.material3.Icon
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp

@Composable
fun IconKey(iconKey: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Icon(
        imageVector = iconKey.toIcon(),
        contentDescription = null,
        tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
        modifier = modifier.size(22.dp)
    )
}

private fun String.toIcon(): ImageVector = when (this) {
    "code" -> Icons.Outlined.Code
    "terminal" -> Icons.Outlined.Terminal
    "bug" -> Icons.Outlined.BugReport
    "cloud" -> Icons.Outlined.Cloud
    "storage" -> Icons.Outlined.Storage
    "palette" -> Icons.Outlined.Palette
    "phone" -> Icons.Outlined.PhoneAndroid
    "security" -> Icons.Outlined.Security
    "chart" -> Icons.Outlined.BarChart
    "robot" -> Icons.Outlined.SmartToy
    "game" -> Icons.Outlined.VideogameAsset
    "build" -> Icons.Outlined.Build
    "web" -> Icons.Outlined.Web
    "dataset" -> Icons.Outlined.Dataset
    "settings" -> Icons.Outlined.Settings
    else -> Icons.Outlined.Code
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Sizes
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Spacing
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item

@Composable
fun ItemRow(
    item: Item,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    WireFrame(modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable(onClick = onClick)
                .padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            WireFrame(
                modifier = Modifier.size(Sizes.iconFrame),
                cornerBrackets = false
            ) {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.size(Sizes.iconFrame),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    val symbol = item.symbol
                    val iconKey = item.iconKey
                    when {
                        !symbol.isNullOrBlank() -> Text(
                            text = symbol,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium
                        )
                        !iconKey.isNullOrBlank() -> IconKey(iconKey = iconKey)
                        else -> Text(
                            text = item.fallbackText,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.md))

            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = item.name,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                )
                if (item.type.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                    LabelText(text = item.type)
                }
            }

            if (item.averageRating > 0) {
                Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.sm))
                Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    Text(
                        text = "★",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,

                    Text(
                        text = "%.1f".format(item.averageRating),
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

@Composable
fun RatingStars(
    rating: Int,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    onRatingChange: ((Int) -> Unit)? = null,
    size: Int = 24
) {
    Row(modifier = modifier) {
        (1..ItemConstraints.RATING_MAX).forEach { star ->
            val filled = star <= rating
            val starModifier = if (onRatingChange != null) {
                Modifier
                    .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
                    .clickable { onRatingChange(star) }
            } else Modifier

            Box(
                modifier = starModifier,
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Text(
                    text = if (filled) "★" else "☆",
                    color = if (filled) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant,
                    fontSize = size.sp
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloat

import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer

/**
 * Базовый skeleton-блок с пульсацией.
 *
 * ВАЖНО: всегда fillMaxWidth, а `width` — это ограничение СВЕРХУ
 * (widthIn(max = width)), а не фиксированная ширина.
 */
@Composable
fun Skeleton(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    width: Dp? = null,
    height: Dp = 16.dp,
    cornerRadius: Dp = 4.dp
) {
    val transition = rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "skeleton")
    val alpha by transition.animateFloat(
        initialValue = 0.4f,
        targetValue = 1f,
        animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(
            animation = tween(900),
            repeatMode = RepeatMode.Reverse
        ),
        label = "skeleton_alpha"
    )

    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(if (width != null) Modifier.widthIn(max = width) else Modifier)
            .height(height)
            .clip(RoundedCornerShape(cornerRadius))
            .alpha(alpha)
            .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant)
    )
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.util.Base64
import android.util.LruCache
import androidx.compose.foundation.Image
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.asImageBitmap
import androidx.compose.ui.layout.ContentScale
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.sp

private const val AVATAR_TARGET_PX = 256

/**
 * Кэш декодированных аватаров.
 *
 * ВАЖНО: Bitmap в кэше НЕ вызывают recycle().
 *
 * Причина: ImageBitmap, полученный через Bitmap.asImageBitmap(), НЕ копирует
 * пиксели — он оборачивает тот же android.graphics.Bitmap. Если вызвать
 * bitmap.recycle(), ImageBitmap станет невалидным, и при следующей отрисовке
 * Canvas.drawBitmap() бросит "trying to use a recycled bitmap".
 *
 * Освобождение нативной памяти при вытеснении из LruCache происходит
 * через GC: Bitmap становится недостижим, GC финализирует его, а
 * NativeAllocationRegistry (API 26+) освобождает нативные пиксели.
 * Для аватаров 256x256 (~256 КБ) при лимите кэша ~1/8 maxMemory это
 * безопасно и не приводит к OOM.
 *
 * Если когда-нибудь понадобится детерминированное освобождение — перейти
 * на Coil (AsyncImage), который сам управляет жизненным циклом Bitmap.
 */
private val avatarCache: LruCache<String, Bitmap> by lazy {
    val maxKb = (Runtime.getRuntime().maxMemory() / 1024 / 8).toInt()
    object : LruCache<String, Bitmap>(maxKb) {
        override fun sizeOf(key: String, value: Bitmap): Int = value.byteCount / 1024
        // entryRemoved НЕ переопределяем: recycle() здесь приведёт к крашу,
        // если ImageBitmap, оборачивающий этот Bitmap, ещё используется в UI.
    }
}

@Composable
fun WireAvatar(
    avatarBase64: String,
    fallbackText: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    size: Dp = 100.dp
) {
    val bitmap: Bitmap? = remember(avatarBase64) {
        if (avatarBase64.isBlank()) {
            null
        } else {
            avatarCache.get(avatarBase64) ?: decodeBase64(avatarBase64)?.also {
                avatarCache.put(avatarBase64, it)
            }
        }
    }

    WireFrame(
        modifier = modifier.size(size),
        accent = true
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxSize()
                .padding(6.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            // isRecycled — защита от случая, если Bitmap всё же оказался
            // recycled (например, сторонним кодом). Тогда показываем fallback.
            if (bitmap != null && !bitmap.isRecycled) {
                Image(
                    bitmap = bitmap.asImageBitmap(),
                    contentDescription = null,
                    contentScale = ContentScale.Crop,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                )
            } else {
                AvatarFallback(fallbackText, size)
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun decodeBase64(base64: String): Bitmap? = runCatching {
    val bytes = Base64.decode(base64, Base64.DEFAULT)

    val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }
    BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, bounds)

    val sample = calculateInSampleSize(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight, AVATAR_TARGET_PX)

    val opts = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inSampleSize = sample }
    BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, opts)
}.getOrNull()

private fun calculateInSampleSize(width: Int, height: Int, target: Int): Int {
    var sample = 1
    var w = width
    var h = height
    while (w / 2 >= target && h / 2 >= target) {
        w /= 2
        h /= 2
        sample *= 2
    }
    return sample
}

/**
 * Размер шрифта fallback-буквы зависит от размера аватара,
 * иначе для 28.dp аватара буква 28.sp выглядит огромной и вылезает.
 */
private fun fallbackFontSize(avatarSize: Dp): Int = when {
    avatarSize.value < 36f -> 12
    avatarSize.value < 56f -> 16
    avatarSize.value < 80f -> 22
    avatarSize.value < 100f -> 28
    else -> 36
}

@Composable
private fun AvatarFallback(text: String, avatarSize: Dp) {
    Text(
        text = text.take(2).uppercase(),
        fontSize = fallbackFontSize(avatarSize).sp,
        fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    )
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.minimumInteractiveComponentSize

import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.CodeboxTheme

@Composable
fun WireButton(
    text: String,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    accent: Boolean = false,
    enabled: Boolean = true
) {
    val textColor = when {
        !enabled -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant
        accent -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
        else -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
    }

    WireFrame(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .clickable(enabled = enabled, onClick = onClick),
        accent = accent && enabled,
        cornerBrackets = false
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(vertical = 12.dp),
            contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
        ) {
            LabelText(text = text, color = textColor)
        }
    }
}

@Preview(showBackground = true, backgroundColor = 0xFF000000)
@Composable
private fun WireButtonPreview() {
    CodeboxTheme {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                .padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)
        ) {
            WireButton(text = "sign_in()", onClick = {}, accent = true)
            WireButton(text = "sign_up()", onClick = {})
            WireButton(text = "disabled()", onClick = {}, enabled = false)
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.BoxScope
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithCache
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.PathEffect
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.Stroke
import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.CodeboxTheme
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Sizes

@Composable
fun WireFrame(
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    accent: Boolean = false,
    cornerBrackets: Boolean = true,
    content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit = {}
) {
    val baseColor: Color = if (accent)
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    else
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant

    val cornerColor: Color = if (accent)
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    else
        MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outline

    Box(
        modifier = modifier.drawWithCache {
            val w = size.width
            val h = size.height
            val frameStroke = Sizes.frameStroke.toPx()
            val accentStroke = Sizes.accentStroke.toPx()
            val c = Sizes.cornerLength.toPx()
            val stroke = Stroke(width = frameStroke)

            onDrawBehind {
                drawRect(
                    color = baseColor,
                    topLeft = Offset.Zero,
                    size = size,
                    style = stroke
                )
                if (cornerBrackets) {
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(0f, 0f), Offset(c, 0f), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(0f, 0f), Offset(0f, c), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(w - c, 0f), Offset(w, 0f), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(w, 0f), Offset(w, c), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(0f, h - c), Offset(0f, h), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(0f, h), Offset(c, h), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(w - c, h), Offset(w, h), accentStroke)
                    drawLine(cornerColor, Offset(w, h - c), Offset(w, h), accentStroke)
                }
            }
        },
        content = content
    )
}

@Preview(showBackground = true, backgroundColor = 0xFF000000)
@Composable
private fun WireFramePreview() {
    CodeboxTheme {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp)) {
            WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.size(200.dp, 100.dp)) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    LabelText(text = "panel")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxHeight
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.heightIn
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.width
import androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.SolidColor
import androidx.compose.ui.text.input.VisualTransformation
import androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.CodeboxTheme
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Sizes
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Spacing

@Composable
fun WireTextField(
    value: String,
    onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    placeholder: String = "",
    label: String? = null,
    singleLine: Boolean = true,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    visualTransformation: VisualTransformation = VisualTransformation.None,
    trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
    minHeight: Dp = Sizes.inputHeight
) {
    val accent = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
    val textColor = if (enabled) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant

    Box(modifier = modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        WireFrame(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .heightIn(min = minHeight),
            accent = enabled && value.isNotEmpty()
        ) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .heightIn(min = minHeight),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                // Текстовое поле — занимает всё свободное место,
                // отступы одинаковые сверху и снизу
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .weight(1f)
                        .padding(
                            start = Spacing.md,
                            end = Spacing.sm,
                            top = Spacing.lg,
                            bottom = Spacing.sm
                        ),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.CenterStart
                ) {
                    if (value.isEmpty() && placeholder.isNotEmpty()) {
                        LabelText(text = placeholder)
                    }
                    BasicTextField(
                        value = value,
                        onValueChange = onValueChange,
                        enabled = enabled,
                        singleLine = singleLine,
                        textStyle = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge.copy(color = textColor),
                        cursorBrush = SolidColor(accent),
                        visualTransformation = visualTransformation,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }

                if (trailingIcon != null) {
                    Box(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .width(Sizes.iconFrame)
                            .fillMaxHeight(),
                        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                    ) {
                        trailingIcon()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (label != null) {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .padding(start = Spacing.md, top = Spacing.xs),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.TopStart
            ) {
                LabelText(text = label, color = accent)
            }
        }
    }
}

@Preview(showBackground = true, backgroundColor = 0xFF000000)
@Composable
private fun WireTextFieldPreview() {
    CodeboxTheme {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)
                .padding(16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)
        ) {
            WireTextField(
                value = "",
                onValueChange = {},
                label = "email",
                placeholder = "dev@codebox.app"
            )
            WireTextField(
                value = "alena@codebox.app",
                onValueChange = {},
                label = "email"
            )
            WireTextField(
                value = "Пишу на Kotlin, люблю Compose и корутины.\n" +
                        "В свободное время читаю исходники библиотек.",
                onValueChange = {},
                label = "about",
                singleLine = false,
                minHeight = 100.dp
            )
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.pattern

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.size
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.systemBarsPadding
import androidx.compose.material.icons.Icons
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.FavoriteBorder
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.Home
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.Person
import androidx.compose.material.icons.outlined.Search
import androidx.compose.material3.Icon
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.minimumInteractiveComponentSize
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.vector.ImageVector
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.HorizontalLine
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Sizes

enum class BottomTab(val route: String) {
    FEED("feed"),
    SEARCH("search"),
    ACTIVITY("activity"),
    PROFILE("profile")
}

@Composable
fun TerminalBottomBar(
    selectedTab: BottomTab?,
    onFeedClick: () -> Unit,
    onSearchClick: () -> Unit,
    onActivityClick: () -> Unit,
    onProfileClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Column(modifier = Modifier.systemBarsPadding()) {
        HorizontalLine()
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .height(Sizes.bottomBarHeight)
                .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            BottomBarItem(Icons.Outlined.Home, "feed",
                selectedTab == BottomTab.FEED, onFeedClick)
            BottomBarItem(Icons.Outlined.Search, "search",
                selectedTab == BottomTab.SEARCH, onSearchClick)
            BottomBarItem(Icons.Outlined.FavoriteBorder, "activity",
                selectedTab == BottomTab.ACTIVITY, onActivityClick)
            BottomBarItem(Icons.Outlined.Person, "profile",
                selectedTab == BottomTab.PROFILE, onProfileClick)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BottomBarItem(
    icon: ImageVector,
    label: String,
    selected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .minimumInteractiveComponentSize()
            .clickable(onClick = onClick),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
    ) {
        Icon(
            imageVector = icon,
            contentDescription = label,
            tint = if (selected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            modifier = Modifier.size(Sizes.iconMd)
        )
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.pattern

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.LabelText
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Spacing

@Composable
fun TerminalTopBar(
    title: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    left: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
    right: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null
) {
    Box(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = Spacing.sm)
    ) {
        // Left
        if (left != null) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterStart),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                left()
            }
        }

        // Center (по абсолютному центру)
        LabelText(
            text = title,
            modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.Center)
        )

        // Right
        if (right != null) {
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterEnd),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.End,
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
            ) {
                right()
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme

import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.CompositionLocalProvider
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.util.LocalTextCaseStyle
import ru.savushkina.core.model.TextCaseStyle

@Composable
fun CodeboxTheme(
    textCaseStyle: TextCaseStyle = TextCaseStyle.NORMAL,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    CompositionLocalProvider(LocalTextCaseStyle provides textCaseStyle) {
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme = CodeboxColorScheme,
            typography = CodeboxTypography,
            shapes = CodeboxShapes,
            content = content
        )
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme

import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

// ─── Базовая монохромная палитра ─────────────────────────────────
// Строго по шкале яркости, без цветовых примесей.

val Black = Color(0xFF000000)
val Gray05 = Color(0xFF0A0A0A)   // почти чёрный (фон поверхностей)
val Gray10 = Color(0xFF111111)
val Gray15 = Color(0xFF1A1A1A)   // карточки
val Gray20 = Color(0xFF222222)
val Gray30 = Color(0xFF2E2E2E)
val Gray40 = Color(0xFF3D3D3D)
val Gray50 = Color(0xFF555555)   // разделители
val Gray60 = Color(0xFF666666)
val Gray70 = Color(0xFF777777)   // неактивный текст
val Gray80 = Color(0xFF999999)   // второстепенный текст
val Gray90 = Color(0xFFCCCCCC)
val Gray95 = Color(0xFFE5E5E5)
val White = Color(0xFFFFFFFF)

// ─── Зелёный акцент ──────────────────────────────────────────────
// Три оттенка — на все случаи. Больше не нужно.

val GreenPrimary = Color(0xFF39FF14) // основной неон (кнопки, активные элементы)
val GreenMuted = Color(0xFF1F8C1F)   // приглушённый (вторичный акцент, иконки)
val GreenDim = Color(0xFF0F3D0F)     // очень тёмный (фон под акцентом)

// Полупрозрачные — для «свечения» и деликатных рамок.
val GreenPrimary12 = GreenPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.12f)
val GreenPrimary24 = GreenPrimary.copy(alpha = 0.24f)

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme

import androidx.compose.material3.darkColorScheme

val CodeboxColorScheme = darkColorScheme(
    // ── Основной акцент ──
    primary = GreenPrimary,
    onPrimary = Black,
    primaryContainer = GreenDim,
    onPrimaryContainer = GreenPrimary,

    // ── Вторичный — приглушённый зелёный ──
    secondary = GreenMuted,
    onSecondary = Black,
    secondaryContainer = GreenDim,
    onSecondaryContainer = GreenPrimary,

    // ── Третичный — белый (для «чистых» акцентов) ──
    tertiary = White,
    onTertiary = Black,

    // ── Фон ──
    background = Black,
    onBackground = Gray95,

    // ── Поверхности ──
    surface = Gray05,
    onSurface = Gray95,
    surfaceVariant = Gray15,
    onSurfaceVariant = Gray80,
    surfaceContainer = Gray10,
    surfaceContainerHigh = Gray15,
    surfaceContainerHighest = Gray20,

    // ── Границы ──
    outline = GreenMuted,
    outlineVariant = Gray40,

    // ── Ошибка — приглушённый зелёный ──
    // (семантически остаётся, но визуально не выбивается из палитры)
    error = GreenMuted,
    onError = Black,
    errorContainer = GreenDim,
    onErrorContainer = GreenPrimary,

    // ── Служебные ──
    scrim = Black.copy(alpha = 0.8f),
    inverseSurface = Gray95,
    inverseOnSurface = Black,
    inversePrimary = GreenDim
)

import androidx.compose.material3.Typography
import androidx.compose.ui.text.TextStyle
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.Font
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontFamily
import androidx.compose.ui.text.font.FontWeight

import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.R

val JetBrainsMono = FontFamily(
    Font(R.font.jetbrains_mono_regular, FontWeight.Normal),
    Font(R.font.jetbrains_mono_medium, FontWeight.Medium),
    Font(R.font.jetbrains_mono_bold, FontWeight.Bold)
)

// Базовые стили для терминального UI
private val monoRegular = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = JetBrainsMono,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Normal
)
private val monoMedium = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = JetBrainsMono,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Medium
)
private val monoBold = TextStyle(
    fontFamily = JetBrainsMono,
    fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold
)

val CodeboxTypography = Typography(
    // ── Крупные табло (24°C, 236,780,340, 12:01) ──
    displayLarge = monoBold.copy(
        fontSize = 48.sp, lineHeight = 52.sp, letterSpacing = (-1).sp
    ),
    displayMedium = monoBold.copy(
        fontSize = 36.sp, lineHeight = 40.sp, letterSpacing = (-0.5).sp
    ),
    displaySmall = monoBold.copy(
        fontSize = 28.sp, lineHeight = 32.sp
    ),

    // ── Заголовки панелей (CAPS, широкий трекинг) ──
    headlineLarge = monoMedium.copy(
        fontSize = 18.sp, lineHeight = 24.sp, letterSpacing = 1.5.sp
    ),
    headlineMedium = monoMedium.copy(
        fontSize = 16.sp, lineHeight = 22.sp, letterSpacing = 1.5.sp

    ),
    titleSmall = monoMedium.copy(
        fontSize = 11.sp, lineHeight = 16.sp, letterSpacing = 1.sp
    ),

    // ── Тело текста ──
    bodyLarge = monoRegular.copy(fontSize = 14.sp, lineHeight = 20.sp),
    bodyMedium = monoRegular.copy(fontSize = 12.sp, lineHeight = 18.sp),
    bodySmall = monoRegular.copy(fontSize = 11.sp, lineHeight = 16.sp),

    // ── Метки (LABEL, MIN, MAX, HUMIDITY) ──
    labelLarge = monoMedium.copy(
        fontSize = 11.sp, lineHeight = 14.sp, letterSpacing = 2.sp
    ),
    labelMedium = monoRegular.copy(

    ),

        fontSize = 9.sp, lineHeight = 12.sp, letterSpacing = 2.5.sp

FILE [71/192]: core/designsystem/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/core/designsystem/util/TextCase.kt

package ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.util

import androidx.compose.runtime.staticCompositionLocalOf
import ru.savushkina.core.model.TextCaseStyle

val LocalTextCaseStyle = staticCompositionLocalOf { TextCaseStyle.NORMAL }

private val BRACKET_REGEX = Regex("^(\\[\\s*)(.*?)(\\s*])$")
private const val COMMENT_PREFIX = "// "

fun String.toDisplayCase(style: TextCaseStyle): String {
    if (style == TextCaseStyle.NORMAL) return this

    if (startsWith(COMMENT_PREFIX)) {
        val body = removePrefix(COMMENT_PREFIX)
        return COMMENT_PREFIX + body.transform(style)
    }

    val bracket = BRACKET_REGEX.find(this)
    if (bracket != null) {
        val (open, content, close) = bracket.destructured
        return open + content.transform(style) + close
    }

    return transform(style)
}

private fun String.transform(style: TextCaseStyle): String = when (style) {
    TextCaseStyle.CAMEL_CASE -> lowercase()
        .split(" ", "_", "-")
        .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
        .mapIndexed { i, w -> if (i == 0) w else w.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() } }
        .joinToString("")

    TextCaseStyle.SNAKE_CASE -> lowercase()
        .replace(" ", "_")
        .replace("-", "_")

    TextCaseStyle.NORMAL -> this
}

FILE [80/192]: core/domain/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/core/domain/FeedWriter.kt
==============================================================================
package ru.savushkina.core.domain

import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType

/**
 * Порт для записи событий в ленты подписчиков.
 *
 * Вызывается из репозиториев при создании отзыва / комментария / реакции /
 * подписки. Реализация пишет батчем в `feeds/{ownerUid}/items`.
 *
 * ВАЖНО: в production для аккаунтов с >500 подписчиков fan-out должен идти
 * через Cloud Function (Firestore Triggers), а не из клиента — иначе
 * клиент упрётся в лимит 500 операций на батч и в правила безопасности.
 * Здесь клиентский fan-out ограничен MAX_FANOUT.
 */
interface FeedWriter {
    /**
     * Записать событие в ленты всех подписчиков [actorUid] (кроме самого
     * [actorUid]) и опционально в ленту [extraOwnerUid] (например, владельцу
     * отзыва при реакции/комментарии).
     *
     * @param sourceId уникальный id источника (reviewId / commentId / followId)
     * @param type тип события
     * @param payload денормализованные поля для отображения
     * @param extraOwnerUid дополнительный получатель (владелец отзыва)
     */
    suspend fun fanOut(
        actorUid: String,
        sourceId: String,
        type: FeedItemType,
        payload: FeedPayload,
        extraOwnerUid: String? = null
    ): Result<Unit>

    data class FeedPayload(
        val actorName: String,
        val actorAvatarBase64: String,
        val reviewId: String = "",
        val reviewComment: String = "",
        val itemName: String = "",
        val rating: Int = 0,
        val commentText: String = "",
        val reaction: ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction? = null
    )

    companion object {
        /** Максимум подписчиков для клиентского fan-out (лимит батча Firestore = 500). */
        const val MAX_FANOUT = 400
    }
}

/**
 * Доменная ошибка с готовым сообщением для UI.

sealed interface AppError {
    val message: String
    val cause: Throwable?

    data class Network(
        override val message: String = "Нет подключения к интернету",
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError

    data class Auth(
        override val message: String,
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError

    data class Validation(
        override val message: String,
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError

    data class NotFound(
        override val message: String = "Не найдено",
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError

    data class LimitReached(
        override val message: String,
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError

    data class Unknown(
        override val message: String = "Что-то пошло не так. Попробуйте ещё раз",
        override val cause: Throwable? = null
    ) : AppError
}

package ru.savushkina.core.model

/**
 * Элемент ленты активности. Хранится в `feeds/{ownerUid}/items/{feedItemId}`.
 *
 * Денормализован: все поля для отображения (имя, аватар, текст) копируются
 * в момент события, чтобы чтение ленты было одним запросом без join'ов.
 */
data class FeedItem(
    val id: String = "",
    /** Владелец ленты (кому показываем). */
    val ownerUid: String = "",
    /** Тип события. */
    val type: FeedItemType = FeedItemType.NEW_FOLLOWER,
    /** Кто инициатор (подписчик, лайкнувший, комментатор, автор отзыва). */
    val actorUid: String = "",
    val actorName: String = "",
    val actorAvatarBase64: String = "",
    /** Ссылка на отзыв (для реакций/комментариев/отзывов подписок). */
    val reviewId: String = "",
    /** Текст отзыва (денормализация). */
    val reviewComment: String = "",
    /** Название item'а (денормализация). */
    val itemName: String = "",
    /** Рейтинг отзыва (для FollowingReview). */
    val rating: Int = 0,
    /** Текст комментария (для ReviewComment / FollowingComment). */
    val commentText: String = "",
    /** LIKE / DISLIKE (для ReviewReaction). */
    val reaction: Reaction? = null,
    /** Время события (millis since epoch). */
    val timestampMillis: Long = 0L
)

enum class FeedItemType {
    NEW_FOLLOWER,
    REVIEW_REACTION,
    REVIEW_COMMENT,
    FOLLOWING_REVIEW,
    FOLLOWING_COMMENT
}

/**
 * Детерминированный ID элемента ленты — защита от дублей при повторной записи.
 */
fun feedItemId(type: FeedItemType, sourceId: String, ownerUid: String): String =
    "${type.name.lowercase()}_${sourceId}_$ownerUid"

FILE [96/192]: core/model/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/core/model/Review.kt
==============================================================================
package ru.savushkina.core.model

data class Review(
    val userId: String = "",
    val itemId: String = "",
    val rating: Int = 0,
    val comment: String = "",
    val likes: Int = 0,
    val dislikes: Int = 0,
    // денормализация
    val authorName: String = "",
    val authorAvatarBase64: String = "",
    val itemName: String = "",
    val itemSymbol: String? = null,
    val itemIconKey: String? = null,
    val createdAtMillis: Long = 0L
) {
    val hasComment: Boolean get() = comment.isNotBlank()

    /**
     * Составной ID. `|` не может встретиться в Firestore ID (там запрещён только `/`),
     * но `|` мы явно запрещаем в uid/itemId при валидации на клиенте.
     * Если исторически уже есть данные с `_` — используем `|` как разделитель.
     */
    val reviewId: String get() = "$userId|$itemId"

    companion object {
        private const val SEP = '|'

        /** Возвращает (userId, itemId) или null, если формат некорректный. */
        fun parseReviewId(reviewId: String): Pair<String, String>? {
            val idx = reviewId.indexOf(SEP)
            if (idx <= 0 || idx == reviewId.length - 1) return null
            return reviewId.substring(0, idx) to reviewId.substring(idx + 1)
        }
    }
}

    data object LoadingProfile : SessionState

    data class ProfileLoadError(val userId: String) : SessionState
    /** Пользователь вошёл, но не завершил онбординг. */
    data class Onboarding(val userId: String) : SessionState
    /** Полностью вошёл и онбординг пройден. */
    data class Authenticated(val user: User) : SessionState
}

package ru.savushkina.core.model

enum class TextCaseStyle {
    /** Обычный текст — как есть. */
    NORMAL,
    /** camelCase — первое слово с маленькой, остальные с большой. */
    CAMEL_CASE,
    /** snake_case — всё с маленькой, пробелы как подчёркивания. */
    SNAKE_CASE;

    val displayName: String
        get() = when (this) {
            NORMAL -> "обычный"
            CAMEL_CASE -> "camelCase"
            SNAKE_CASE -> "snake_case"
        }
}

FILE [101/192]: core/model/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/core/model/User.kt

package ru.savushkina.core.model

data class User(
    val uid: String = "",
    val email: String = "",
    val name: String = "",
    val username: String = "",
    val description: String = "",
    val avatarBase64: String = "",
    val role: Role? = null,
    val onboardingCompleted: Boolean = false
) {
    val displayName: String
        get() = name.ifBlank {
            if (username.isNotBlank()) "@$username" else email.substringBefore('@')
        }

    val handle: String
        get() = if (username.isNotBlank()) "@$username" else ""

    val initials: String
        get() = displayName
            .trim()
            .split(" ")
            .filter { it.isNotBlank() }
            .take(2)
            .joinToString("") { it.first().uppercase() }
            .ifBlank { "?" }
}

package ru.savushkina.core.navigation

import android.net.Uri

object Routes {
    const val SPLASH = "splash"
    const val AUTH = "auth"
    const val ONBOARDING = "onboarding"
    const val FEED = "feed"
    const val SEARCH = "search"
    const val TYPES = "types"
    const val TYPE_ITEMS = "type_items/{type}"
    const val TOP_RATED = "top_rated"
    const val LOWEST_RATED = "lowest_rated"
    const val PROFILE = "profile"
    const val USER_PROFILE = "user/{userId}"
    const val SETTINGS = "settings"
    const val DETAILS = "details/{itemId}"
    const val USER_SEARCH = "user_search"

    fun userSearch() = USER_SEARCH
    const val REVIEW_FORM = "review_form/{itemId}"
    const val REVIEW_DETAIL = "review_detail/{reviewId}"
    const val FAVOURITE_PICKER = "favourite_picker"

    const val COLLECTIONS = "collections?userId={userId}"
    const val COLLECTION_CREATE = "collection_create"
    const val COLLECTION_TYPE_PICKER = "collection_type_picker"
    const val COLLECTION_DETAIL = "collection/{collectionId}"
    const val COLLECTION_PICKER = "collection_picker/{collectionId}"
    const val COLLECTION_ARRAY_PICKER = "collection_array_picker?name={name}&type={type}"

    const val ACTIVITY = "activity"
    const val REVIEW_REACTIONS = "review_reactions/{reviewId}"
    fun reviewReactions(reviewId: String) = "review_reactions/${Uri.encode(reviewId)}"
    /** Список подписчиков / подписок. mode = "followers" | "following". */
    const val FOLLOW_LIST = "follow_list/{mode}"

    // ── path args ──
    fun details(itemId: String) = "details/${Uri.encode(itemId)}"
    fun reviewForm(itemId: String) = "review_form/${Uri.encode(itemId)}"
    fun reviewDetail(reviewId: String) = "review_detail/${Uri.encode(reviewId)}"
    fun userProfile(userId: String) = "user/${Uri.encode(userId)}"
    fun typeItems(type: String) = "type_items/${Uri.encode(type)}"
    fun collectionDetail(collectionId: String) = "collection/${Uri.encode(collectionId)}"
    fun collectionPicker(collectionId: String) = "collection_picker/${Uri.encode(collectionId)}"

    // ── query args ──
    fun collections(userId: String? = null): String =
        if (userId.isNullOrBlank()) "collections"
        else "collections?userId=${Uri.encode(userId)}"

    fun collectionArrayPicker(name: String, type: String): String {
        val encodedName = Uri.encode(name)
        val encodedType = Uri.encode(type)
        return "collection_array_picker?name=$encodedName&type=$encodedType"
    }

    fun followList(mode: FollowListMode): String = "follow_list/${mode.routeValue}"

    // ── декодер (используется во ViewModel'ях) ──
    fun decode(raw: String?): String = raw?.let(Uri::decode).orEmpty()
}

enum class FollowListMode(val routeValue: String) {
    FOLLOWERS("followers"),
    FOLLOWING("following");

    companion object {
        fun fromRoute(value: String?): FollowListMode =
            entries.firstOrNull { it.routeValue == value } ?: FOLLOWERS
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.activity

import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box

import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.AlertBox
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.BlinkingCursor

import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItem
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItemType
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale

@Composable
fun ActivityScreen(
    onUserClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onReviewClick: (reviewId: String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: ActivityViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SectionHeader(text = "активность")
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (val s = state) {
                is ActivityUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is ActivityUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = s.message)
                    }
                }
                is ActivityUiState.Success -> {
                    if (s.items.isEmpty()) {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            LabelText(text = "// пока тихо")
                        }
                    } else {
                        ActivityList(
                            state = s,
                            onUserClick = onUserClick,
                            onReviewClick = onReviewClick,
                            onLoadMore = viewModel::loadMore,
                            onRetryLoadMore = viewModel::retryLoadMore
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ActivityList(
    state: ActivityUiState.Success,
    onUserClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onReviewClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onLoadMore: () -> Unit,
    onRetryLoadMore: () -> Unit
) {
    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val currentState by rememberUpdatedState(state)
    val currentOnLoadMore by rememberUpdatedState(onLoadMore)

    LaunchedEffect(listState) {
        snapshotFlow {
            val info = listState.layoutInfo
            val last = info.visibleItemsInfo.lastOrNull()?.index
            val total = info.totalItemsCount
            last != null && total > 0 && last >= total - 3
        }.collect { nearEnd ->
            if (nearEnd) {
                val s = currentState
                if (s.canLoadMore && !s.isLoadingMore && s.loadMoreError == null) {
                    currentOnLoadMore()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    LazyColumn(
        state = listState,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = Spacing.lg),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
    ) {
        items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
            ActivityRow(
                item = item,
                onUserClick = onUserClick,
                onReviewClick = onReviewClick
            )
        }

        if (state.loadMoreError != null) {
            item(key = "load_more_error") {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                ) {
                    AlertBox(text = state.loadMoreError)
                    WireButton(text = "повторить", onClick = onRetryLoadMore, accent = true)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ActivityRow(
    item: FeedItem,
    onUserClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onReviewClick: (String) -> Unit
) {
    val actionText = when (item.type) {
        FeedItemType.NEW_FOLLOWER -> "подписался на вас"
        FeedItemType.REVIEW_REACTION -> if (item.reaction == Reaction.LIKE) "лайкнул ваш отзыв" else "дизлайкнул ваш отзыв"
        FeedItemType.REVIEW_COMMENT -> "оставил комментарий"
        FeedItemType.FOLLOWING_REVIEW -> "оставил новый отзыв"
        FeedItemType.FOLLOWING_COMMENT -> "оставил комментарий"
    }

    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top
        ) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.clickable { onUserClick(item.actorUid) }) {
                WireAvatar(
                    avatarBase64 = item.actorAvatarBase64,
                    fallbackText = item.actorName.take(2).uppercase().ifBlank { "??" },
                    size = 36.dp
                )
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.sm))
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = item.actorName.ifBlank { "аноним" },
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                    modifier = Modifier.clickable { onUserClick(item.actorUid) }
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                Text(
                    text = actionText,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                )

                when (item.type) {
                    FeedItemType.REVIEW_REACTION -> {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            text = "«${item.reviewComment.ifBlank { item.itemName }}»",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
                            modifier = Modifier.clickable { onReviewClick(item.reviewId) }
                        )
                    }
                    FeedItemType.REVIEW_COMMENT -> {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            text = "«${item.commentText}»",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                        LabelText(text = "к отзыву: «${item.reviewComment.take(60)}»")
                    }
                    FeedItemType.FOLLOWING_REVIEW -> {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            text = "★ ${item.rating} · «${item.reviewComment.take(80)}»",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground,
                            modifier = Modifier.clickable { onReviewClick(item.reviewId) }
                        )
                    }
                    FeedItemType.FOLLOWING_COMMENT -> {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            text = "«${item.commentText}»",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                        )
                    }
                    FeedItemType.NEW_FOLLOWER -> Unit
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                LabelText(text = formatTime(item.timestampMillis))
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun formatTime(millis: Long): String {
    if (millis <= 0L) return "недавно"
    return SimpleDateFormat("dd.MM HH:mm", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date(millis))
}

FILE [115/192]: feature/activity/src/main/java/com/example/feature/activity/ActivityViewModel.kt

package ru.savushkina.feature.activity

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FeedRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.FeedItem
import ru.savushkina.core.model.SessionState
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface ActivityUiState {
    data object Loading : ActivityUiState
    data class Success(
        val items: List<FeedItem>,
        val isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
        val canLoadMore: Boolean = true,
        val loadMoreError: String? = null
    ) : ActivityUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : ActivityUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class ActivityViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val feedRepository: FeedRepository,
    sessionRepository: SessionRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val currentUserId: StateFlow<String?> = sessionRepository.sessionState
        .map { state ->
            when (state) {
                is SessionState.Authenticated -> state.user.uid
                is SessionState.Onboarding -> state.userId
                is SessionState.ProfileLoadError -> state.userId
                else -> null
            }
        }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, null)

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<ActivityUiState>(ActivityUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private var nextCursor: Long? = null

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            currentUserId
                .flatMapLatest { uid ->
                    if (uid == null) {
                        flowOf(ActivityUiState.Error("Не авторизован"))
                    } else {
                        nextCursor = null
                        feedRepository.observeFeed(uid, FeedRepository.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)
                            .map { items ->
                                nextCursor = items.lastOrNull()?.timestampMillis
                                ActivityUiState.Success(
                                    items = items,
                                    canLoadMore = items.size >= FeedRepository.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE
                                ) as ActivityUiState
                            }
                            .catch { emit(ActivityUiState.Error(it.message ?: "Ошибка загрузки")) }
                    }
                }
                .collect { _uiState.value = it }
        }
    }

    fun loadMore() {
        val current = _uiState.value
        if (current !is ActivityUiState.Success) return
        if (current.isLoadingMore || !current.canLoadMore) return
        if (current.loadMoreError != null) return
        val uid = currentUserId.value ?: return
        val cursor = nextCursor ?: return

        _uiState.update { state ->
            if (state is ActivityUiState.Success) state.copy(isLoadingMore = true, loadMoreError = null)
            else state
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            feedRepository.loadMore(uid, cursor, FeedRepository.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE)
                .onSuccess { page ->
                    nextCursor = page.lastOrNull()?.timestampMillis
                    _uiState.update { state ->
                        if (state is ActivityUiState.Success) {
                            state.copy(
                                items = state.items + page,
                                isLoadingMore = false,
                                canLoadMore = page.size >= FeedRepository.DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE,
                                loadMoreError = null
                            )
                        } else state
                    }
                }
                .onFailure { e ->
                    _uiState.update { state ->
                        if (state is ActivityUiState.Success) {
                            state.copy(
                                isLoadingMore = false,
                                loadMoreError = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить ещё"
                            )
                        } else state
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun retryLoadMore() {
        val current = _uiState.value as? ActivityUiState.Success ?: return
        if (current.loadMoreError == null) return
        _uiState.update { it.copy(loadMoreError = null) }
        loadMore()
    }
}

@Composable
fun AuthScreen(
    viewModel: AuthViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    AuthContent(
        state = state,
        onEmailChange = viewModel::onEmailChange,
        onPasswordChange = viewModel::onPasswordChange,
        onTogglePassword = viewModel::togglePasswordVisibility,
        onSignIn = viewModel::signIn,
        onSignUp = viewModel::signUp
    )
}

@Composable
fun AuthContent(
    state: AuthState,
    onEmailChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onPasswordChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onTogglePassword: () -> Unit = {},
    onSignIn: () -> Unit = {},
    onSignUp: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        // isLoading || isDone — держим спиннер до навигации по navTarget,
        // чтобы форма не мелькнула и не была кликабельной повторно.
        if (state.isLoading || state.isDone) {
            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                BlinkingCursor()
            }
        } else {
            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
            ) {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .widthIn(max = 480.dp)
                        .padding(vertical = Spacing.lg),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
                ) {
                    SectionHeader(text = "codebox")
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxl))

                    WireTextField(
                        value = state.email,
                        onValueChange = onEmailChange,
                        label = "email"
                    )

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                    WireTextField(
                        value = state.password,
                        onValueChange = onPasswordChange,
                        label = "password",
                        visualTransformation = if (state.isPasswordVisible)
                            VisualTransformation.None
                        else
                            PasswordVisualTransformation(),
                        trailingIcon = {
                            PasswordVisibilityToggle(
                                visible = state.isPasswordVisible,
                                onToggle = onTogglePassword
                            )
                        }
                    )

                    state.error?.let {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                        AlertBox(text = it)
                    }

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

                    WireButton(text = "войти", onClick = onSignIn)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
                    WireButton(text = "зарегистрироваться", onClick = onSignUp)
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.auth

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ErrorMapper
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserConstraints
import javax.inject.Inject

data class AuthState(
    val email: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isPasswordVisible: Boolean = false,
    val isDone: Boolean = false,
    /** Ошибка конкретного поля ввода (валидация). Сбрасывается при правке поля. */
    val fieldError: String? = null,
    /** Ошибка отправки формы (сеть/сервер). Не сбрасывается при правке полей. */
    val submitError: String? = null
) {
    /** Совместимое свойство для UI: показывает первую доступную ошибку. */
    val error: String?
        get() = fieldError ?: submitError
}

@HiltViewModel
class AuthViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val errorMapper: ErrorMapper
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(AuthState())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    fun onEmailChange(value: String) {
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(email = value, fieldError = null)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(password = value, fieldError = null)
    }

    fun togglePasswordVisibility() {
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(isPasswordVisible = !_state.value.isPasswordVisible)
    }

    /**
     * Вызывается UI после обработки [AuthState.isDone] (например, после навигации),
     * чтобы событие не «залипло» при повороте экрана / повторной подписке.
     */
    fun onDoneHandled() {
        if (_state.value.isDone) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(isDone = false)
        }
    }

    fun signIn() {
        if (_state.value.isLoading) return

        val email = _state.value.email.trim()
        val password = _state.value.password
        validate(email, password)?.let { message ->
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(fieldError = message, submitError = null)
            return
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                isLoading = true,
                isDone = false,
                fieldError = null,
                submitError = null
            )

            // Работаем с Result репозитория напрямую — без двойного оборачивания.
            val signInResult = runCatchingCancellable {
                authRepository.signIn(email, password)
            }.getOrElse { e ->
                // Сюда попадаем только если runCatchingCancellable поймал не-Result исключение
                // (например, CancellationException пробрасывается — см. реализацию).
                handleUnexpectedFailure(e)
                return@launch
            }

            signInResult.fold(
                onSuccess = {
                    // Симметрия с signUp: гарантируем профиль. Идемпотентно.
                    val profileResult = runCatchingCancellable {
                        val uid = authRepository.currentUid()
                            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Нет uid после успешного входа")
                        userRepository.ensureUserExists(uid, email)
                    }.getOrElse { e ->
                        handleUnexpectedFailure(e)
                        return@launch
                    }

                    profileResult.fold(
                        onSuccess = {
                            _state.value = _state.value.copy(isLoading = false, isDone = true)
                        },
                        onFailure = { e ->
                            // Вход выполнен, но профиль не создан.
                            // НЕ ставим isDone=true: покажем ошибку, пользователь повторит.
                            // ensureUserExists идемпотентен — повтор безопасен.
                            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                                isLoading = false,
                                isDone = false,
                                submitError = errorMapper.map(e).message
                            )
                        }
                    )
                },
                onFailure = { e ->
                    // НЕ вызываем signOut(): при сетевой ошибке до попытки входа
                    // это разлогинило бы активную сессию. Если нужен явный сброс —
                    // делайте его только после подтверждения, что вход начался
                    // (например, сравнив currentUid() до и после).
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isDone = false,
                        submitError = errorMapper.map(e).message
                    )
                }
            )
        }
    }

    fun signUp() {
        if (_state.value.isLoading) return

        val email = _state.value.email.trim()
        val password = _state.value.password
        validate(email, password)?.let { message ->
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(fieldError = message, submitError = null)
            return
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                isLoading = true,
                isDone = false,
                fieldError = null,
                submitError = null
            )

            val signUpResult = runCatchingCancellable {
                authRepository.signUp(email, password)
            }.getOrElse { e ->
                handleUnexpectedFailure(e)
                return@launch
            }

            signUpResult.fold(
                onSuccess = {
                    val profileResult = runCatchingCancellable {
                        val uid = authRepository.currentUid()
                            ?: throw IllegalStateException("Нет uid после успешной регистрации")
                        userRepository.ensureUserExists(uid, email)
                    }.getOrElse { e ->
                        handleUnexpectedFailure(e)
                        return@launch
                    }

                    profileResult.fold(
                        onSuccess = {
                            _state.value = _state.value.copy(isLoading = false, isDone = true)
                        },
                        onFailure = { e ->
                            // Аккаунт создан, но профиль — нет.
                            // Показываем ошибку; повторный signUp() вернёт EMAIL_EXISTS,
                            // поэтому UI должен предложить «Войти» (ensureUserExists
                            // теперь вызывается и в signIn — повтор безопасен).
                            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                                isLoading = false,
                                isDone = false,
                                submitError = errorMapper.map(e).message
                            )
                        }
                    )
                },
                onFailure = { e ->
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        isDone = false,
                        submitError = errorMapper.map(e).message
                    )
                }
            )
        }
    }

    /**
     * Страховка: сбрасываем isLoading, чтобы UI не залип, и логируем неожиданный сбой.
     * Здесь не показываем пользователю технические детали.
     */
    private fun handleUnexpectedFailure(e: Throwable) {
        // Если в проекте есть логгер — залогируйте e здесь.
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(
            isLoading = false,
            isDone = false,
            submitError = errorMapper.map(e).message
        )
    }

    private fun validate(email: String, password: String): String? {
        if (email.isBlank()) return "Введите email"
        if (email.length > EMAIL_MAX_LENGTH) return "Email слишком длинный"
        if (!EMAIL_REGEX.matches(email)) return "Некорректный email"
        if (password.length < UserConstraints.PASSWORD_MIN) {
            return "Пароль слишком короткий (минимум ${UserConstraints.PASSWORD_MIN})"
        }
        if (password.length > UserConstraints.PASSWORD_MAX) {
            return "Пароль слишком длинный (максимум ${UserConstraints.PASSWORD_MAX})"
        }
        return null
    }

    private companion object {
        const val EMAIL_MAX_LENGTH = 254

        val EMAIL_REGEX = Regex(
            "^[A-Za-z0-9+_.-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
        )
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
