@Composable
fun ArrayPickerScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onCreated: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: ArrayPickerViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val query by viewModel.query.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val selectedIds by viewModel.selectedIds.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isSaving by viewModel.isSaving.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val error by viewModel.error.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    ArrayPickerContent(
        query = query,
        selectedIds = selectedIds,
        allowedType = viewModel.typeName,
        isSaving = isSaving,
        error = error,
        state = state,
        onQueryChange = viewModel::onQueryChange,
        onToggleItem = viewModel::toggleItem,
        onSubmit = { viewModel.submit(onCreated) },
        onBack = onBack
    )
}

@Composable
fun ArrayPickerContent(
    query: String,
    selectedIds: List<String>,
    allowedType: String,
    isSaving: Boolean,
    error: String?,
    state: ArrayPickerUiState,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onToggleItem: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onSubmit: () -> Unit = {},
    onBack: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// выбор ($allowedType)",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            LabelText(
                text = "выбрано: ${selectedIds.size}",
                color = if (selectedIds.size >= UserCollection.MIN_SIZE)
                    MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = onQueryChange,
                label = "поиск",
                placeholder = "начните вводить"
            )

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                when (state) {
                    is ArrayPickerUiState.Loading -> {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            BlinkingCursor()
                        }
                    }
                    is ArrayPickerUiState.Error -> {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            AlertBox(text = state.message)
                        }
                    }
                    is ArrayPickerUiState.Success -> {
                        if (state.items.isEmpty()) {
                            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                LabelText(text = "// ничего не найдено")
                            }
                        } else {
                            LazyColumn(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                            ) {
                                items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                                    val isSelected = selectedIds.contains(item.id)
                                    ArrayPickerItemRow(
                                        item = item,
                                        isSelected = isSelected,
                                        onClick = { onToggleItem(item.id) }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            error?.let {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                AlertBox(text = it)
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireButton(
                text = if (isSaving) "создание..." else "готово",
                onClick = onSubmit,
                accent = true,
                enabled = !isSaving && selectedIds.size >= UserCollection.MIN_SIZE
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ArrayPickerItemRow(
    item: Item,
    isSelected: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    WireFrame(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        accent = isSelected
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable(onClick = onClick)
                .padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = item.name,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                )
                if (item.type.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                    LabelText(text = item.type)
                }
            }
            LabelText(
                text = if (isSelected) "[x]" else "[ ]",
                color = if (isSelected) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
            )
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.FlowPreview
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface ArrayPickerUiState {
    data object Loading : ArrayPickerUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<Item>) : ArrayPickerUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : ArrayPickerUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class, FlowPreview::class)
@HiltViewModel
class ArrayPickerViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val collectionRepository: CollectionRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val name: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("name"))
    private val allowedType: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("type"))

    private val _query = MutableStateFlow("")
    val query = _query.asStateFlow()

    private val _selectedIds = MutableStateFlow<List<String>>(emptyList())
    val selectedIds = _selectedIds.asStateFlow()

    private val _isSaving = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isSaving = _isSaving.asStateFlow()

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<ArrayPickerUiState> = _query
        .debounce(300)
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .flatMapLatest { raw ->
            val q = raw.trim().lowercase()
            flow {
                emit(ArrayPickerUiState.Loading)
                runCatchingCancellable {
                    val all = itemRepository.getItemsByType(allowedType, limit = 50)
                    if (q.isBlank()) all
                    else all.filter { it.name.lowercase().contains(q) }
                }
                    .onSuccess { emit(ArrayPickerUiState.Success(it)) }
                    .onFailure {
                        emit(
                            ArrayPickerUiState.Error(
                                it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить"
                            )
                        )
                    }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            ArrayPickerUiState.Loading
        )

    val typeName: String get() = allowedType

    fun onQueryChange(value: String) {
        _query.value = value
    }

    fun toggleItem(itemId: String) {
        val current = _selectedIds.value
        if (current.contains(itemId)) {
            _selectedIds.value = current - itemId
            _error.value = null
            return
        }
        if (current.size >= UserCollection.MAX_SIZE_LIMIT) {
            _error.value = "Максимум ${UserCollection.MAX_SIZE_LIMIT} айтемов"
            return
        }
        _selectedIds.value = current + itemId
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun submit(onSuccess: (String) -> Unit) {
        val selected = _selectedIds.value.distinct()
        if (selected.size < UserCollection.MIN_SIZE) {
            _error.value = "Выберите минимум ${UserCollection.MIN_SIZE} айтема"
            return
        }
        if (_isSaving.value) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isSaving.value = true
            _error.value = null

            runCatchingCancellable {
                val uid = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("Не авторизован")
                val collection = UserCollection(
                    userId = uid,
                    name = name,
                    itemIds = selected,
                    isFixedSize = true,
                    maxSize = selected.size,
                    allowedItemType = allowedType,
                    createdAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
                )
                collectionRepository.createCollection(collection).getOrThrow()
            }.onSuccess { id ->
                _isSaving.value = false
                onSuccess(id)
            }.onFailure {
                _isSaving.value = false
                _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось создать массив"
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun CollectionDetailScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onAddItemClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onDeleted: () -> Unit,
    viewModel: CollectionDetailViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isOwn by viewModel.isOwnCollection.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    var confirmDelete by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }

    CollectionDetailContent(
        state = state,
        isOwnCollection = isOwn,
        onBack = onBack,
        onItemClick = onItemClick,
        onAddItemClick = onAddItemClick,
        onRemoveItem = viewModel::removeItem,
        onDeleteClick = { if (isOwn) confirmDelete = true }
    )

    if (confirmDelete && isOwn) {
        DeleteCollectionDialog(
            onConfirm = {
                confirmDelete = false
                viewModel.deleteCollection(onDeleted)
            },
            onDismiss = { confirmDelete = false }
        )
    }

@Composable
fun CollectionDetailContent(
    state: CollectionDetailUiState,
    isOwnCollection: Boolean,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onAddItemClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onRemoveItem: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onDeleteClick: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            val title = when (state) {
                is CollectionDetailUiState.Success -> "// ${state.collection.name}"
                else -> "// коллекция"
            }
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = title,
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is CollectionDetailUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is CollectionDetailUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is CollectionDetailUiState.Success -> {
                    val collection = state.collection
                    val canEdit = isOwnCollection && collection.isEditable

                    Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                        LabelText(
                            text = if (collection.isFixedSize)
                                "массив · ${collection.itemIds.size}/${collection.maxSize}"
                            else
                                "список · ${collection.itemIds.size}"
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                        if (canEdit) {
                            WireButton(
                                text = "+ добавить айтем",
                                onClick = { onAddItemClick(collection.id) },
                                accent = true
                            )
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                        }

                        if (state.items.isEmpty()) {
                            Box(
                                Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                LabelText(text = "// пусто")
                            }
                        } else {
                            LazyColumn(
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                            ) {
                                items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                                    CollectionItemRow(
                                        item = item,
                                        isEditable = canEdit,
                                        onRemove = { onRemoveItem(item.id) },
                                        onClick = { onItemClick(item.id) }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        if (isOwnCollection) {
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                            WireButton(
                                text = "удалить коллекцию",
                                onClick = onDeleteClick
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CollectionItemRow(
    item: Item,
    isEditable: Boolean,
    onRemove: () -> Unit,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(

        ) {

                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground

                    imageVector = Icons.Outlined.Close,
                    contentDescription = "Убрать",
                    tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .size(18.dp)
                        .clickable(onClick = onRemove)
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.SessionState
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface CollectionDetailUiState {
    data object Loading : CollectionDetailUiState
    data class Success(
        val collection: UserCollection,
        val items: List<Item>
    ) : CollectionDetailUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : CollectionDetailUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class CollectionDetailViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val collectionRepository: CollectionRepository,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val collectionId: String =
        Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("collectionId"))

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<CollectionDetailUiState>(
        CollectionDetailUiState.Loading
    )
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _retry = MutableStateFlow(0)

    /**
     * UID текущего пользователя как StateFlow. Никакого var вне State —
     * UI гарантированно рекомпозируется при смене авторизации.
     */
    private val currentUserId: StateFlow<String?> = authRepository.authState
        .map { it?.uid }
        .stateIn(
            scope = viewModelScope,
            started = SharingStarted.Eagerly,
            initialValue = authRepository.currentUid()
        )

    /**
     * true, если текущая коллекция принадлежит текущему пользователю.
     * Пересчитывается автоматически при изменении _uiState или currentUserId.
     */
    val isOwnCollection: StateFlow<Boolean> = combine(
        _uiState,
        currentUserId
    ) { state, uid ->
        state is CollectionDetailUiState.Success &&
                uid != null &&
                state.collection.userId == uid
    }.stateIn(
        scope = viewModelScope,
        started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
        initialValue = false
    )

    init {
        if (collectionId.isBlank()) {
            _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Error("Некорректный ID коллекции")
        } else {
            observe()
        }
    }

    private fun observe() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _retry.flatMapLatest {
                _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Loading
                collectionRepository.observeCollection(collectionId)
                    .catch { e ->
                        _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Error(
                            e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить коллекцию"
                        )
                        emit(null)
                    }
            }.collect { collection ->
                if (collection == null) {
                    // Ошибку уже показали в catch; повторно не затираем
                    return@collect
                }
                runCatchingCancellable {
                    itemRepository.getItemsByIds(collection.itemIds)
                }.onSuccess { items ->
                    _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Success(collection, items)
                }.onFailure {
                    _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Error(
                        it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить айтемы"
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun retry() {
        _retry.value++
    }

    fun removeItem(itemId: String) {
        if (!isOwnCollection.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            collectionRepository.removeItem(collectionId, itemId)
                .onFailure {
                    _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Error(
                        it.message ?: "Не удалось удалить айтем"
                    )
                }
        }
    }

    fun deleteCollection(onDeleted: () -> Unit) {
        if (!isOwnCollection.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            collectionRepository.deleteCollection(collectionId)
                .onSuccess { onDeleted() }
                .onFailure {
                    _uiState.value = CollectionDetailUiState.Error(
                        it.message ?: "Не удалось удалить коллекцию"
                    )
                }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.FlowPreview
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface CollectionPickerUiState {
    data object Loading : CollectionPickerUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<Item>) : CollectionPickerUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : CollectionPickerUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class, FlowPreview::class)
@HiltViewModel
class CollectionPickerViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val collectionRepository: CollectionRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val collectionId: String =
        Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("collectionId"))

    private val _query = MutableStateFlow("")
    val query = _query.asStateFlow()

    private val _collection = MutableStateFlow<UserCollection?>(null)

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<CollectionPickerUiState> = combine(
        _query.debounce(300).distinctUntilChanged(),
        _collection
    ) { q, collection ->
        q.trim() to collection?.itemIds.orEmpty()
    }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .flatMapLatest { (q, excluded) ->
            flow {
                emit(CollectionPickerUiState.Loading)
                runCatchingCancellable {
                    val all = if (q.isBlank()) itemRepository.getTopRated()
                    else itemRepository.searchByName(q)
                    all.filterNot { it.id in excluded }
                }
                    .onSuccess { emit(CollectionPickerUiState.Success(it)) }
                    .onFailure {
                        emit(
                            CollectionPickerUiState.Error(
                                it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить"
                            )
                        )
                    }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            CollectionPickerUiState.Loading
        )

    init {
        if (collectionId.isNotBlank()) {
            viewModelScope.launch {
                collectionRepository.observeCollection(collectionId)
                    .catch { e ->
                        _error.value = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить коллекцию"
                    }
                    .collect { _collection.value = it }
            }
        }
    }

    fun onQueryChange(value: String) {
        _query.value = value
        // Ошибка добавления относится к прошлому действию — сбрасываем.
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun addItem(itemId: String, onAdded: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            collectionRepository.addItem(collectionId, itemId)
                .onSuccess {
                    _error.value = null
                    onAdded()
                }
                .onFailure { e ->
                    _error.value = e.message ?: "Не удалось добавить"
                }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun CollectionsListScreen(

) {

    )

@Composable
fun CollectionsListContent(
    collections: List<UserCollection>,
    isOwnCollections: Boolean = true,
    error: String? = null,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onCollectionClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onCreateClick: () -> Unit = {},
    onRetry: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = if (isOwnCollections) "// коллекции" else "// коллекции пользователя",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            if (isOwnCollections) {
                WireButton(
                    text = "+ создать",
                    onClick = onCreateClick,
                    accent = true
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
            }

            if (error != null) {
                Box(
                    Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    Column(
                        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.md)
                    ) {
                        AlertBox(text = error)
                        WireButton(
                            text = "повторить",
                            onClick = onRetry,
                            accent = true
                        )
                    }
                }
                return@TerminalScreen
            }

            if (collections.isEmpty()) {
                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    LabelText(text = "// пока нет коллекций")
                }
            } else {
                LazyColumn(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                ) {
                    items(collections, key = { it.id }) { collection ->
                        CollectionRow(
                            collection = collection,
                            onClick = { onCollectionClick(collection.id) }
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CollectionRow(
    collection: UserCollection,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable(onClick = onClick)
                .padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = collection.name,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                LabelText(
                    text = if (collection.isFixedSize)
                        "массив · ${collection.itemIds.size}/${collection.maxSize}"
                    else
                        "список · ${collection.itemIds.size}"
                )
            }
            LabelText(text = ">", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class CollectionsListViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val collectionRepository: CollectionRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val targetUserId: String? =
        Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("userId")).takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }

    private val _currentUserId = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)

    val isOwnCollections: StateFlow<Boolean> = _currentUserId
        .map { current ->
            current != null && (targetUserId.isNullOrBlank() || targetUserId == current)
        }
        .stateIn(
            scope = viewModelScope,
            started = SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            initialValue = false
        )

    private val _collections = MutableStateFlow<List<UserCollection>>(emptyList())
    val collections = _collections.asStateFlow()

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    private val _retry = MutableStateFlow(0)

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _retry.flatMapLatest {
                _error.value = null
                val currentUid = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
                _currentUserId.value = currentUid
                val uid = targetUserId ?: currentUid
                if (uid.isNullOrBlank()) {
                    _error.value = "Не авторизован"
                    kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf(emptyList())
                } else {
                    collectionRepository.observeCollections(uid)
                        .catch { e ->
                            _error.value = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить коллекции"
                            emit(emptyList())
                        }
                }
            }.collect { _collections.value = it }
        }
    }

    fun retry() {
        _retry.value++
    }
}

@Composable
fun CollectionTypePickerContent(
    state: CollectionTypePickerUiState,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onTypeSelected: (String) -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// тип айтема",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is CollectionTypePickerUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is CollectionTypePickerUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is CollectionTypePickerUiState.Success -> {
                    if (state.types.isEmpty()) {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            LabelText(text = "// типов нет")
                        }
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                        ) {
                            items(state.types, key = { it }) { type ->
                                WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                                    Row(
                                        modifier = Modifier
                                            .fillMaxWidth()
                                            .clickable { onTypeSelected(type) }
                                            .padding(Spacing.md),
                                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                                    ) {
                                        LabelText(
                                            text = type,
                                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface CollectionTypePickerUiState {
    data object Loading : CollectionTypePickerUiState
    data class Success(val types: List<String>) : CollectionTypePickerUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : CollectionTypePickerUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class CollectionTypePickerViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<CollectionTypePickerUiState>(
        CollectionTypePickerUiState.Loading
    )
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            runCatchingCancellable { itemRepository.getTypes() }
                .onSuccess { _uiState.value = CollectionTypePickerUiState.Success(it) }
                .onFailure {
                    _uiState.value = CollectionTypePickerUiState.Error(
                        it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить"
                    )
                }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun CreateCollectionScreen(
    backStackEntry: NavBackStackEntry,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onListCreated: (String) -> Unit,
    onGoToTypePicker: () -> Unit,
    onGoToArrayPicker: (name: String, type: String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: CreateCollectionViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    val selectedTypeFlow = remember(backStackEntry) {
        backStackEntry.savedStateHandle
            .getStateFlow<String?>("selected_type", null)
    }

    LaunchedEffect(selectedTypeFlow) {
        selectedTypeFlow.collectLatest { type ->
            if (type != null) {
                viewModel.onAllowedTypeChange(type)
                backStackEntry.savedStateHandle["selected_type"] = null
            }
        }
    }

    CreateCollectionContent(
        state = state,
        onBack = onBack,
        onNameChange = viewModel::onNameChange,
        onKindChange = viewModel::onKindChange,
        onPickTypeClick = onGoToTypePicker,
        onCreateList = { viewModel.createList(onListCreated) },
        onNextForArray = {
            if (viewModel.validateForArray()) {
                onGoToArrayPicker(
                    state.name.trim(),
                    state.allowedType ?: ""
                )
            }
        }
    )
}

@Composable
fun CreateCollectionContent(
    state: CreateCollectionState,

    onNameChange: (String) -> Unit = {},

) {

                left = {

            ) {
                WireTextField(

                    onValueChange = onNameChange,

                    onClick = { onKindChange(CollectionKind.LIST) }
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))

                    selected = state.kind == CollectionKind.ARRAY,

                    )

                            )

                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

package com.example.feature.collection

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.CollectionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.CollectionKind
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserCollection
import javax.inject.Inject

data class CreateCollectionState(
    val name: String = "",
    val kind: CollectionKind = CollectionKind.LIST,
    val allowedType: String? = null,
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class CreateCollectionViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val collectionRepository: CollectionRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(CreateCollectionState())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    fun onNameChange(value: String) {
        _state.update { it.copy(name = value, error = null) }
    }

    fun onKindChange(kind: CollectionKind) {
        _state.update {
            it.copy(
                kind = kind,
                allowedType = if (kind == CollectionKind.ARRAY) it.allowedType else null,
                error = null
            )
        }
    }

    fun onAllowedTypeChange(type: String) {
        _state.update { it.copy(allowedType = type, error = null) }
    }

    fun createList(onSuccess: (String) -> Unit) {
        val s = _state.value
        val validationError = validateName(s.name)
        if (validationError != null) {
            _state.update { it.copy(error = validationError) }
            return
        }
        if (s.isLoading) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

            runCatchingCancellable {
                val uid = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("Не авторизован")
                val collection = UserCollection(
                    userId = uid,
                    name = s.name.trim(),
                    itemIds = emptyList(),
                    isFixedSize = false,
                    maxSize = 0,
                    allowedItemType = null,
                    createdAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
                )
                collectionRepository.createCollection(collection).getOrThrow()
            }.onSuccess { id ->
                _state.update { it.copy(isLoading = false) }
                onSuccess(id)
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _state.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Не удалось создать"
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun validateForArray(): Boolean {
        val s = _state.value
        val nameError = validateName(s.name)
        if (nameError != null) {
            _state.update { it.copy(error = nameError) }
            return false
        }
        if (s.allowedType.isNullOrBlank()) {
            _state.update { it.copy(error = "Выберите тип айтемов") }
            return false
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun validateName(raw: String): String? {
        val name = raw.trim()
        return when {
            name.isBlank() -> "Введите имя"
            name.length > UserCollection.NAME_MAX ->
                "Имя слишком длинное (макс. ${UserCollection.NAME_MAX})"
            else -> null
        }
    }
}

import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.RatingStars

@Composable
fun DetailsScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onWriteReview: () -> Unit,
    onReviewClick: (reviewId: String) -> Unit,
    onAuthorClick: (userId: String) -> Unit,
    currentUserId: String?,
    viewModel: DetailsViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val myReactions by viewModel.myReactions.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val canLoadMoreReviews by viewModel.canLoadMoreReviews.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isLoadingMoreReviews by viewModel.isLoadingMoreReviews.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val loadMoreReviewsError by viewModel.loadMoreReviewsError.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    DetailsContent(
        state = state,
        myReactions = myReactions,
        currentUserId = currentUserId,
        canLoadMoreReviews = canLoadMoreReviews,
        isLoadingMoreReviews = isLoadingMoreReviews,
        loadMoreReviewsError = loadMoreReviewsError,
        onBack = onBack,
        onWriteReview = onWriteReview,
        onReviewClick = onReviewClick,
        onAuthorClick = onAuthorClick,
        onLike = viewModel::onLike,
        onDislike = viewModel::onDislike,
        onLoadMoreReviews = viewModel::loadMoreReviews,
        onRetryLoadMoreReviews = viewModel::retryLoadMoreReviews
    )
}

@Composable
fun DetailsContent(
    state: DetailsUiState,
    myReactions: Map<String, Reaction?> = emptyMap(),
    currentUserId: String? = null,
    canLoadMoreReviews: Boolean = false,
    isLoadingMoreReviews: Boolean = false,
    loadMoreReviewsError: String? = null,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onWriteReview: () -> Unit = {},
    onReviewClick: (reviewId: String) -> Unit = {},
    onAuthorClick: (userId: String) -> Unit = {},
    onLike: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onDislike: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onLoadMoreReviews: () -> Unit = {},
    onRetryLoadMoreReviews: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// item",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is DetailsUiState.Loading -> {
                    Column(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                    ) {
                        // Skeleton заголовка (иконка + название + тип)
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Skeleton(width = 72.dp, height = 72.dp, cornerRadius = 0.dp)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.md))
                            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                Skeleton(height = 22.dp, width = 180.dp)
                                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                                Skeleton(height = 14.dp, width = 80.dp)
                            }
                        }
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
                        repeat(3) { SkeletonReviewRow() }
                    }
                }
                is DetailsUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is DetailsUiState.Success -> {
                    DetailsBody(
                        item = state.item,
                        reviews = state.reviews,
                        myReview = state.myReview,
                        myReactions = myReactions,
                        currentUserId = currentUserId,
                        canLoadMoreReviews = canLoadMoreReviews,
                        isLoadingMoreReviews = isLoadingMoreReviews,
                        loadMoreReviewsError = loadMoreReviewsError,
                        onWriteReview = onWriteReview,
                        onReviewClick = onReviewClick,
                        onAuthorClick = onAuthorClick,
                        onLike = onLike,
                        onDislike = onDislike,
                        onLoadMoreReviews = onLoadMoreReviews,
                        onRetryLoadMoreReviews = onRetryLoadMoreReviews
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun DetailsBody(
    item: Item,
    reviews: List<Review>,
    myReview: Review?,
    myReactions: Map<String, Reaction?>,
    currentUserId: String?,
    canLoadMoreReviews: Boolean,
    isLoadingMoreReviews: Boolean,
    loadMoreReviewsError: String?,
    onWriteReview: () -> Unit,
    onReviewClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onAuthorClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onLike: (String) -> Unit,
    onDislike: (String) -> Unit,
    onLoadMoreReviews: () -> Unit,
    onRetryLoadMoreReviews: () -> Unit
) {
    val symbol = item.symbol
    val iconKey = item.iconKey

    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = Spacing.xxl),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
    ) {
        item(key = "header") {
            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.size(72.dp), accent = true) {
                    Box(Modifier.size(72.dp), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        when {
                            !symbol.isNullOrBlank() -> Text(
                                text = symbol,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
                            )
                            !iconKey.isNullOrBlank() -> IconKey(
                                iconKey = iconKey,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(Sizes.iconLg)
                            )
                            else -> Text(
                                text = item.fallbackText,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.md))

                Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                    Text(
                        text = item.name,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                    if (item.type.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                        LabelText(text = item.type)
                    }
                    if (item.averageRating > 0) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            RatingStars(rating = item.averageRating.toInt(), size = 16)
                            Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.xs))
                            Text(
                                text = "%.1f".format(item.averageRating),
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (item.description.isNotBlank()) {
            item(key = "description") {
                WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                    Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(Spacing.md)) {
                        LabelText(text = "description")
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            text = item.description,
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        item(key = "write_review") {
            if (myReview != null) {
                WireButton(text = "изменить мой отзыв", onClick = onWriteReview)
            } else {
                WireButton(text = "оценить", onClick = onWriteReview, accent = true)
            }
        }

        item(key = "reviews_header") {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
            SectionHeader(text = "отзывы")
        }

        if (reviews.isEmpty()) {
            item(key = "reviews_empty") {
                LabelText(text = "// пока нет отзывов")
            }
        } else {
            items(reviews, key = { it.reviewId }) { review ->
                val isMine = currentUserId != null && review.userId == currentUserId
                ReviewRow(
                    review = review,
                    isMine = isMine,
                    myReaction = myReactions[review.reviewId],
                    onLike = { onLike(review.reviewId) },
                    onDislike = { onDislike(review.reviewId) },
                    onCardClick = { onReviewClick(review.reviewId) },
                    onCommentsClick = { onReviewClick(review.reviewId) },
                    onAuthorClick = { onAuthorClick(review.userId) }
                )
            }
        }

        if (loadMoreReviewsError != null) {
            item(key = "reviews_load_more_error") {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                ) {
                    AlertBox(text = loadMoreReviewsError)
                    WireButton(
                        text = "повторить",
                        onClick = onRetryLoadMoreReviews,
                        accent = true
                    )
                }
            }
        } else if (isLoadingMoreReviews) {
            item(key = "reviews_loading_more") {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    SkeletonReviewRow()
                }
            }
        } else if (canLoadMoreReviews) {
            item(key = "reviews_load_more") {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
                WireButton(
                    text = "показать ещё отзывы",
                    onClick = onLoadMoreReviews
                )
            }
        } else if (reviews.isNotEmpty()) {
            item(key = "reviews_end") {
                Box(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
                    contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                ) {
                    LabelText(text = "// конец отзывов")
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.details

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface DetailsUiState {
    data object Loading : DetailsUiState
    data class Success(
        val item: Item,
        val reviews: List<Review>,
        val myReview: Review?
    ) : DetailsUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : DetailsUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
@HiltViewModel
class DetailsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val itemId: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("itemId"))

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<DetailsUiState>(DetailsUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _myReactions = MutableStateFlow<Map<String, Reaction?>>(emptyMap())
    val myReactions = _myReactions.asStateFlow()

    private val _isLoadingMoreReviews = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isLoadingMoreReviews = _isLoadingMoreReviews.asStateFlow()

    private val _canLoadMoreReviews = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val canLoadMoreReviews = _canLoadMoreReviews.asStateFlow()

    private val _loadMoreReviewsError = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val loadMoreReviewsError = _loadMoreReviewsError.asStateFlow()

    private var nextReviewCursor: String? = null

    private val _retry = MutableStateFlow(0)

    private val currentUid = authRepository.authState
        .map { it?.uid }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.Eagerly, authRepository.currentUid())

    init {
        if (itemId.isBlank()) {
            _uiState.value = DetailsUiState.Error("Некорректный ID айтема")
        } else {
            observe()
        }
    }

    private fun observe() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _retry
                .flatMapLatest {
                    _uiState.value = DetailsUiState.Loading
                    nextReviewCursor = null
                    _canLoadMoreReviews.value = false
                    _loadMoreReviewsError.value = null

                    combine(
                        itemRepository.observeItemById(itemId),
                        currentUid.flatMapLatest { uid ->
                            reviewRepository.observeReviewsForItem(
                                itemId = itemId,
                                limit = ReviewRepository.DEFAULT_REVIEWS_PAGE_SIZE
                            )
                                .flatMapLatest { reviews ->
                                    if (uid == null || reviews.isEmpty()) {
                                        flowOf(reviews to emptyMap<String, Reaction?>())
                                    } else {
                                        combine(
                                            flowOf(reviews),
                                            reviewRepository.observeMyReactionsForReviews(
                                                reviewIds = reviews.map { it.reviewId },
                                                userId = uid
                                            )
                                        ) { r, reactions -> r to reactions }
                                    }
                                }
                                .map { (reviews, reactions) -> Triple(uid, reviews, reactions) }
                        }
                    ) { item, (uid, reviews, reactions) ->
                        Quad(item, uid, reviews, reactions)
                    }.catch { e ->
                        _uiState.value = DetailsUiState.Error(
                            e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить айтем"
                        )
                        emit(Quad(null, null, emptyList(), emptyMap()))
                    }
                }
                .collect { quad ->
                    _myReactions.value = quad.reactions
                    val item = quad.item
                    if (item == null) {
                        _uiState.value = DetailsUiState.Error("Айтем не найден")
                    } else {
                        val freshReviews = enrichWithProfiles(quad.reviews)
                        val myReview = quad.uid?.let { u ->
                            freshReviews.find { it.userId == u }
                        }

                        val headIds = freshReviews.map { it.reviewId }.toSet()
                        val currentExtra = when (val s = _uiState.value) {
                            is DetailsUiState.Success ->
                                s.reviews.filterNot { it.reviewId in headIds }
                            else -> emptyList()
                        }
                        val merged = (freshReviews + currentExtra)
                            .distinctBy { it.reviewId }

                        if (nextReviewCursor == null) {
                            nextReviewCursor = if (
                                freshReviews.size >= ReviewRepository.DEFAULT_REVIEWS_PAGE_SIZE
                            ) {
                                freshReviews.lastOrNull()?.reviewId
                            } else null
                            _canLoadMoreReviews.value = nextReviewCursor != null
                        }

                        _uiState.value = DetailsUiState.Success(item, merged, myReview)
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun loadMoreReviews() {
        if (_isLoadingMoreReviews.value) return
        if (!_canLoadMoreReviews.value) return
        val cursor = nextReviewCursor ?: return
        if (_loadMoreReviewsError.value != null) return

        _isLoadingMoreReviews.value = true
        _loadMoreReviewsError.value = null

        viewModelScope.launch {
            reviewRepository.loadMoreReviews(
                itemId = itemId,
                lastDocId = cursor,
                limit = ReviewRepository.DEFAULT_REVIEWS_PAGE_SIZE
            ).onSuccess { page ->
                val fresh = enrichWithProfiles(page.items)
                _uiState.update { state ->
                    if (state is DetailsUiState.Success) {
                        val merged = (state.reviews + fresh).distinctBy { it.reviewId }
                        state.copy(reviews = merged)
                    } else state
                }
                nextReviewCursor = page.nextCursor
                _canLoadMoreReviews.value = page.nextCursor != null
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _loadMoreReviewsError.value = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить ещё"
            }
            _isLoadingMoreReviews.value = false
        }
    }

    fun retryLoadMoreReviews() {
        if (_loadMoreReviewsError.value == null) return
        _loadMoreReviewsError.value = null
        loadMoreReviews()
    }

    /**
     * Батч-подмена денормализованных authorName/authorAvatarBase64
     * через `getUsersByIds` (whereIn по 30) + глобальный кэш.
     */
    private suspend fun enrichWithProfiles(reviews: List<Review>): List<Review> {
        if (reviews.isEmpty()) return reviews
        val authorIds = reviews.map { it.userId }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct()
        if (authorIds.isEmpty()) return reviews

        val users: List<User> = runCatching {
            userRepository.getUsersByIds(authorIds)
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (users.isEmpty()) return reviews

        val byId = users.associateBy { it.uid }
        return reviews.map { review ->
            val user = byId[review.userId]
            if (user == null) review
            else review.copy(
                authorName = user.displayName,
                authorAvatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64
            )
        }
    }

    fun retry() {
        _retry.value++
    }

    fun onLike(reviewId: String) {
        val uid = authRepository.currentUid() ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val current = _myReactions.value[reviewId]
            if (current == Reaction.LIKE) {
                reviewRepository.removeReaction(reviewId, uid)
            } else {
                reviewRepository.react(reviewId, uid, Reaction.LIKE)
            }
        }
    }

    fun onDislike(reviewId: String) {
        val uid = authRepository.currentUid() ?: return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val current = _myReactions.value[reviewId]
            if (current == Reaction.DISLIKE) {
                reviewRepository.removeReaction(reviewId, uid)
            } else {
                reviewRepository.react(reviewId, uid, Reaction.DISLIKE)
            }
        }
    }

    private data class Quad(
        val item: Item?,
        val uid: String?,
        val reviews: List<Review>,
        val reactions: Map<String, Reaction?>
    )
}

package com.example.feature.favourite_picker

import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.hilt.navigation.compose.hiltViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.AlertBox
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.BlinkingCursor
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.HorizontalLine
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.ItemRow
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.LabelText
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.component.WireTextField
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.pattern.TerminalScreen
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.pattern.TerminalTopBar
import ru.savushkina.core.designsystem.theme.Spacing

@Composable
fun FavouritePickerScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onItemSelected: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: FavouritePickerViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val query by viewModel.query.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val favouritesLoadError by viewModel.favouritesLoadError.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    FavouritePickerContent(
        query = query,
        state = state,
        favouritesLoadError = favouritesLoadError,
        onQueryChange = viewModel::onQueryChange,
        onBack = onBack,
        onItemSelected = onItemSelected
    )
}

@Composable
fun FavouritePickerContent(
    query: String,
    state: FavouritePickerUiState,
    favouritesLoadError: String? = null,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onItemSelected: (String) -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// выбрать айтем",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            WireTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = onQueryChange,
                label = "поиск",
                placeholder = "начните вводить"
            )

            favouritesLoadError?.let {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                AlertBox(text = it)
            }

            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                when (state) {
                    is FavouritePickerUiState.Idle,
                    is FavouritePickerUiState.Loading -> {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            BlinkingCursor()
                        }
                    }
                    is FavouritePickerUiState.Error -> {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            AlertBox(text = state.message)
                        }
                    }
                    is FavouritePickerUiState.Success -> {
                        if (state.items.isEmpty()) {
                            Box(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
                            ) {
                                LabelText(
                                    text = if (query.isBlank())
                                        "// все айтемы уже в четвёрке"
                                    else
                                        "// ничего не найдено"
                                )
                            }
                        } else {
                            LazyColumn(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                            ) {
                                items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                                    ItemRow(
                                        item = item,
                                        onClick = { onItemSelected(item.id) }
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.example.feature.favourite_picker

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.FlowPreview
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.debounce
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FavouriteRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface FavouritePickerUiState {
    data object Idle : FavouritePickerUiState
    data object Loading : FavouritePickerUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<Item>) : FavouritePickerUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : FavouritePickerUiState
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class, FlowPreview::class)
@HiltViewModel
class FavouritePickerViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val favouriteRepository: FavouriteRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _query = MutableStateFlow("")
    val query = _query.asStateFlow()

    private val _selectedIds = MutableStateFlow<Set<String>>(emptySet())

    /** Ошибка загрузки списка избранного (не блокирует работу). */
    private val _favouritesLoadError = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val favouritesLoadError: StateFlow<String?> = _favouritesLoadError.asStateFlow()

    val uiState: StateFlow<FavouritePickerUiState> = _query
        .debounce(300)
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .combine(_selectedIds) { q, selected -> q.trim() to selected }
        .distinctUntilChanged()
        .flatMapLatest { (q, selected) ->
            flow {
                emit(FavouritePickerUiState.Loading)
                runCatchingCancellable {
                    if (q.isBlank()) itemRepository.getTopRated()
                    else itemRepository.searchByName(q)
                }
                    .onSuccess { items ->
                        emit(
                            FavouritePickerUiState.Success(
                                items.filterNot { it.id in selected }
                            )
                        )
                    }
                    .onFailure {
                        emit(
                            FavouritePickerUiState.Error(
                                it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить"
                            )
                        )
                    }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            FavouritePickerUiState.Loading
        )

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val uid = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
            if (uid == null) {
                _favouritesLoadError.value = "Не авторизован"
                return@launch
            }
            favouriteRepository.observeFavourites(uid)
                .catch { e ->
                    // Не роняем экран — показываем ошибку отдельно.
                    _favouritesLoadError.value =
                        e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить избранное"
                }
                .collect { ids ->
                    _selectedIds.value = ids.toSet()
                    _favouritesLoadError.value = null
                }
        }
    }

    fun onQueryChange(value: String) {
        _query.value = value
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun FeedScreen(
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit,
    viewModel: FeedViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isRefreshing by viewModel.isRefreshing.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    FeedContent(
        state = state,
        isRefreshing = isRefreshing,
        onItemClick = onItemClick,
        onRetry = viewModel::retry,
        onRefresh = viewModel::refresh,
        onLoadMore = viewModel::loadMore,
        onRetryLoadMore = viewModel::retryLoadMore

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun FeedContent(
    state: FeedUiState,
    isRefreshing: Boolean = false,
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onRetry: () -> Unit = {},
    onRefresh: () -> Unit = {},
    onLoadMore: () -> Unit = {},
    onRetryLoadMore: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            SectionHeader(text = "codebox")
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is FeedUiState.Loading -> {
                    SkeletonList(count = 8) {
                        SkeletonItemRow()
                    }
                }
                is FeedUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Column(
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.md)
                        ) {
                            AlertBox(text = state.message)
                            WireButton(
                                text = "повторить",
                                onClick = onRetry,
                                accent = true
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                is FeedUiState.Success -> {
                    if (state.items.isEmpty()) {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            LabelText(text = "// пока нет айтемов")
                        }
                    } else {
                        PullToRefreshBox(
                            isRefreshing = isRefreshing,
                            onRefresh = onRefresh,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                        ) {
                            FeedList(
                                state = state,
                                onItemClick = onItemClick,
                                onLoadMore = onLoadMore,
                                onRetryLoadMore = onRetryLoadMore
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FeedList(
    state: FeedUiState.Success,
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit,
    onLoadMore: () -> Unit,
    onRetryLoadMore: () -> Unit
) {
    val listState = rememberLazyListState()
    val currentOnLoadMore by rememberUpdatedState(onLoadMore)
    val currentState by rememberUpdatedState(state)

    LaunchedEffect(listState) {
        snapshotFlow {
            val layoutInfo = listState.layoutInfo
            val lastVisible = layoutInfo.visibleItemsInfo.lastOrNull()?.index
            val total = layoutInfo.totalItemsCount
            if (lastVisible == null || total == 0) false
            else lastVisible >= total - 3
        }
            .collect { nearEnd ->
                if (nearEnd) {
                    val s = currentState
                    if (s.canLoadMore && !s.isLoadingMore && s.loadMoreError == null) {
                        currentOnLoadMore()
                    }
                }
            }
    }

    LazyColumn(
        state = listState,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = Spacing.lg),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
    ) {
        items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
            ItemRow(item = item, onClick = { onItemClick(item.id) })
        }

        state.loadMoreError?.let { error ->
            item(key = "load_more_error") {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(Spacing.md),
                    horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                    verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                ) {
                    AlertBox(text = error)
                    WireButton(
                        text = "повторить",
                        onClick = onRetryLoadMore,
                        accent = true
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
