package ru.savushkina.feature.feed

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface FeedUiState {
    data object Loading : FeedUiState
    data class Success(
        val items: List<Item>,
        val isLoadingMore: Boolean = false,
        val canLoadMore: Boolean = true,
        val loadMoreError: String? = null
    ) : FeedUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : FeedUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class FeedViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<FeedUiState>(FeedUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _isRefreshing = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isRefreshing = _isRefreshing.asStateFlow()

    private var nextCursor: String? = null

    init {
        loadFirstPage(isRefresh = false)
    }

    /**
     * @param isRefresh true — pull-to-refresh: НЕ сбрасываем UI в Loading,
     *                  показываем индикатор PullToRefreshBox, данные обновятся
     *                  по завершении. false — обычная первая загрузка.
     */
    private fun loadFirstPage(isRefresh: Boolean) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (isRefresh) {
                _isRefreshing.value = true
            } else {
                _uiState.value = FeedUiState.Loading
            }
            nextCursor = null
            try {
                itemRepository.loadItemsPage(PAGE_SIZE, null)
                    .onSuccess { page ->
                        nextCursor = page.nextCursor
                        _uiState.value = FeedUiState.Success(
                            items = page.items,
                            canLoadMore = page.nextCursor != null,
                            loadMoreError = null
                        )
                    }
                    .onFailure { e ->
                        // При refresh ошибку не показываем как полноэкранную —
                        // оставляем старые данные, ошибка видна по индикатору.
                        if (!isRefresh) {
                            _uiState.value = FeedUiState.Error(
                                e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить ленту"
                            )
                        }
                    }
            } finally {
                _isRefreshing.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun refresh() {
        loadFirstPage(isRefresh = true)
    }

    fun loadMore() {
        val current = _uiState.value
        if (current !is FeedUiState.Success) return
        if (current.isLoadingMore || !current.canLoadMore) return
        if (current.loadMoreError != null) return
        val cursor = nextCursor ?: return

        _uiState.value = current.copy(isLoadingMore = true, loadMoreError = null)

        viewModelScope.launch {
            itemRepository.loadItemsPage(PAGE_SIZE, cursor)
                .onSuccess { page ->
                    nextCursor = page.nextCursor
                    _uiState.update { state ->
                        if (state is FeedUiState.Success) {
                            state.copy(
                                items = state.items + page.items,
                                isLoadingMore = false,
                                canLoadMore = page.nextCursor != null,
                                loadMoreError = null
                            )
                        } else state
                    }
                }
                .onFailure { e ->
                    _uiState.update { state ->
                        if (state is FeedUiState.Success) {
                            state.copy(
                                isLoadingMore = false,
                                loadMoreError = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить ещё"
                            )
                        } else state
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun retryLoadMore() {
        val current = _uiState.value as? FeedUiState.Success ?: return
        if (current.loadMoreError == null) return
        _uiState.value = current.copy(loadMoreError = null)
        loadMore()
    }

    fun retry() {
        loadFirstPage(isRefresh = false)
    }

    private companion object {
        const val PAGE_SIZE = 20L
    }
}

                        onValueChange = onUsernameChange,
                        label = "username",
                        placeholder = "придумайте @handle"
                    )

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))

                    LabelText(
                        text = when {
                            state.isCheckingUsername -> "// проверяем..."
                            state.usernameAvailable == true -> "// @${state.username} свободен"
                            state.usernameAvailable == false -> "// @${state.username} занят"
                            else -> "// 3–20 символов, a-z, 0-9, _"
                        },
                        color = when {
                            state.usernameAvailable == true -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                            state.usernameAvailable == false -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                            else -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                        }
                    )

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

                    LabelText(
                        text = "// выберите свою роль",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                    RolePicker(
                        selectedRole = state.role,
                        onRoleSelect = onRoleSelect
                    )

                    state.error?.let {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                        AlertBox(text = it)
                    }

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

                    WireButton(
                        text = if (state.isLoading) "загрузка..." else "сохранить",
                        onClick = onComplete,
                        accent = true,
                        enabled = !state.isLoading
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.onboarding

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.filterNotNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Role
import ru.savushkina.core.model.UserConstraints
import javax.inject.Inject

data class OnboardingState(
    val name: String = "",
    val username: String = "",
    val role: Role? = null,
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isCheckingUsername: Boolean = false,
    val usernameAvailable: Boolean? = null,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class OnboardingViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val sessionRepository: SessionRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(OnboardingState())
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    /** Текущая корутина проверки username — чтобы отменять при новом вводе. */
    private var usernameCheckJob: Job? = null

    fun onNameChange(value: String) {
        _state.update { it.copy(name = value, error = null) }
    }

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        val clean = value.lowercase().removePrefix("@").filter { it.isLetterOrDigit() || it == '_' }
        _state.update {
            it.copy(
                username = clean,
                error = null,
                usernameAvailable = null,
                isCheckingUsername = false
            )
        }
        scheduleUsernameCheck(clean)
    }

    private fun scheduleUsernameCheck(username: String) {
        usernameCheckJob?.cancel()
        if (username.isBlank()) return

        val validation = validateUsername(username)
        if (validation != null) {
            _state.update { it.copy(usernameAvailable = false) }
            return
        }

        usernameCheckJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            delay(500)
            _state.update { it.copy(isCheckingUsername = true, usernameAvailable = null) }
            userRepository.isUsernameAvailable(username)
                .onSuccess { available ->
                    _state.update {
                        it.copy(
                            isCheckingUsername = false,
                            usernameAvailable = available,
                            error = if (available) null else "Этот username уже занят"
                        )
                    }
                }
                .onFailure {
                    _state.update {
                        it.copy(
                            isCheckingUsername = false,
                            usernameAvailable = null,
                            error = it.error ?: "Не удалось проверить username"
                        )
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun onRoleSelect(role: Role) {
        _state.update { it.copy(role = role, error = null) }
    }

    fun complete() {
        val name = _state.value.name.trim()
        val username = _state.value.username.trim()
        val role = _state.value.role

        validate(name, username, role)?.let {
            _state.update { s -> s.copy(error = it) }
            return
        }
        if (_state.value.isLoading) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.update { it.copy(isLoading = true, error = null) }

            runCatchingCancellable {
                val authUser = authRepository.authState.filterNotNull().first()
                val email = authUser.email
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("Email не найден в профиле")

                userRepository.saveOnboarding(
                    uid = authUser.uid,
                    email = email,
                    name = name,
                    username = username,
                    role = role!!
                ).getOrThrow()
            }.onSuccess {
                _state.update { it.copy(isLoading = false) }
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _state.update {
                    it.copy(
                        isLoading = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Не удалось сохранить"
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun signOut() {
        sessionRepository.signOut()
    }

    private fun validate(name: String, username: String, role: Role?): String? {
        if (name.isBlank()) return "Введите имя"
        if (name.length > UserConstraints.NAME_MAX) {
            return "Имя слишком длинное (максимум ${UserConstraints.NAME_MAX} символов)"
        }
        validateUsername(username)?.let { return it }
        if (role == null) return "Выберите роль"
        return null
    }

    private fun validateUsername(username: String): String? {
        val clean = username.trim().lowercase().removePrefix("@")
        return when {
            clean.isBlank() -> "Придумайте username"
            clean.length < UserConstraints.USERNAME_MIN ->
                "Username слишком короткий (минимум ${UserConstraints.USERNAME_MIN})"
            clean.length > UserConstraints.USERNAME_MAX ->
                "Username слишком длинный (максимум ${UserConstraints.USERNAME_MAX})"
            !UserConstraints.USERNAME_REGEX.matches(clean) ->
                "Только lowercase латиница, цифры и _"
            else -> null
        }
    }
}

@Composable

    viewModel: FollowListViewModel = hiltViewModel()

@Composable
fun FollowListContent(
    title: String,
    state: FollowListUiState,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onUserClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onRetry: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = title,
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is FollowListUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is FollowListUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        Column(
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.md)
                        ) {
                            AlertBox(text = state.message)
                            WireButton(
                                text = "повторить",
                                onClick = onRetry,
                                accent = true
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                is FollowListUiState.Success -> {
                    if (state.users.isEmpty()) {
                        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                            LabelText(text = "// пока пусто")
                        }
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                        ) {
                            items(state.users, key = { it.uid }) { user ->
                                FollowUserRow(user = user, onClick = { onUserClick(user.uid) })
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FollowUserRow(user: User, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .clickable(onClick = onClick)
                .padding(Spacing.md),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            WireAvatar(
                avatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64,
                fallbackText = user.initials,
                size = 40.dp
            )
            Spacer(Modifier.padding(start = Spacing.md))
            Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                Text(
                    text = user.displayName,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                )
                if (user.handle.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                    LabelText(
                        text = user.handle,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.profile

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FollowRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.FollowListMode
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface FollowListUiState {
    data object Loading : FollowListUiState
    data class Success(val users: List<User>) : FollowListUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : FollowListUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class FollowListViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val followRepository: FollowRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    val mode: FollowListMode = FollowListMode.fromRoute(
        Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("mode"))
    )

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<FollowListUiState>(FollowListUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        load()
    }

    fun retry() = load()

    private fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = FollowListUiState.Loading
            runCatchingCancellable {
                val uid = userRepository.currentUser.value?.uid
                    ?: throw IllegalStateException("Не авторизован")

                val ids: List<String> = when (mode) {
                    FollowListMode.FOLLOWERS ->
                        followRepository.observeFollowers(uid).firstOrNull().orEmpty()
                    FollowListMode.FOLLOWING ->
                        followRepository.observeFollowing(uid).firstOrNull().orEmpty()
                }
                if (ids.isEmpty()) return@runCatchingCancellable emptyList()

                userRepository.getUsersByIds(ids)
            }.onSuccess { users ->
                _uiState.value = FollowListUiState.Success(users)
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _uiState.value = FollowListUiState.Error(
                    e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить список"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun ProfileScreen(

        followersCount = followersCount,

@Composable
fun ProfileContent(
    state: ProfileUiState,
    reviews: List<Review> = emptyList(),
    favourites: List<Item> = emptyList(),
    isOwnProfile: Boolean = true,
    currentUserId: String? = null,
    error: String? = null,

    onBack: () -> Unit = {},

                            modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)

                right = if (isOwnProfile) {

                                .size(Sizes.iconMd)
                                .clickable(onClick = onSettingsClick)
                        )

            )

            if (error != null) {
                AlertBox(text = error)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {

                    Column(

                        SkeletonProfileHeader()
                        repeat(3) {

                is ProfileUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is ProfileUiState.Success -> {
                    PullToRefreshBox(
                        isRefreshing = isRefreshing,
                        onRefresh = onRefresh,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
                    ) {
                        ProfileBody(
                            user = state.user,
                            reviews = reviews,
                            favourites = favourites,
                            isOwnProfile = isOwnProfile,
                            currentUserId = currentUserId,
                            followersCount = followersCount,
                            followingCount = followingCount,
                            isFollowing = isFollowing,
                            followActionLoading = followActionLoading,
                            onReviewClick = onReviewClick,
                            onAddFavouriteClick = onAddFavouriteClick,
                            onRemoveFavourite = onRemoveFavourite,
                            onCollectionsClick = onCollectionsClick,
                            onFollowersClick = onFollowersClick,
                            onFollowingClick = onFollowingClick,
                            onToggleFollow = onToggleFollow
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

@Composable
private fun ProfileBody(
    user: User,
    reviews: List<Review>,
    favourites: List<Item>,
    isOwnProfile: Boolean,
    currentUserId: String?,
    followersCount: Int,
    followingCount: Int,
    isFollowing: Boolean,
    followActionLoading: Boolean,
    onReviewClick: (reviewId: String) -> Unit,
    onAddFavouriteClick: (slotIndex: Int) -> Unit,
    onRemoveFavourite: (String) -> Unit,
    onCollectionsClick: () -> Unit,
    onFollowersClick: () -> Unit,
    onFollowingClick: () -> Unit,
    onToggleFollow: () -> Unit
) {
    LazyColumn(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = Spacing.xxl),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
    ) {
        item(key = "header") {
            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxWidth()
                    .padding(vertical = Spacing.lg),
                horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally
            ) {
                WireAvatar(
                    avatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64,
                    fallbackText = user.initials,
                    size = 120.dp
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
                Text(
                    text = user.displayName,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                    textAlign = TextAlign.Center,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                )
                if (user.handle.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                    LabelText(
                        text = user.handle,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
                    )
                }
                user.role?.let { role ->
                    if (role != Role.DO_NOT_SPECIFY) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                        KeyValueRow(key = "role", value = role.displayName, accent = true)
                    }
                }
                if (user.description.isNotBlank()) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(Spacing.md)) {
                            LabelText(text = "about")
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xs))
                            Text(
                                text = user.description,
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                FollowStatsRow(
                    isOwnProfile = isOwnProfile,
                    followersCount = followersCount,
                    followingCount = followingCount,
                    onFollowersClick = onFollowersClick,
                    onFollowingClick = onFollowingClick
                )

                if (!isOwnProfile && currentUserId != null) {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
                    WireButton(
                        text = when {
                            followActionLoading -> "..."
                            isFollowing -> "отписаться"
                            else -> "подписаться"
                        },
                        onClick = onToggleFollow,
                        accent = !isFollowing,
                        enabled = !followActionLoading
                    )
                }
            }
        }

        item(key = "favourites") {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                FavouriteFourSection(
                    favourites = favourites,
                    isOwnProfile = isOwnProfile,
                    onSlotClick = onAddFavouriteClick,
                    onRemoveFavourite = onRemoveFavourite
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                WireButton(text = "коллекции", onClick = onCollectionsClick)
            }
        }

        item(key = "reviews_header") {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))
            SectionHeader(text = if (isOwnProfile) "мои отзывы" else "отзывы")
        }

        if (reviews.isEmpty()) {
            item(key = "reviews_empty") {
                LabelText(text = "// пока нет отзывов")
            }
        } else {
            items(reviews, key = { it.reviewId }) { review ->
                val isMine = currentUserId != null && review.userId == currentUserId
                ReviewRow(
                    review = review,
                    isMine = isMine,
                    onCardClick = { onReviewClick(review.reviewId) },
                    onCommentsClick = { onReviewClick(review.reviewId) }
                )
            }
        }
    }

/**
 * Счётчики подписчиков/подписок.
 *
 * В своём профиле оба счётчика кликабельны (открывают список).
 * В чужом профиле — только «подписчики» показываются числом, БЕЗ перехода;
 * «подписки» в чужом профиле не показываем вовсе.
 */
@Composable
private fun FollowStatsRow(
    isOwnProfile: Boolean,
    followersCount: Int,
    followingCount: Int,
    onFollowersClick: () -> Unit,
    onFollowingClick: () -> Unit
) {
    WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .padding(vertical = Spacing.md),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceEvenly,
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
        ) {
            // Подписчики — видны всегда.
            FollowStatItem(
                value = followersCount.toString(),
                label = "подписчики",
                clickable = isOwnProfile,
                onClick = onFollowersClick
            )

            if (isOwnProfile) {
                // Подписки — только в своём профиле.
                FollowStatItem(
                    value = followingCount.toString(),
                    label = "подписки",
                    clickable = true,
                    onClick = onFollowingClick
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun FollowStatItem(
    value: String,
    label: String,
    clickable: Boolean,
    onClick: () -> Unit
) {
    Column(
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        modifier = Modifier
            .then(if (clickable) Modifier.clickable(onClick = onClick) else Modifier)
            .padding(horizontal = Spacing.lg, vertical = Spacing.xs)
    ) {
        Text(
            text = value,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineSmall,
            color = if (clickable) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
        LabelText(
            text = label,
            color = if (clickable) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
            else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Хелпер для навигации из CodeboxNavHost — какой экран открывать.
 */
fun FollowListMode.routeTitle(): String = when (this) {
    FollowListMode.FOLLOWERS -> "// подписчики"
    FollowListMode.FOLLOWING -> "// подписки"
}

FILE [155/192]: feature/profile/src/main/java/ru/savushkina/feature/profile/ProfileViewModel.kt

package ru.savushkina.feature.profile

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.filterNotNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flatMapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flowOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FavouriteRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.FollowRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.SessionRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.AddFavouriteResult
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.model.SessionState
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface ProfileUiState {
    data object Loading : ProfileUiState
    data class Success(val user: User) : ProfileUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : ProfileUiState
}

private data class FollowCounts(
    val followers: Int = 0,
    val following: Int = 0
)

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
@HiltViewModel
class ProfileViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val sessionRepository: SessionRepository,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val favouriteRepository: FavouriteRepository,
    private val followRepository: FollowRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val targetUserId: String? = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("userId"))
        .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }

    val currentUserId: StateFlow<String?> = sessionRepository.sessionState
        .map { state ->
            when (state) {
                is SessionState.Authenticated -> state.user.uid
                is SessionState.Onboarding -> state.userId
                is SessionState.ProfileLoadError -> state.userId
                else -> null
            }
        }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), null)

    val isOwnProfile: StateFlow<Boolean> = currentUserId
        .map { targetUserId == null || targetUserId == it }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), targetUserId == null)

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<ProfileUiState>(ProfileUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _reviews = MutableStateFlow<List<Review>>(emptyList())
    val reviews = _reviews.asStateFlow()

    private val _favourites = MutableStateFlow<List<Item>>(emptyList())
    val favourites = _favourites.asStateFlow()

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    private val _isRefreshing = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isRefreshing = _isRefreshing.asStateFlow()

    private val _refreshTrigger = MutableStateFlow(0)

    // ── Подписки ──

    private val _followersCount = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val followersCount = _followersCount.asStateFlow()

    private val _followingCount = MutableStateFlow(0)
    val followingCount = _followingCount.asStateFlow()

    /** true, если текущий пользователь подписан на target (в чужом профиле). */
    val isFollowing: StateFlow<Boolean> = combine(
        currentUserId,
        _refreshTrigger
    ) { uid, _ -> uid }
        .flatMapLatest { uid ->
            val target = targetUserId
            if (uid == null || target == null || uid == target) {
                flowOf(false)
            } else {
                followRepository.observeIsFollowing(uid, target)
                    .catch { emit(false) }
            }
        }
        .stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000), false)

    private val _followActionLoading = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val followActionLoading = _followActionLoading.asStateFlow()

    init {
        observeProfile()
        observeReviewsAndFavourites()
        observeFollowCounts()
    }

    fun refresh() {
        if (_isRefreshing.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isRefreshing.value = true
            try {
                if (targetUserId != null) {
                    val user = runCatching { userRepository.getUser(targetUserId) }.getOrNull()
                    if (user != null) {
                        _uiState.value = ProfileUiState.Success(user)
                    }
                }
                _refreshTrigger.value++
            } finally {
                _isRefreshing.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeProfile() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            if (targetUserId == null) {
                userRepository.currentUser.collect { user ->
                    _uiState.value = if (user != null) {
                        ProfileUiState.Success(user)
                    } else {
                        ProfileUiState.Error("Профиль не найден")
                    }
                }
            } else {
                val current = currentUserId.filterNotNull().first()
                val isOwn = targetUserId == current
                val user = runCatchingCancellable {
                    if (isOwn) userRepository.refresh(targetUserId).getOrNull()
                    else userRepository.getUser(targetUserId)
                }.getOrNull()

                _uiState.value = if (user != null) ProfileUiState.Success(user)
                else ProfileUiState.Error("Профиль не найден")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeReviewsAndFavourites() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _refreshTrigger
                .flatMapLatest { currentUserId }
                .flatMapLatest { uid ->
                    if (uid == null) {
                        flowOf(emptyList<Review>())
                    } else {
                        val profileUid = targetUserId ?: uid
                        reviewRepository.observeReviewsForUser(profileUid)
                            .catch { _reviews.value = emptyList() }
                    }
                }
                .collect { reviews ->
                    _reviews.value = enrichReviewsWithProfiles(reviews)
                }
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _refreshTrigger
                .flatMapLatest { currentUserId }
                .flatMapLatest { uid ->
                    if (uid == null) {
                        flowOf(emptyList<Item>())
                    } else {
                        val profileUid = targetUserId ?: uid
                        favouriteRepository.observeFavourites(profileUid)
                            .map { ids -> itemRepository.getItemsByIds(ids) }
                            .catch { _favourites.value = emptyList() }
                    }
                }
                .collect { _favourites.value = it }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Счётчики подписок.
     *
     * ВАЖНО:
     * - в своём профиле (targetUserId == null) — обновляются в реальном времени
     *   через observeFollowers/observeFollowing (Flow);
     * - в чужом профиле — один раз через getFollowCounts (count() не слушает).
     */
    private fun observeFollowCounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _refreshTrigger
                .flatMapLatest { currentUserId }
                .flatMapLatest<String?, FollowCounts> { uid ->
                    val profileUid = targetUserId ?: uid
                    when {
                        profileUid == null -> flowOf(FollowCounts())
                        targetUserId == null -> {
                            // Свой профиль — live-подписка на оба счётчика.
                            combine(
                                followRepository.observeFollowers(profileUid)
                                    .map { it.size }
                                    .catch { emit(0) },
                                followRepository.observeFollowing(profileUid)
                                    .map { it.size }
                                    .catch { emit(0) }
                            ) { followers, following ->
                                FollowCounts(followers, following)
                            }
                        }
                        else -> {
                            // Чужой профиль — один раз, без live-подписки.
                            val result: Result<Pair<Int, Int>> = runCatching {
                                followRepository.getFollowCounts(profileUid)
                            }.getOrElse { Result.failure(it) }

                            val pair: Pair<Int, Int>? = result.getOrNull()
                            val counts = if (pair != null) {
                                FollowCounts(pair.first, pair.second)
                            } else {
                                FollowCounts()
                            }
                            flowOf(counts)
                        }
                    }
                }
                .collect { counts ->
                    _followersCount.value = counts.followers
                    _followingCount.value = counts.following
                }
        }
    }

    fun toggleFollow() {
        val target = targetUserId ?: return
        val uid = currentUserId.value ?: run {
            _error.value = "Не авторизован"
            return
        }
        if (uid == target) return
        if (_followActionLoading.value) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _followActionLoading.value = true
            try {
                if (isFollowing.value) {
                    followRepository.unfollow(uid, target).onFailure {
                        _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось отписаться"
                    }
                } else {
                    followRepository.follow(uid, target).onFailure {
                        _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось подписаться"
                    }
                }
                // Обновляем счётчики после действия.
                followRepository.getFollowCounts(target).onSuccess { counts ->
                    _followersCount.value = counts.first
                    _followingCount.value = counts.second
                }
            } finally {
                _followActionLoading.value = false
            }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun enrichReviewsWithProfiles(reviews: List<Review>): List<Review> {
        if (reviews.isEmpty()) return reviews
        val authorIds = reviews.map { it.userId }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct()
        if (authorIds.isEmpty()) return reviews

        val users = runCatching { userRepository.getUsersByIds(authorIds) }
            .getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (users.isEmpty()) return reviews

        val byId = users.associateBy { it.uid }
        return reviews.map { review ->
            val user = byId[review.userId]
            if (user == null) review
            else review.copy(
                authorName = user.displayName,
                authorAvatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64
            )
        }
    }

    fun addFavourite(itemId: String) {
        val uid = currentUserId.value ?: run {
            _error.value = "Не авторизован"
            return
        }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            favouriteRepository.addFavourite(uid, itemId)
                .onSuccess { result ->
                    _error.value = when (result) {
                        AddFavouriteResult.Added -> null
                        AddFavouriteResult.AlreadyExists -> "Уже в избранном"
                        AddFavouriteResult.LimitReached -> "Максимум 4 избранных"
                    }
                }
                .onFailure { _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось добавить" }
        }
    }

    fun removeFavourite(itemId: String) {
        val uid = currentUserId.value ?: run {
            _error.value = "Не авторизован"
            return
        }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            favouriteRepository.removeFavourite(uid, itemId)
                .onFailure { _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось убрать" }
        }
    }

    fun clearError() {
        _error.value = null
    }

    fun signOut() = sessionRepository.signOut()
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.review

import androidx.compose.foundation.background
import androidx.compose.foundation.clickable

@Composable
fun ReviewDetailScreen(
    onBack: () -> Unit,
    onAuthorClick: (userId: String) -> Unit,
    currentUserId: String?,
    viewModel: ReviewDetailViewModel = hiltViewModel()
) {
    val state by viewModel.uiState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val comments by viewModel.comments.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val commentsLoaded by viewModel.commentsLoaded.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val draft by viewModel.commentDraft.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isSending by viewModel.isSendingComment.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val canLoadMore by viewModel.canLoadMoreComments.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val isLoadingMore by viewModel.isLoadingMoreComments.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val error by viewModel.error.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()

    ReviewDetailContent(
        state = state,
        comments = comments,
        commentsLoaded = commentsLoaded,
        commentDraft = draft,
        isSendingComment = isSending,
        canLoadMoreComments = canLoadMore,
        isLoadingMoreComments = isLoadingMore,
        currentUserId = currentUserId,
        error = error,
        onBack = onBack,
        onAuthorClick = onAuthorClick,
        onCommentDraftChange = viewModel::onCommentDraftChange,
        onSubmitComment = { onDone -> viewModel.submitComment(onDone) },
        onDeleteComment = viewModel::deleteComment,
        onLoadMoreComments = viewModel::loadMoreComments
    )
}

@Composable
fun ReviewDetailContent(
    state: ReviewDetailUiState,
    comments: List<ReviewComment> = emptyList(),
    commentsLoaded: Boolean = false,
    commentDraft: String = "",
    isSendingComment: Boolean = false,
    canLoadMoreComments: Boolean = false,
    isLoadingMoreComments: Boolean = false,
    currentUserId: String? = null,
    error: String? = null,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onAuthorClick: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onCommentDraftChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onSubmitComment: (onDone: () -> Unit) -> Unit = { it() },
    onDeleteComment: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onLoadMoreComments: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    // rememberSaveable — переживает поворот экрана
    var inputVisible by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }

    TerminalScreen {
        Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                TerminalTopBar(
                    title = "// отзыв",
                    left = {
                        LabelText(
                            text = "< назад",
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                            modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                        )
                    }
                )
                HorizontalLine()
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                val isReady = state is ReviewDetailUiState.Success && commentsLoaded

                if (!isReady) {
                    when (state) {
                        is ReviewDetailUiState.Error -> {
                            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                AlertBox(text = state.message)
                            }
                        }
                        else -> {
                            Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                                BlinkingCursor()
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else if (state is ReviewDetailUiState.Success) {
                    val review = state.review
                    val isMine = currentUserId != null && review.userId == currentUserId

                    LazyColumn(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                        contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 100.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.xs)
                    ) {
                        item(key = "review_card") {
                            WireFrame(
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                                accent = isMine
                            ) {
                                Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(Spacing.md)) {
                                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                        Box(
                                            modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                                                onAuthorClick(review.userId)
                                            }
                                        ) {
                                            WireAvatar(
                                                avatarBase64 = review.authorAvatarBase64,
                                                fallbackText = review.authorName
                                                    .take(2).uppercase().ifBlank { "??" },
                                                size = 40.dp
                                            )
                                        }
                                        Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.sm))
                                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                            Text(
                                                text = review.authorName.ifBlank { "аноним" },
                                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                                                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                                                modifier = Modifier.clickable {
                                                    onAuthorClick(review.userId)
                                                }
                                            )
                                            if (review.itemName.isNotBlank()) {
                                                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                                                LabelText(text = review.itemName)
                                            }
                                        }
                                        RatingStars(rating = review.rating, size = 16)
                                    }
                                    if (review.hasComment) {
                                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                                        Text(
                                            text = review.comment,
                                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onBackground
                                        )
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        item(key = "comments_header") {
                            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))
                            SectionHeader(text = "комментарии")
                        }

                        if (comments.isEmpty()) {
                            item(key = "comments_empty") {
                                LabelText(text = "// пока нет комментариев")
                            }
                        } else {
                            items(comments, key = { it.id }) { c ->
                                val isCommentMine =
                                    currentUserId != null && c.authorId == currentUserId
                                CommentRow(
                                    comment = c,
                                    isMine = isCommentMine,
                                    canDelete = isCommentMine,
                                    onDelete = { onDeleteComment(c.id) },
                                    onAuthorClick = onAuthorClick
                                )
                            }
                        }

                        if (canLoadMoreComments) {
                            item(key = "load_more") {
                                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                                WireButton(
                                    text = if (isLoadingMoreComments) "загрузка..."
                                    else "показать ещё",
                                    onClick = onLoadMoreComments,
                                    enabled = !isLoadingMoreComments
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (state is ReviewDetailUiState.Success && commentsLoaded) {
                FloatingActionButton(
                    onClick = { inputVisible = true },
                    containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                    contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimary,
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .align(Alignment.BottomEnd)
                        .padding(Spacing.lg)
                ) {
                    Icon(
                        imageVector = Icons.Filled.Add,
                        contentDescription = "Добавить комментарий"
                    )
                }
            }

            if (inputVisible) {
                CommentInputDialog(
                    value = commentDraft,
                    onValueChange = onCommentDraftChange,
                    onDismiss = { inputVisible = false },
                    onSubmit = { onSubmitComment { inputVisible = false } },
                    isSubmitting = isSendingComment,
                    error = error
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CommentInputDialog(
    value: String,
    onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onSubmit: () -> Unit,
    isSubmitting: Boolean,
    error: String? = null
) {
    Dialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        properties = DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false)
    ) {
        Box(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth(0.9f)
                .wrapContentHeight()
                .imePadding()
        ) {
            WireFrame(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                Column(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .fillMaxWidth()
                        .background(MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background)   // ← непрозрачный фон
                        .padding(Spacing.md)
                ) {
                    LabelText(text = "// новый комментарий")
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                    WireTextField(
                        value = value,
                        onValueChange = onValueChange,
                        placeholder = "текст комментария",
                        singleLine = false,
                        minHeight = 140.dp,
                        enabled = !isSubmitting
                    )

                    error?.let {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                        AlertBox(text = it)
                    }

                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                    ) {
                        Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            WireButton(
                                text = "отмена",
                                onClick = onDismiss,
                                enabled = !isSubmitting
                            )
                        }
                        Box(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                            WireButton(
                                text = if (isSubmitting) "..." else "отправить",
                                onClick = onSubmit,
                                accent = true,
                                enabled = !isSubmitting && value.isNotBlank()
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.review

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.catch
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ItemConstraints
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ReviewComment
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

sealed interface ReviewDetailUiState {
    data object Loading : ReviewDetailUiState
    data class Success(val review: Review) : ReviewDetailUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : ReviewDetailUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class ReviewDetailViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val reviewId: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("reviewId"))

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<ReviewDetailUiState>(ReviewDetailUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    private val _comments = MutableStateFlow<List<ReviewComment>>(emptyList())
    val comments = _comments.asStateFlow()

    private val _commentsLoaded = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val commentsLoaded = _commentsLoaded.asStateFlow()

    private val _commentDraft = MutableStateFlow("")
    val commentDraft = _commentDraft.asStateFlow()

    private val _isSendingComment = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isSendingComment = _isSendingComment.asStateFlow()

    private val _canLoadMoreComments = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val canLoadMoreComments = _canLoadMoreComments.asStateFlow()

    private val _isLoadingMoreComments = MutableStateFlow(false)
    val isLoadingMoreComments = _isLoadingMoreComments.asStateFlow()

    private val _error = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val error = _error.asStateFlow()

    private var hasLoadedMoreThanPage = false

    init {
        val parsed = Review.parseReviewId(reviewId)
        if (parsed == null) {
            _uiState.value = ReviewDetailUiState.Error("Некорректный ID отзыва")
        } else {
            val (userId, itemId) = parsed
            load(userId, itemId)
            observeComments()
        }
    }

    private fun load(userId: String, itemId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val review = reviewRepository.getReview(userId, itemId)
            _uiState.value = if (review != null) {
                val fresh = enrichReviewsWithProfiles(listOf(review)).first()
                ReviewDetailUiState.Success(fresh)
            } else {
                ReviewDetailUiState.Error("Отзыв не найден")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun observeComments() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            reviewRepository.observeComments(reviewId)
                .catch { e ->
                    _error.value = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить комментарии"
                    _commentsLoaded.value = true
                }
                .collect { tail ->
                    val hasMore = tail.size > ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE
                    val visible = if (hasMore)
                        tail.takeLast(ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE.toInt())
                    else tail
                    val visibleIds = visible.map { it.id }.toSet()
                    val head = _comments.value.filterNot { it.id in visibleIds }

                    val merged = (head + visible)
                        .distinctBy { it.id }
                        .sortedWith(
                            compareBy<ReviewComment> { it.createdAtMillis }
                                .thenBy { it.id }
                        )

                    _comments.value = enrichCommentsWithProfiles(merged)
                    _commentsLoaded.value = true

                    if (!hasLoadedMoreThanPage) {
                        _canLoadMoreComments.value = hasMore
                    }
                }
        }
    }

    fun loadMoreComments() {
        val oldest = _comments.value.firstOrNull() ?: return
        if (_isLoadingMoreComments.value) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isLoadingMoreComments.value = true
            runCatchingCancellable {
                reviewRepository.loadMoreComments(
                    reviewId = reviewId,
                    lastCreatedAtMillis = oldest.createdAtMillis,
                    lastId = oldest.id
                ).getOrThrow()
            }.onSuccess { more ->
                val existingIds = _comments.value.map { it.id }.toSet()
                val newOnes = more.filterNot { it.id in existingIds }
                val merged = (_comments.value + newOnes)
                    .distinctBy { it.id }
                    .sortedWith(
                        compareBy<ReviewComment> { it.createdAtMillis }
                            .thenBy { it.id }
                    )
                _comments.value = enrichCommentsWithProfiles(merged)
                _canLoadMoreComments.value =
                    more.size >= ItemConstraints.COMMENTS_PAGE_SIZE
                if (more.isNotEmpty()) {
                    hasLoadedMoreThanPage = true
                }
            }.onFailure {
                _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить комментарии"
            }
            _isLoadingMoreComments.value = false
        }
    }

    fun onCommentDraftChange(value: String) {
        _commentDraft.value = value
    }

    fun submitComment(onSuccess: () -> Unit = {}) {
        val text = _commentDraft.value.trim()
        if (text.isBlank()) { _error.value = "Комментарий пустой"; return }
        if (text.length > ItemConstraints.COMMENT_MAX) {
            _error.value = "Комментарий слишком длинный"; return
        }

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _isSendingComment.value = true
            val uid = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
            if (uid == null) {
                _error.value = "Не авторизован"
                _isSendingComment.value = false
                return@launch
            }
            val currentUser = userRepository.currentUser.value
            reviewRepository.addComment(
                ReviewComment(
                    reviewId = reviewId,
                    authorId = uid,
                    authorName = currentUser?.displayName ?: "",
                    authorAvatarBase64 = currentUser?.avatarBase64 ?: "",
                    text = text
                )
            )
                .onSuccess {
                    _commentDraft.value = ""
                    _error.value = null
                    onSuccess()
                }
                .onFailure {
                    _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось отправить комментарий"
                }
            _isSendingComment.value = false
        }
    }

    fun deleteComment(commentId: String) {
        val removed = _comments.value.find { it.id == commentId }
        _comments.value = _comments.value.filterNot { it.id == commentId }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            reviewRepository.deleteComment(reviewId, commentId)
                .onFailure {
                    if (removed != null) {
                        _comments.value = (_comments.value + removed)
                            .distinctBy { it.id }
                            .sortedWith(
                                compareBy<ReviewComment> { it.createdAtMillis }
                                    .thenBy { it.id }
                            )
                    }
                    _error.value = it.message ?: "Не удалось удалить"
                }
        }
    }

    private suspend fun enrichReviewsWithProfiles(reviews: List<Review>): List<Review> {
        if (reviews.isEmpty()) return reviews
        val ids = reviews.map { it.userId }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct()
        if (ids.isEmpty()) return reviews
        val users = runCatching { userRepository.getUsersByIds(ids) }
            .getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (users.isEmpty()) return reviews
        val byId = users.associateBy { it.uid }
        return reviews.map { review ->
            val user: User = byId[review.userId] ?: return@map review
            review.copy(
                authorName = user.displayName,
                authorAvatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64
            )
        }
    }

    private suspend fun enrichCommentsWithProfiles(
        comments: List<ReviewComment>
    ): List<ReviewComment> {
        if (comments.isEmpty()) return comments
        val ids = comments.mapNotNull { it.authorId }.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.distinct()
        if (ids.isEmpty()) return comments
        val users = runCatching { userRepository.getUsersByIds(ids) }
            .getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (users.isEmpty()) return comments
        val byId = users.associateBy { it.uid }
        return comments.map { comment ->
            val uid = comment.authorId ?: return@map comment
            val user = byId[uid] ?: return@map comment
            comment.copy(
                authorName = user.displayName,
                authorAvatarBase64 = user.avatarBase64
            )
        }
    }
}

                    }

                            LabelText(text = "// пока нет реакций")
                        }
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),

                                            .padding(Spacing.md),

                                    ) {
                                        WireAvatar(
                                            avatarBase64 = entry.user.avatarBase64,
                                            fallbackText = entry.user.initials,
                                            size = 36.dp
                                        )
                                        Spacer(Modifier.width(Spacing.sm))
                                        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
                                            Text(

                                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall,

                                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium

                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

package ru.savushkina.feature.review

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Reaction
import ru.savushkina.core.model.User
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

data class ReactionUser(
    val user: User,
    val reaction: Reaction,
    val createdAtMillis: Long
)

sealed interface ReactionsUiState {
    data object Loading : ReactionsUiState
    data class Success(val items: List<ReactionUser>) : ReactionsUiState
    data class Error(val message: String) : ReactionsUiState
}

@HiltViewModel
class ReviewReactionsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val reviewId: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("reviewId"))

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow<ReactionsUiState>(ReactionsUiState.Loading)
    val uiState = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        load()
    }

    fun retry() = load()

    private fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = ReactionsUiState.Loading
            runCatchingCancellable {
                val reactions = reviewRepository.observeReactionsForReview(reviewId)
                    .let { flow ->
                        // Берём первый snapshot — для экрана «список» live не нужен.
                        kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first(flow)
                    }
                val uids = reactions.map { it.userId }.distinct()
                val users = userRepository.getUsersByIds(uids).associateBy { it.uid }
                reactions.mapNotNull { r ->
                    val user = users[r.userId] ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    ReactionUser(
                        user = user,
                        reaction = r.reaction,
                        createdAtMillis = r.createdAtMillis
                    )
                }.sortedByDescending { it.createdAtMillis }
            }.onSuccess { _uiState.value = ReactionsUiState.Success(it) }
                .onFailure { _uiState.value = ReactionsUiState.Error(it.message ?: "Ошибка") }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun ReviewContent(
    state: ReviewFormState,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onRatingChange: (Int) -> Unit = {},
    onCommentChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onSave: () -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {

                Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                    BlinkingCursor()
                }
                return@Column
            }

            Column(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            ) {
                state.item?.let { item ->
                    Text(
                        text = item.name,
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
                    )
                    if (item.type.isNotBlank()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xxs))
                        LabelText(text = item.type)
                    }
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))

                LabelText(text = "// ваша оценка")
                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.sm))
                RatingStars(
                    rating = state.rating,
                    onRatingChange = onRatingChange,
                    size = 32
                )

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.lg))

                WireTextField(
                    value = state.comment,
                    onValueChange = onCommentChange,
                    label = "комментарий",
                    placeholder = "поделитесь впечатлением",
                    singleLine = false,
                    enabled = !state.isSaving
                )

                state.error?.let {
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))
                    AlertBox(text = it)
                }

                Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.xl))

                WireButton(
                    text = if (state.isSaving) "сохранение..." else "сохранить",
                    onClick = onSave,
                    accent = true,
                    enabled = !state.isSaving
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.savushkina.feature.review

import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.firstOrNull
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import ru.savushkina.core.common.runCatchingCancellable
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.AuthRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ItemRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.ReviewRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.domain.UserRepository
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Item
import ru.savushkina.core.model.ItemConstraints
import ru.savushkina.core.model.Review
import ru.savushkina.core.navigation.Routes
import javax.inject.Inject

data class ReviewFormState(
    val item: Item? = null,
    val rating: Int = 0,
    val comment: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isSaving: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class ReviewViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val savedStateHandle: SavedStateHandle,
    private val itemRepository: ItemRepository,
    private val reviewRepository: ReviewRepository,
    private val userRepository: UserRepository,
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val itemId: String = Routes.decode(savedStateHandle.get<String>("itemId"))
    private var currentUserId: String? = null

    private val _state = MutableStateFlow(
        ReviewFormState(
            isLoading = true,
            rating = savedStateHandle.get<Int>(KEY_RATING) ?: 0,
            comment = savedStateHandle.get<String>(KEY_COMMENT).orEmpty()
        )
    )
    val state = _state.asStateFlow()

    init {
        if (itemId.isBlank()) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                isLoading = false,
                error = "Некорректный ID айтема"
            )
        } else {
            load()
        }
    }

    private fun load() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            currentUserId = authRepository.authState.firstOrNull()?.uid
            runCatchingCancellable {
                val item = itemRepository.getItemById(itemId)
                val existing = currentUserId?.let { reviewRepository.getReview(it, itemId) }
                item to existing
            }.onSuccess { (item, existing) ->
                // Если в SavedStateHandle уже есть черновик (rating/comment),
                // не перезатираем его данными из существующего отзыва.
                val hasDraftRating = savedStateHandle.contains(KEY_RATING)
                val hasDraftComment = savedStateHandle.contains(KEY_COMMENT)
                _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                    item = item,
                    rating = if (hasDraftRating) _state.value.rating
                    else existing?.rating ?: 0,
                    comment = if (hasDraftComment) _state.value.comment
                    else existing?.comment ?: "",
                    isLoading = false
                )
                // Если черновика не было, а отзыв существовал — сохраняем как стартовый.
                if (!hasDraftRating && existing != null) {
                    savedStateHandle[KEY_RATING] = existing.rating
                }
                if (!hasDraftComment && existing != null) {
                    savedStateHandle[KEY_COMMENT] = existing.comment
                }
            }.onFailure { e ->
                _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = e.message ?: "Не удалось загрузить айтем"
                )
            }
        }
    }

    fun onRatingChange(newRating: Int) {
        savedStateHandle[KEY_RATING] = newRating
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(rating = newRating, error = null)
    }

    fun onCommentChange(value: String) {
        savedStateHandle[KEY_COMMENT] = value
        _state.value = _state.value.copy(comment = value, error = null)
    }

    fun save(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        val uid = currentUserId
        if (uid == null) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(error = "Не авторизован")
            return
        }
        val rating = _state.value.rating
        if (rating < 1 || rating > ItemConstraints.RATING_MAX) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(error = "Поставьте оценку от 1 до 5")
            return
        }
        val comment = _state.value.comment.trim()
        if (comment.length > ItemConstraints.REVIEW_COMMENT_MAX) {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                error = "Комментарий слишком длинный (максимум ${ItemConstraints.REVIEW_COMMENT_MAX})"
            )
            return
        }
        if (_state.value.isSaving) return

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _state.value = _state.value.copy(isSaving = true, error = null)
            val user = userRepository.currentUser.value
            val item = _state.value.item

            reviewRepository.saveReview(
                Review(
                    userId = uid,
                    itemId = itemId,
                    rating = rating,
                    comment = comment,
                    authorName = user?.displayName ?: "",
                    authorAvatarBase64 = user?.avatarBase64 ?: "",
                    itemName = item?.name ?: "",
                    itemSymbol = item?.symbol,
                    itemIconKey = item?.iconKey
                )
            )
                .onSuccess {
                    // Черновик больше не нужен — очищаем.
                    savedStateHandle.remove<Int>(KEY_RATING)
                    savedStateHandle.remove<String>(KEY_COMMENT)
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        rating = 0,
                        comment = ""
                    )
                    onSuccess()
                }
                .onFailure { e ->
                    _state.value = _state.value.copy(
                        isSaving = false,
                        error = e.message ?: "Не удалось сохранить отзыв"
                    )
                }
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val KEY_RATING = "review_rating"
        const val KEY_COMMENT = "review_comment"
    }
}

@Composable
fun LowestRatedContent(
    state: LowestRatedUiState,
    onBack: () -> Unit = {},
    onItemClick: (String) -> Unit = {}
) {
    TerminalScreen {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            TerminalTopBar(
                title = "// наименьший рейтинг",
                left = {
                    LabelText(
                        text = "< назад",
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary,
                        modifier = Modifier.clickable(onClick = onBack)
                    )
                }
            )
            HorizontalLine()
            Spacer(Modifier.height(Spacing.md))

            when (state) {
                is LowestRatedUiState.Loading -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        BlinkingCursor()
                    }
                }
                is LowestRatedUiState.Error -> {
                    Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.Center) {
                        AlertBox(text = state.message)
                    }
                }
                is LowestRatedUiState.Success -> {
                    if (state.items.isEmpty()) {
                        LabelText(text = "// айтемов пока нет")
                    } else {
                        LazyColumn(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(Spacing.sm)
                        ) {
                            items(state.items, key = { it.id }) { item ->
                                ItemRow(item = item, onClick = { onItemClick(item.id) })
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
